tadabhāve teṣāntārṇṇapārṇṇatvādīnāṃ viśeṣadharmmāṇāmabhāve bhavato dhūmamātrasya tebhya eva viśeṣadharmebhyo bhavatītyevamātmanastadutpattiniyamasyābhāvāt
tathā tadabhāve'gnyabhāve bhavato dravyatvādeḥ sāmānyadharmasyāgnerevāyaṃ bhavatītyevaṃ--rūpasya tadutpattiniyamasyābhāvāt
kutaḥ sarvathā janyajanakabhāvo yataḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ syāt
yata evantasmāt kāryaṃ dhūmādikaṃ svabhāvairyā vadbhirdhūmatvādibhiḥ svagatairitthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā
teṣāṃ kāraṇagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇāṃ hetuḥ kāryaṃ gamakamityarthaḥ
teṣāmeva kāraṇagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇāntatkāryamityevaṃ rūpasya niyamasya sadbhāvāt
na hi tatsāmānyadharmāt kadācidapi kāryaṃ vyabhicarati
kāryamapi taireva dharmaiḥ svagataiḥ kāraṇagatānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ gamakāḥ
yerthāntarāsambhavino dhūmatvapā ṇḍutvādayo viśeṣarūpāstaiḥ kāraṇagataiḥ sāmānyadharmairvinā na bhavanti
yadi sāmānyadharmāṇāṃ kāraṇagatānāṃ kāryagatairviśeṣadharmairevāvinābhāvād gamyagamakabhāvastadāṃśena janyajanakabhāvaḥ syāt
dhūmasya ca viśeṣadharmā eva janyāḥ syuḥ
yadi hi kāryasya taiḥ kāraṇagatairviśeṣadharmairjanyo yo viśeṣaḥ sa grahītuṃ śakyate jñāpakahetvadhikārāt
tathā liṅgaviśeṣo liṅgameva viśeṣo dhūmalakṣaṇaḥ sa upādhirviśeṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ dravyatvādīnānteṣāṃ grahaṇe'bhimatatvād gamakatvasya
na hi dhūmena viśeṣitā dravyatvādayo'gniṃ vyabhicaranti
nanu dhūma eva tatra gamako na tu tadviśiṣṭā dravyatvādayaḥ
yathā kṛtakatve sati prameyatvādityatra kṛtakatvameva gamakaṃ na prameyatvaṃ
na dhūmasya vyabhicārādiha sāmānyopādānaṃ kintarhi sarveṣāṃ pratipattṝṇāṃ dṛṣṭe vastuni sāmānyākāre pratipattirbhavati paścād viśeṣāvasāyaḥ
tasmāt pratipatturadhyavasāyavaśād viśeṣopahitaṃ sāmānyaṅgamakambhavati na viśeṣasya vyabhicārāditi
liṅgaviśeṣasya sāmānyaviśeṣaṇatvenaivopādānā d ahetutvaṃ hetutvopādāne hi hetutvaṃ syānnānyathā
yadā dravyatvādīnyaviśiṣṭāni vivakṣitāni tadā teṣāṃ vyabhicārād gamakatvanneṣyate
svabhāve sādhye kimbhūte bhāvamātrānurodhini hetusadbhāvamātrānurodhini bhāvo hetuḥsvabhāvo hetuḥ
tasya hetorbhāvini'bhūtasya kāraṇāntarāyattasya dharmasya paścād yo bhāvastasya niyamābhāvāt
nanu ca sādhyasvabhāvatā sādhanasya na kenacidiṣṭaṃ tatkathamucyate tadbhāvamātrānurodhinyeva tādātmyamiti
evammanyate vyatiriktāvapi kṛtakatvānityatvākhyau dharmāvapyupagacchadbhiravaśyamabhūtvā bhavanaṃ bhūtvā cābhavanamabhyupagantavyamanyathātmāderiva kṛtakatvānityatve paṭāderna syātāṃ
tasmād yadevābhūtvā bhavanambhāvasya tadeva kṛtakatvaṃ yadeva ca bhūtvā'bhavanamanavasthāyitvantadevānityatvamastu kimanyena sāmānyena kalpiteneti
bodharūpaṃ pratyakṣādikaṃ pramāṇaṃ svata eva sidhyati
jñānajñeyābhāvayostu nīrūpatvena viśeṣābhāvāt kathaṃ jñānābhāvasya svataḥsiddhi rjñeyābhāvasya cajñānābhāvāt siddhirucyate
kevalaṃ yadi svasantāne jñānaṃ syād upalabhyetānupalambhādasadeva taditi svata eva jñānābhāvaḥ siddha iṣyate
tatrāpi hi yadi sattā syādupalabhyetānupalambhānnāstīti niścīyate tataścāpārthikānupalabdhirabhāvasiddhau
ghaṭagrāhakatvasya bhūtalagrāhakasya caikajñānasaṃsargitvād yadā bhūtalagrāhakameva tajjñānambhavati
anyasya ghaṭaviviktasya bhūtalādeḥ sattayā siddhyā niṣedhyasyārthasya sattā kinna sidhyati
nanu bhāvanivṛttirūpo'bhāvaḥ sa kathaṃ pratyakṣasiddha ityucyate
abhāvo nāma nāstyeva kevalaṃ mūḍhasya bhāvaviṣayameva pratyakṣamanyābhāvaṃ vyavahārayati
tena yaduktama rthā pa ttyā'bhāvaḥ pratīyata iti tadayuktaṃ
yato na tāvad ghaṭādīnāmanyonyābhāvo'bhinnaḥ ghaṭavināśe paṭādyutpattiprasaṅgāt
atha bhinno'bhāvastadā ghaṭādīnāṃ parasparaṃ bhedo na syāt
yadā hi ghaṭābhāvarūpaḥ paṭo na bhavati tadā paṭo ghaṭa eva syāt
yathā vā ghaṭasya paṭābhāvād bhinnatvād ghaṭarūpatā tathā paṭāderapi syāt
nāpyeṣāṃ parasparābhinnānāmabhāve na bhedaḥ śakyate karttuṃ
nāpi parasparabhinnānāmabhāvena bhedaḥ kriyate svahetubhya eva bhinnānāmutpatteḥ
atha svarūpeṇa bhedastathābhāvānāmapi sa syāditi kimabhāvena kalpitena
nanu prāgabhāve sati hetoḥ sakāśādutpattiḥ syānnāsati prāgabhāve vidyamāna- tvāt
yadyevanna kadācanāpi kāryotpattiḥ syād virodhinaḥ prāgabhāvasya sannihitatvāt
na ca tadvināśāt kāryotpattiḥ prāgabhāvamantareṇa kāryotpattyabhyupagamaprasaṅgāt
tasmādutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ kāryasya na bhāvo nāpyabhāvo dharmosattvāt
kintu yadotpadyate tadā sattvamasyānyadā nāstīti vyavahriyate
pra dhvaṃ sā bhā va sya cāsattvaṃ svayamevācāryobhidhāsyate
yacca yasmādutpadyate tattasya kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ cocyate
teṣāṃ caikakṣaṇasthāyitvenotpatternāśitvaṃ svasvarūpeṇaivotpatteḥ parasparabhinnatā ca sidhyati
yasmād ghaṭādeḥ pūrvampaścādanyatra ca nivṛttimātramabhinnaṃ pratibhāsate
kevalaṃ yo mūḍha utpatteḥ pūrvaṃ paścādanyatra ca kāryasya bhāvamicchati taṃ pratīdamucyate
kāryasya pūrvampaścādanyatra cābhāva iti bhāvāropaniṣedhamātraṃ kriyate
na cāvastuna ete syurākārā ityādi yaduktantannirastaṃ
itaścaitannirastaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ yato na prākpradhvaṃsābhāvābhyāmbhāvasya kaścit tadutpattilakṣaṇo virodhalakṣaṇo vā sambandho'sahabhāvitvenādviṣṭhatvāt
yadi ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasambandhabalena bhāvasya prāgabhāva iti pratītistathā prāgabhāvāderbhāva ityapi pratītiḥ syāt sambandhasyāviśeṣāt
na cā nyo nyā bhā vo bhāvānāmasti
na hi ghaṭasya nivṛttiḥ paṭasya nivṛttirbhavatyapratīteḥ na ca paṭe'vasthānātsā tatsambandhinī yuktā
tasmādanyābhāva evāsti nānyonyābhāvastenānyābhāvāt prāgabhāvādīnāṃ na bheda iti kathaṃ caturvidho'bhāva ucyate
pratyakṣābhāvanirāśasaśca nai rā tmya si ddhā vabhihita iti nehocyate
naiṣa doṣo ya smādekajñānasaṃsargiṇoḥ pratyakṣeṇaikasya grahaṇamevānyasyāgrahaṇantadagrahaṇameva ca tasyābhāvagrahaṇambhāve hi tasyāgrahaṇāyogād
evantāvadamūḍhaṃ prati dṛśyānupalambho nābhāvaṃ vyabhicaratītyabhāvavyavahāraḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ
na cāpyabhāvonupalabdhānāmapi sattvānnityaṃ śakyamānānupalaṃbhavyabhicāra iti kṛtvā vyavaharttumaśakya iti vaktuṃ yuktaṃ
tato na tatra gotvaṃ sādhyate kintu govyavahāraḥ
yadāyaṃ mūḍhamatiḥ śāvaleye pravarttitagovyavahāro bāhuleye śāvaleyarūpaśūnyatvād govyavahāraṃ na pravarttayati sa nimittapradarśanena govyavahāre pravarttyate
tathā ceti yenaivaṃ vyavahāraḥ sādhyate tena dṛṣṭāntāsiddhicodanāpi prativyūḍhā pratikṣiptā
anupalabdherliṅgādabhāve sādhye yenaiva liṅgo na sādhyadharmiṇyabhāvaḥsādhyastenaiva dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇyapi tatrāpyaparo dṛṣṭānta ityanavasthā syāt
nanu yo hi viṣayaṃ pratipadyate sa viṣayiṇamapi pratipadyata iti kathaṃ vyavahārasyāpi sādhyatvamityāha
dṛśyante hi loke tathāvidhā ye viṣayapratipattāvapyapratipannaviṣayiṇaḥ

tena nirhetukepi vināśe'gnisannidhānāt pūrvaṃ prabandhapravṛttasya śītasparśasya svarasanirodhe'nyasya ca prabandhenotpitsoragnisannidhāne satyanutpatteragniśītayorvirodhāvagatirloke na tu paramārthato virodhaḥ
atha sahetukavināśamabhyupagamyaivamucyate tadā yathāsau kāraṇaṃ nivarttayati kāryaṃ kinna nivarttayati

yadi ca kāraṇanivarttanamantareṇa na kāryaṃ nivarttayituṃ śakyate tadā tatkāraṇasyāpi kathannivarttakaṃ yāvattatkāraṇaṃ na nivarttayati tatkāraṇasyāpyevamityanavasthayā na kaścit kasyacinnivarttakaḥ syāt
na ca santānāpekṣayaitadvaktuṃ yujyate sahetuke vināśe santānasyaivābhāvāditi yatkiñcidetat
sa cetyanyabhāve satyabhāvonutpattilakṣaṇo virodhaheturanupalabdheḥ sakāśād vyavahriyate
anyonyopalabdhiḥ parasparapratipattistasyāḥ parihāro vivekastena sthitaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yayostau tathoktau
tathā hi yayoreva dharmayorekatrānavasthānantayoreva dvitīyo virodhaḥ
dvitīyastvanyena sahaikatvābhāvena svarūpaviṣaya ityanayorvirodha yormahān bhedaḥ
na ca nīla nivṛttirūpampītampītanivṛttirūpaṃ ca nīlamanayorbhāvarūpatvānnīlābhāve pītasya bhāvaprasaṃgācca

bhāvasya ca rūpe pratibhāsamāne tadabhāvo na pratibhāsate
tasmād virodhadvayasyāpyanupalabdhikṛtatvād viruddhopalabdhyādayo vidhimukhena prayuktā apyanupalabdhisvabhāvā bhavanti
na ca sambandhagrāhakasya pramāṇasya rūpaṃ sambandhinorbhavati
na hyagnidhūmayoḥ sambandhagrāhakasya pratyakṣasya rūpaṃ dhūmasya bhavati nāgneḥ
tasmād dṛṣṭānte gṛhītavirodhamagnyādikamanyatra pradeśe dṛṣṭvā śītādyabhāvonumīyata iti
yadi virodhasambandhadvāreṇa gamyagamakabhāvo virodhināntataścā gnidarśanācchītasya pratītiḥ syāttayoreva virodhasambandhena samutthitatvāt
yadā cāgninā śīto nivarttyate tadā kathaṃ virodhaḥ sambandho dviṣṭhatvābhāvāt
tasmād yathā yathāgnisadbhāve śītasyānupalambhastathā tathā dṛṣṭānte tadabhāvasya pratipannatvāt
anityoghaṭaḥ syānnitya ityatra hyanityopalabdhireva nityānupalabdhirato na nityānityarūpamvastu
etacca kāraṇamātra gṛhītvoktamapratibaddhāsāmarthyasya kāraṇasyābhāvaḥ kāryābhāvād gamyata eva
svabhāvāntarasya ca niṣedhe sādhye kāraṇānupalabdhirevetyavadhāraṇamato na vyāghātaḥ
asyāmapīti svabhāvānupalabdhau yadā vyāpako yo dharmastasyānupalabdhyā vyāpyābhāvamāha
yadā hi samunnatayoḥ parvatapradeśayorekasmin pradeśe taruvanaṃ dṛśyamānamatigahanatvādanavadhāritavṛkṣaviśeṣambhavati
tatrāparasmin parvvatoddeśe śiṃśapābhāvo na niścetumpāryate śiṃśapāyā adṛśyatvād vṛkṣastūpalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpta iti śakyate'bhāvaniścayaḥ karttuntasya
tatrāgnirviruddhaṃ śītaṃ nivarttayan tadvyāpyantuṣārasparśamapi nivarttayatītyarthataḥ svabhāvaviruddhopalabdhāviyamantarbhavati
yatra ca vahniḥ pratyakṣaḥ śītasparśastuṣārasparśaścāpratyakṣastatrāyamapi prayogo draṣṭavyaḥ
na śītasparśotra dhūmāditi śītaviruddhognistasya kāryaṃ dhūmaḥ sogniṃ sannidhāpayati sa ca śītamapanayati
yatra ca śītasparśaḥ parokṣo vahnirapi dhūmaśca pratyakṣastatrāyaṃ prayogo draṣṭavyaḥ
yadā mahāhradasyopari vāspādau dhūmādirūpatayā sandeho bhavati tadā'yaṃ prayogo draṣṭavyaḥ
tatra hi niṣkampe mahāhrade yadyagniḥ syāt prabhāsvaratayā pratyakṣa eva syād
svabhāva eva vṛkṣatvaṃ śiṃśapātvasyāto vṛkṣatvena śiṃśapā vyāptā
nanu ca svabhāvānupalabdhāveva dṛśyaniṣedho na tu viruddhopalabdhyādau
tathā hyadṛśyasyaiva śītasparśasya kāryasya cādṛśyasyaiva niṣedhaḥ sādhyate
tena yathā'dṛśyasya śītasparśāderniṣedhastathā piśācāderapi syādityata āha

yathā svabhāvānupalabdhāvanyatropalabdhasya ghaṭādeḥ pradeśaviśeṣe'bhāvaḥ sādhyate tathānyatra pratipannavirodhasya śītasparśasya pratipannakāryatvasya ca kāryasya viruddhopalabdhyādinā sādhyadharmiṇyabhāvaḥ sādhyate na tu sarvadā'dṛśyasyeti
teṣāmapi yeṣāmabhāvenābhāvaḥ sādhyate teṣāṃ kāraṇādīnāṃ dṛśyātmanāmevāsiddhiranupalabdhiḥ
tadviruddhānāṃ ca pratiṣedhyārthaviruddhānāñca svabhāvaviruddhādīnāṃ siddhirupalabdhiliṅgatvena veditavyā
atra ca dṛśyātmanāṃ siddhiriti na sambadhyate upalabdhivacanādeva dṛśyātmatāyā labdhatvāt
tasya śītaviruddhasyāgneryat kāraṇaṃ kāṣṭhādistasyopalabdhyā kinna sidhyati śītābhāvaḥ
tena śītasparśena viruddhasya vahnernimittaṃ kāṣṭhādistasya yopalabdhiḥ prayujyate sā vyabhicāriṇī
atra hi kāṣṭhamātrasya dahanahetoḥ śītanimittena tuṣārādinā virodhābhāvāt
yatpunarapratibaddhasāmarthyamagnijanakaṃ kāṣṭhantasya yadyapi śītanimittena virodhastathāpi tathābhūtasya kāṣṭhasya kāryadarśanādeva niścayāt kāryavirodha eva syāt
sannihito dahanaviśeṣo yasya puruṣasya sa tathā tadbhāvastasmāt
atra hi paritāpanimittasya dahanasya romaharṣādinimittena śītena virodhosti
śītasparśasya tatkāryasya ca romaharṣādeḥ parokṣatve sati vahnidarśanācchītakāraṇanivṛttyā yadā romaharṣādernivṛttiḥ sādhyābhipretā tadā'yaṃ prayogo draṣṭavyaḥ
yasya viruddhasya kāryamupalabhyate tena viruddho yo dvitīyaḥ pratiyogī sa tadviruddhastasya yat kāryantasyābhāvagatiruktā
romaharṣādiviśeṣo yaḥ śītakṛtastena yukto yaḥ puruṣaḥ sa yasmin pradeśevidyate sa tathā
puruṣe hi dharmiṇi na pakṣadharmo hetuḥ syād dhūmasya pradeśadharmatvāt
yatra vahniḥ śītasparśo romaharṣādiviśeṣaśca parokṣastatrābhāvasādhane draṣṭavyaḥ
tatra hi śītaviruddhāgnikāryasya dhūmasyopalabdhyā agniviruddhaśītakāryasya romaharṣāderabhāvaḥ sādhayitumiṣṭastena tathābhūta eva sādhyaḥ
dhūmo hi dahanaṃ sannidhāpayati sa śītannivartayati
maulena prabhedena caturvidhāpi satī avāntaraprayogabhedād aṣṭavidhā bhavati
nanu ciravinaṣṭepyagnau vāsagṛhādau dhūmasya sadbhāvāt kathamviruddhakāryopalabdherna vyabhicāra ityata āha
nātra śītaḥ kasmiṃścit kāle yadā'gnirvartamānībhūta iti kālāpekṣaṇaṃ
vyomni dhūmāt kutraciddeśe nāsti śīto yatra sannihito vahniryatoyaṃ dhūma utthita iti deśāpekṣaṇaṃ
yovasthāviśeṣo dhūmasya sannihitāgnerdṛṣṭastamapekṣya varttamānepi kāle śītābhāvonumīyate
nanu deśakālādyapekṣitvasya kāryahetuviśeṣaṇatve'siddho hetuḥ syād dharmiṇo'bhāvāditi cet
anyatheti yadi na deśādyapekṣaṇantadā vyabhicāri viruddhakāryaṃ syāt
yathā bhasmānapekṣitadeśakālaṃ aśītasādhane śītābhāve sādhye vyabhicāri
samaguṇeti sannihitānupahitena yathā kṣitivījodakādikāraṇakalāpaṃ dṛṣṭvāṃkuraḥ kāryonumīyate
sa kathaṃ kāraṇākhyo hetustrividhe svabhāvakāryānupalambhākhye hetāvantarbhavati
samagreṇeti yāvataḥ kāraṇakalāpāt kāryamutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭantāvatā nāntyāvasthāprāptena tatra liṅgigrahaṇāt prāgeva kāryasya pratyakṣatvāt
yaḥ kāryotpādonumīyate sa hetoḥ svabhāvo varṇitaḥ
yasmāttatra samagreṣu kāraṇeṣu samagrāt kāraṇālliṅgāt kāryotpattisambhavastathānumīyate
yadi tarhi kāryotpādanaśaktistanmātrānuvandhinī niyatastarhi kāryotpāda iti sa eva kasmānnānumīyata iti paraḥ pṛcchati
kiṃ punaḥ sāmagryāḥ sakāśāt kāryamevānumīyata ityatrāha
tathā hi pūrvasmāt samagrāduttarasyasamarthasya kṣaṇasyotpattistasya cātmātiśayaḥ śaktiriti sāmagrī phalaṃ śaktistāsāṃ pariṇāmaḥ
pūrvasajātiḥ sadṛśaḥ pūrvaḥ kāraṇakalāpastāvanmātraṃ heturyasyāḥ śaktiprasūteḥ sā tathā
nanu kāryaṃ prati kāraṇasya yogyatā yadi śaktirucyate tadā kāryavyabhicāre yogyatāyā api vyabhicāra iti kathametadanumānaṃ
atha yogyatāsambhava ucyate tadāyamarthaḥ syāt kāryaṃ syādvā na veti
yadyetadanumānampareṇa samarthyate tadā trividhaliṅgajamevetyā cā rye ṇa pratipādyate
yadā tu kadācit kāryaṃ syādityevaṃrūpaḥ sambhavonumīyate tadā kathamasya vyabhicāraḥ
tenāyamartha uttarottarapariṇāme yadi prabandhābhāvastadā kāryaṃ syādanyadā tu nāstīti
anye tu pariṇāmavatyāṃ sāmagryāṃ pratibandhakābhāve satyekāntena kāryotpādanayogyatā bhavatīti saivānumīyate
kāryotpādanayogyatāpratītiśca kāryamapi viśeṣaṇatvenākṣipatīti na pṛthak kāryānumānaṃ kriyata iti manyante
kevalaṃ sāmagrīmātrāt kāryānumāne vyabhicāra ucyate pratibandhakābhāvaḥ kathampratipanna iti cet
yo hi taṃ jñātuṃ śaknoti tasyaitadanumānaṃ yo hi dhūmasyāgnijanyatvaṃ jñātuṃ śaknoti tasya dhūmādagnyanumānaṃ nānyasya tadvat
yā tarhītyādinā punarapi tridhaiva sa ityasya vyāghātamāha
rasasya janikā yā sāmagrī tasyāmeva sāmagryāmāyattasya rasato liṅgādyā gatiḥ
rasasya yo hetuḥ pūrvamapādānantasya yo dharmoṃ rūpajanakatvantasyānumānena
evaṃ hi tasya rasasamānakālabhāvi rūpajanakatvaṃ niścīyate
yadi samānakālabhāvino rūpasyāpi niścayaḥ syāttenātītaikakālānāmekaiva gatiḥ kāryaliṅgajā
nanvanabhihitād rasahetoḥ sakāśāt paścātsamānakālasya rupasyānumānaṃ hetoḥ kāryānumāne vyabhicārāt
kāryotpādanayogyatānumāne ca na rasasamānakālasya rūpasyānumānaṃ syāt
yadā tu samānakālānāṅgatistadā kāryaṃ liṅgaṃ yasya hetudharmānumānasya tatkāryaliṅgantasmājjātā kāryaliṅgajeti tadapāstaṃ
cāvayavidravye rūpādayo guṇā vyavasthitāstena tatra rūpāderasato gatiryuktā
na bau ddhā nāṃ rūpādivyatirekeṇāvayavino'nabhyupagamāt na dharmiṇo'bhāvāt
kṣaṇikatve hi rūpādeḥ samānajātīyakāryatvaṃ syānna rasādikāryatvaṃ pratibandhagrāhakābhāvāt
santānāśrayeṇa tvanumānādivyavahāre rūpādisantānānāṃ na parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ pratipanna iti kathamanumānānumeyavyavahāra iti
tatra ca rūpādīnāṃ parasparāvinirbhāgarbhāga niyamaḥ pratīyata eva
sa ca pratibandhahetuko'nyathā ghaṭapaṭādīnāmapi parasparāvinirbhāganiyamaḥ syāt
pratibandhaśca teṣāṃ na tādātmyaṃ bhedena pratīter
na caikārthasamavāyasteṣāṃ yato na tāvadasamavetānāṃ samavāyabalādekārthasamavāyaḥ samavāyasyaivābhāvāt
samavetānāmapi kiṃ samavāyena svahetubhya eva tathā niṣpatteḥ
yadyapi cātrāvayavī ma vidyate tathāpyāmrādipratyayaviṣayasya dharmitvantena tatra rasato rūpādigatiḥ
yato yaiva svabhāvena rūpaṃ rūpaṃ janayati na tenaiva rasādikaṃ janayati teṣāṃ parasparābhedaprasaṃgāt
na tatra rūpasya pūrvvamekakāryajanakatvaṃ yenāyandoṣaḥ syāt
na ca kāraṇasya kāryābhāva eva kāraṇatvaṃ yenānekamekasmādutpadyamānamekaṃ prasajyeta kintu kāryotpattau prāgbhāva eva tasya kāraṇatvaṃ loke
yathā caikakāryotpattau tasya prāgbhāvakāraṇatvantathā kalāpotpattāvapi dṛṣṭatvāt
yadvā yenaiva svabhāvena rūpaṃ rūpaṃ janayati tenaiva rasādikamapi svarūpabhedastveṣāmupādānabhedakṛto na sahakārikṛtaḥ
tathā hi vāyau sparśasadbhāvepi rūpādyabhāvād rūpādyanutpattiḥ
apsu rasādibhāvepi gandhābhāvād gandhānutpattistena rasāderniyataṃ kāraṇaṃ rasādirevāvasīyate
tena rūpamekayā śaktyā rūpaṃ janayatyanyānyayā rasādikamiti
śaktasyāpi kiṃ śaktiyogena svarūpeṇaiva kārakatvācchakteśca kārakatvaṃ na syācchaktiyogābhāvāt
bhāvopi tarhi śī ktatvāt kimiti śaktimapekṣate
yopi mī māṃ sa ko manyate
bhāvasya svarūpātiśaya eva śa ktiḥ sā ca bhinnābhinnā
yato bhāve gṛhyamāṇe śaktirna gṛhyate'to bhāvād bhinnā
kāryānyathānupapattyā tu sā bhāvasyābhinnā'nyathā bhāvasya kārakatvanna syāt
kiṃ cārthāpattyā kāryāt prāgbhāvina eva bhāvasyābhinnā śaktiḥ kalpyatāṃ iti prāgbhāva eva śaktiḥ
sa ca pratyakṣasiddha iti kathaṃ na śaktiḥ pratyakṣā
tasmāt kāryād rasādeḥ kāraṇadharmānumānād asya kāryahetāvantarbhāvaḥ
nanu ca rasakāryeṇānumitāt kāraṇāt sakāśāt samānakālinaḥ kāryasyānumānamidaṃ na tu hetudharmānumānamityata āha
rasād rūpe pratipattau hetureva tathābhūta iti rūpajananasambandhonumīyate
pravṛttā na pratibaddhā śaktiryasya tat pravṛttaśakti
svakāraṇasyeti rasasya yat svakāraṇantasya phalotpādanaṃ pratītirasotpādanaṃ pratyābhimukhyenānuguṇyena vinā na rasa utpadyate
rūpasya ya upādānahetavaḥ pūrvalakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītā rūpaparamāṇavasteṣāṃ rūpajananampratyābhimukhyaṃ pravṛttistasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ
sāpi rasopādānakāraṇapravṛttī rūpopādānakāraṇasya rūpajananamprati yā pravṛttistayā saha karttu śīlaṃ yasyā rasopādānakāraṇapravṛtteḥ sā tathoktā
yata evantasmād yathābhūtāddhetoriti pravṛttaśaktirūpopādānakāraṇasahitāt pūrvakṣaṇasaṃgṛhītād rasā lliṅgatvenābhimato rasa utnnastathābhūtameva hetumanumāpayan gamayan samānakālaṃ rūpaṃ gamayati
yataśca sādhyāyattatvena heturgamakastena kāraṇena trividhāddhetornānyo hetuḥ saṃyogyādirgamakosti
śliṣṭānāmapi kiṃ saṃyogena svahetubhyaḥ eva śliṣṭānāmutpatteḥ
apṛthaksiddhānāmapi kiṃ samavāyena svahetubhya evoparyuparibhāvena niṣpattestena na samavāyenāpi gamakatvaṃ
yacca nai yā yi koktaṃ pūrvavaccheṣavatsāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ cānumānaṃ nyāyasūtraṃ 1
śeṣavadanumānaṃ ca kāryāt kāraṇānumānaṃ tadiṣṭameva śāstrakṛtā
yathā devadattasya deśāntaraprāptiṃ gatipūrvikāṃ dṛṣṭvā'dityasyāpi deśāntaraprāptyā gatyanumānaṃ
sarvamevānumānaṃ sāmānyato dṛṣṭameveti svayamevā cā ryaṃstṛtīye paricchede vakṣyati
yadapyu dyo ta ka re ṇa sāmānyato dṛṣṭamudāhṛtaṃ
yathā valākātasto yānumānantadapi kāryaliṅgajameveti pra mā ṇa vi ni śca ye'bhihitaṃ
tasmād yathābhūtād bhūtapariṇāmād varṣahetuḥ pipīlikādīnāmvikāro jātaḥ
anyatra tu yogyatānumīyate na tu varṣa eva pratibandhasambhavena vyabhicārāt
tasmāt samagrādapi kāraṇakalāpānnāsti kāryānumānaṃ kevalaṃ yogyatānumānameva
ye tu mī māṃ sa kā dayo'samagrādapi kāraṇāt kāryamanumimate
ātmanyātmīye cāhammameti yobhiniveśaḥ sa pūrvaḥ kāraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ rāgādīnāntena tathoktāḥ
yoniṃ yoniṃ manaskarotīti saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyā miti śas pratyayo vā
rāgādirahitā upalakhaṇḍādayo vipakṣastatra heturdehādimattvasya yā vṛttistasyā adṛṣṭāvapi
yathā caitadanantaroktaṃ na pramāṇantathā vipakṣe hetoradṛṣṭimātreṇa kāryasāmānyasya kāryamātrasya darśanāt
nanu sarvameva vacanaṃ rāgādikāryamiti kathantatkāryasāmānyamityata āha
aviśiṣṭavivakṣāmātraṃ vaktukāmatā sāmānyantadeva heturyeṣāṃ spandādīnānte tathoktāstadbhāvastasmāt
na ca vaktukāmatā rāgaḥ,api tu nityasukhātmātmīyākāraṃ yaddarśana- mabhiniveśastenākṣiptaṃ janitaṃ
te ca satvālambanatvād ātmādidarśanapravṛttāḥ sattvānunayapravṛttyā cābhiṣvaṅgasvabhāvāstato vītarāgā api rāgiṇaḥ prasaktā ityata āha
atra vacanād rāgānumāne kriyamāṇe vacanamātrādapratipattirityanena sambandhaḥ
yasmād yathā rakto bravīti tathā viraktopīti prakṣīṇarāgopi
na hi vītarāgasya vacanoccāraṇe phalamasti tathā cāvyabhicāro rāgavacanayoriti bhāvaḥ
vītarāgo hi pareṣṭavyāsakto na ca saktimantareṇa parārthapravṛttirastīti bhāvaḥ
sattvadarśanaviparyāsāyātatvāt karuṇāpi rāgātmako doṣa iti cedāha
nanu ca sattvālambanā eva pṛthagjanenābhyastāstāstatkathaṃ dharmādyālambanā ucyanta ityata āha
na rāgāpekṣiṇya iti nānuśayena sattveṣu pravarttanta ityarthaḥ
ātmadarśananivṛttāvapi tarhi karuṇāvadabhyāsād rāgādayaḥ pravarttanta ityāha
iṣṭo nāma parārthastathāpi kathaṃ phalatvamiti cet
nanvahamiti buddhirahitasya kathaṃ parārthāpi pravṛttiriti cet
yadi vacanād vītarāgasya vaktukāmatā sādhyate atha karuṇā tena sarāga ityucyate
tadanyena rāgādibhyonyena vaktukāmatādinā vītarāgasya doṣavattvasādhane na kiṃcid aniṣṭaṃ
vaktaryātmani yāvān kaścid viśeṣo dṛṣṭastasya sarvasyānyatrānumānaprasaṅgaḥ
iheti sādhyābhimate rāgādāvapyavyabhicāra iti ko niścayaḥ
karaṇaguṇastālvādīnāmpāṭavādiḥ sa ca vaktukāmatā ceti dvandvaḥ
tathā hi yathā pāṣāṇādau rāgotpādanayogyatāvirahastathā sarvapuruṣadharmairapi tatastathābhūte vacanādarśanād yadi rāgotpādanayogyatānumānamevaṃ sarvapuruṣadharmasya
rāgotpādanayogyatā hi rāgavacanayorekaṅkāraṇantadanumāne ca rāgopyarthatonumito bhavati tena yogyatā evānumānaṃ na sarveṣāṃ puruṣadharmāṇāmityatrāha
tasya ca rāgasya santānavāhitvantathā ca dvitīyādivarṇṇaniṣpatau rāga evopayuktassyāt
sa eva rāga upayuktaḥ syādātmādyabhiniveśavatāṃ sarveṣāmeva rāgitvāt
sarvadarśinastu darśananivṛttyā syānniścayastasya hi sarvajñeyavyāpi jñānaṃ
sarvadharmakṣaṇikatvādyālambanaṃ ca jñānaṃ spaṣṭābhaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ cocyate
tasmāt tattvābhyāsanimittā sphuṭābhatvabṛddhireva tattvasākṣātkaraṇena pratyakṣatvakāriṇī rāgādiyogyasvabhāvatāṃ jñānasya bādhate
tena yadi nāma rāgārahite kvacid vacanaṃ na dṛṣṭantāvatā sarvatra vītarāge vacanena na bhāvyamiti nāsti niścayaḥ
ātmadarśanaṃ sa tkā ya dṛ ṣṭiḥ
tadā hi yo mādṛśo rāgotpattipratyayaviśeṣeṇa yuktaḥ sa rāgī
yata evamadarśanamātrānnāsti niścayastasmād vipakṣe'dṛṣṭirvipakṣe hetoradarśanamaheturliṅgasya vyatirekaniścayaṃ prati
vipakṣadṛṣṭyā hetorvyabhicāro na ca vītarāge vacanaṃ dṛṣṭantasmādadarśanāt sādhyābhāve vyatirekaḥ siddha ityata āha
sambhāvyo vyabhicāro yasya sa tathā tadbhāvastasmāt
yadyapi na dṛṣṭo vipakṣe tathāpi tatra sambhavo na viruddha iti saṃmbhāvyate vyabhicāraḥ
bāhulyena sthālyantargatānāṃ pakvānāndarśanepi na sthālyantargatatvena kevalena pākaḥ sidhyati
etaireva pakvaiḥ samānaḥ pākaheturyeṣānte pakvā iti
kinnai yā yi ko ktaṃ kāryāt kāraṇānumānarūpaṃ śeṣavadanumānamihābhipretamutā nyadeveti pṛcchati
kiṅkāraṇantasya hetoḥ sa vyatireko'niścita iti vipakṣepi vṛttirāśaṃkyeta
yata evannādarśanamātrād vyatirekastasmādekanivṛttyā sādhyanivṛttyānyanivṛttiṃsādhananivṛttimicchatā tayoḥ sādhyasādhanayoḥ kaścit svabhāvena pratibandhastādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇopyeṣṭavyaḥ
yata evantena kāraṇena hetostriṣvapi rūpeṣu pakṣadharmānvayavyatirekeṣu niścayo varṇṇitaḥ
ācārya di gnā ge na pra mā ṇa sa mu cca yā diṣu
anvayavyatirekaniścayaṃ ca varṇṇayatā pratibandhopyarthato darśita eva
yasya doṣasya nirāśe na yo niścaya uktastaṃ vyācaṣṭe
viruddhapakṣyā yeṣāṃ sattvaṃ vipakṣe niścitaṃ sapakṣasattvaṃ sandigdhaṃ
prasiddhastu dvayorityā cā rya granthamidānīṃ vyācaṣṭe
dvayorityanenaikasya vādinaḥ prativādino vā yaḥ siddhastasyapratiṣedhaḥ
prasiddhavacanena sandigdhayoḥ śeṣavadasādhāraṇayoḥ pratiṣedha iti sambandhaḥ
tasmānniścayavacanādā cā rye ṇā pi pratibandha iṣṭa eva
tasmādetad yathā sapakṣe hetordarśane na bhrāntiḥ kintu tadvismṛtamiti sādharmyavacanena smaryate
tathā smṛtirvācā vaidharmyavacanenādarśane kriyata iti cet
darśanamapratīyamānamasmaryamāṇaṃ na sādhyapratipattyaṅgamiti yuktantatreti darśane vācā smaraṇādhānaṃ smṛtijananaṃ
tadabhāve vipakṣadarśanābhāve siddha eva darśanābhāva ityapārthakantatsiddhaye darśanābhāvasiddhaye vaidharmyavacanaṃ
darśanābhāvastu darśananivṛttirūpaḥ sa ca darśanānubhavābhāvādeva pratibhāsate
na vai anupalabhamānasya puṃsastāvatetyadarśanamātreṇa vipakṣe heturnāstītyevaṃ niścayo bhavati deśādiviprakṛṣṭānāmanupalambhepi sattvāt
yasmānna ca nāstīti vacanādapramāṇakāt tatpratikṣipyamāṇaṃ nāstyeva
hetoḥ svasādhye pratibandhagrāhakameva pramāṇaṃ sādhyāyattatāgrāhakantacceha darśanamabhipretaṃ yacca sādhya eva hetordarśanamidameva sarvatra vipakṣe'darśanaṃ
tena yasya sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakaṃ darśanaṃ pravṛttamvismṛtaṃ ca tasyaiva puṃsaḥ darśanādarśanayoḥ pratītayoḥ sādharmyavaidharmyavacanābhyāṃ smaraṇaṃ kriyate nānyasyetyarthaḥ
yathā yadi nāsti sa khyāpyata iti
yathā yena prakāreṇa svasādhyapratibandhena vipakṣe heturnāsti yadi sa nyāya iti pratibandhagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ khyāpyate smaryate tadā nāstīti gamyate
yadyanupalabhamānonupalambhamātrānnāstīti na pratyeti tadā vaidharmyavacanādapyapramāṇakānna pratyeṣyati
atiprasaṃgāditi pratibandhamantareṇa nivṛttau gonivṛttyāpyaśvasya niyamena nivṛttiḥ syāt
ācāryadi gnā ge na vipakṣe heturnnāstī tyuktamata eva niścaya ityata āha
tenā cā rye ṇa nāstīti yad vaidharmyavacanaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmāttathā bhavati vastuno nāstitvameva bhavatyatiprasaṅgāt
tadvacanasya hi prāmāṇye pratijñāmātrādapi sādhyasiddhiḥ syāt
tasmād vipakṣāddhetorvyāvṛttimicchatā tatra vyāvṛttau nyāyo vaktavyaḥ
sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ yata iti nyāyāt
tadabhāve sādhyābhāve'nupalambhātasiddhā vyāvṛttirhetorayameva nyāya iti manyate
yadyadṛṣṭyā hetorvipakṣānnivṛttiḥ syāttadā śeṣavadanumānaṃ vyabhicāri kiṃ
tathā hi yat pakṣīkṛtaṃ phalaṃ yaccopayuktaṃ sapakṣatvenopāttantadvyatirekeṇa vipakṣabhūte tṛtīye rāśau nāsti yathoktasya hetorvṛttiḥ
kadācidekaśākhāprabhavasyāpi phalasyāpakvasyātadrasasya vā pratyakṣeṇānubhavasambhavāt pratyakṣabādhāśaṅkā eva śeṣavato vyabhicāra ityeke ī śva ra se na prabhṛtayaḥ
tadayamartho na kevalābhyāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ heturgamakaḥ, api tvabādhitaviṣayatve satīti
na pravṛttena pratyakṣeṇa bādhāśaṅkā kintu kadācid gandhapratyakṣabādhāpakṣaṃ iti cedāha
na hi sambandhābhyupagame parasya bādhāśaṅkā nivarttata iti bhāvaḥ
avṛttabādhane'pravṛttenaiva pramāṇena bādhane sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ sarvatra hetau na syādāśvāso gamakatvaniścayaḥ
naivaṃ pratibandhavādinaḥ sarvatra hetāvanāśvāsaḥ sādhyapratibaddhe hetau bādhāśaṃkāyā apyabhāvāt
na ca vṛttaṃ pramāṇaṃ śeṣavato bādhakamasti
tasmāt sthitametad adarśanamātrād vyatireke śeṣavatopyavyabhi- cāritvaṃ syāditi
nanu pratibandhabalāt sādhyābhāve hetorvyatireke sati sattāmātreṇa vyatireko gamakaḥ syādityata āha
hetoryo vipakṣād vyatirekaḥ sa siddha eva niścita eva sādhanaṃ

yadi tarhyavidyayā nānityatvādhyavasāyo vinaśyatyapi bhāve mābhūdanityatādhyavasāya ityāśaṃkya bāhmamapi bhrāntibījamāha
yaḥ sattāyā evopalambho nābhāvasya tena sattopalambhena

uttarakṣaṇotpādakāla eva pūrvakṣaṇavināśāt pūrvottarayoḥ kṣaṇayorabhāvenāvyavadhānānnairantaryeṇānyatvāgrahāt sarvadā dvitīyādikṣaṇeṣvapi sattāyā evopalambhena tathābhāvaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭasya bhāvaḥ sadbhāvastasya yā śaṅkā kadācitsa evāyamityevaṃrūpā bhūtā bhrāntasyāpi sa evāyamiti darśanācchaketyāha
dṛṣṭaṃ ca sadṛśāparadarśanaṃ śuktikādau satyapi bhedabhrāntinimittaṃ
etacca nai rā tmya si ddhau vibhaktamiti tatraivābadhārya
tena sarvātmanā pūrvakṣaṇasadṛśasyāparasyotpattistayā vipralabdho na pūrvakṣaṇāduttarakṣaṇamanyatvenādhyavasyatyapi tu sa evāyamityata eva na pūrvakṣaṇasya vināśapratītiruttarasya cotpattipratītiḥ
tenāyamartho yadi sattopalambhe vyabhicāraḥ sadṛśāparotpattyā vā vipralambhaḥ sarvadāstyeva vipralambha ityevaṃ paraḥ
athavā kiṃ punaḥ paśyannapi na vyavasyatītyāha
pūrvaṃ yaḥ sattopalambhena pratīyamāne tadbhāvaśaṅkā pūrvadṛṣṭabhāvāropastena vipralabdhaḥ na vyavasyati
prathamakṣaṇasadṛśasya dvitīyakṣaṇasyotpattyā ca vipralabdho na vyavasyati
kṣaṇasthitidharmatāṃ paśyannapi sadṛśāparotpattyā vipralabdho na vyavasyatīti
nanu bhāvasya kṣaṇikatve sati pūrvottarakṣaṇānāṃ vibhāgena pratibhāsaḥ syāt
atha nīlādyavyatirikta tvāt kṣaṇiṃkatvasya nīlagrahe grahaḥ
yadi ca nīlādyavyatiriktaṃ kṣaṇikatvantadā nīlaniścaye kṣaṇikatvasya niścitatvādanumānasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt
pūrvāparakṣaṇavilakṣaṇa eva kṣaṇaḥ pratyakṣeṇānubhūtaniścitonumānena tu pratyakṣavṛttameva parāmṛśyata iti nānumānasya vaiyarthyamiti
bha ṭṭa vā su de va stvā ha
pūrvottarakṣaṇānāṃ vināśenāpratibhāsanamevākṣaṇikatvapratibhāsanamatokṣaṇikatvagrāhakameva sarvampratyakṣaṃ kevalaṃ kṣaṇikatvānumānena bhrāntaṃ sādhyata iti
yathā hyarthakṣaṇānāṃ paurvāparyantathā jñānakṣaṇānāmapi tena pūrvakeṇa jñānakṣaṇena pūrvaka evārthakṣaṇo gṛhyate nottaraḥ
ekasmin jñāne tayorapratibhāsanāt kathampūrvasmādayamanya iti vibhāgena pratibhāsaḥ syāditi codyate
svarūpapratibhāsa eva ca bhāvasyānyasmād vivekapratibhāsaḥ sumerubhinnapratibhāsavat
sa ca kṣaṇasyāpyastye veti kathaṃ na vivekapratibhāsaḥ
tathā hi prathamadarśī dṛśyamānameva svabhāvambhāvasya paśyati na tu dṛṣṭamityanayorbheda eva
na hi śuktikāyāntadevedamasmadīyaṃ rajatamiti pravarttamānasya śuktikārajatayorvivekapratibhā- sābhāvādabhedopi
tasmād yathātra nirvikalpake jñāne śuktikāyāḥ svarūpapratibhāsa evānyasmāda vivekapratibhāsaḥ
kevalaṃ pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ kasmānna vibhāgena smaryata iti yadi paraṃ codyaṃ syāttatra coktameva sadṛśāparotpattivipralabdhairna smaryata iti
na tu yadyekasmin kṣaṇesyāpratibhāsaḥ kathamakṣaṇikasya pratibhāsaḥ pratikṣaṇamapratibhāsanāt
utpadyamānasya ca bhāvasya pūrvāpararūpaviviktasya pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇāt kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvagrahaḥ

nāpyakṣaṇikaḥ pratīyate pūrvāparakālayorapratibhāsādeva tatsambandhitayedānīṃ pratyakṣe'pratibhāsanāt pūrvakālasambandhisvabhāvasyedānīmapratibhāsa eva vināśo'nyasvabhāvasya pratibhāsa evotpāda iti kathamucyate pūrvottarakṣaṇānāṃ vināśotpādāpratibhāsanād akṣaṇika iti
nāpyanekakṣaṇarūpa idānīntanaḥ kālonekakṣaṇasambhave gṛhītādirūpatā'sya syāt na vyarthatā
nanu yadi nityaṃ sadṛśa iti pratyakṣeṇa niścayaḥ syātsa evāyamiti buddhirbhrāntiryāvatā sarvadā sa evāyamiti pratītirdṛḍharūpotpadyata iti kathaṃ bhrāntistadāha bhaṭṭaḥ
nityaṃ sadṛśa eveti yatra rūḍhā matirbhavet
iha nityaṃ sa eveti vijñānaṃ jāyate dṛḍhaṃ
yato na yāvadaprāmāṇyamasyāstāvannānumānasyotthānaṃ yāvacca nānumānotthānantāvannāsyā aprāmāṇyamanyonyāśrayadoṣa iti
anayośca bhedo na ca kathaṃcidabhedo varttamāna kālabhāvirūpaikasvabhāvatvād vastunaḥ
tasmād bheda eva pratyabhijñāne sati bhāsata iti kathamanena kṣaṇikatvānumānabādhā
sattve vāsya varttamānakālasambandhitvameva syānna pūrvakālasambandhitvaṃ virodhādityuktaṃ
tasmāt pūrvakālasambandhitvasyāsato grāhakaḥ sa iti jñānāṃśo bhrānto'nyathā vastunaḥ spaṣṭabālādyavasthā grāhakaḥ syānna ca bhavati
tasmād bhrāntāt pūrvadṛṣṭarūpāropeṇa sa evāyamiti jñānāt kathamanumānabādhā
nāpi tadabhedena tatkathaṃ pūrvottarakālāstitvayoraikyagrāhakaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt
yadā ca bālādyavasthāyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ vṛddhāvasthāyāṃ pratyabhijñāyate
na tatra vā pratyabhijñāne nityatvaṃ pratibhāsate
tataśca ta evāmī keśā iti pratyabhijñā sadṛśāparotpattinimittaivāta eva bhrāntiḥ
nāpītaretarāśrayatvaṃ yato nānumānena pratyabhijñāyā aprāmāṇyaṃ kriyate'pi tu jñāyate svahetuta evāpramāṇarūpāyā niṣpatteḥ
nāpyasyā aprāmāṇyanimittamanumānasyotthānamapi tu sādhyapratibandhanimittamataḥ pratyabhijñāyā bādhakaṃ
vistarastvayaṃ pratyabhijñābhaṅgavicāro nai rā tmya si ddhau kṛta iti tatraivāvadhāryaḥ
tāṃ punaḥ kṣaṇasthitidharmatāṃ svabhāvampaśyannapi sadṛśāparotpattivipralabdhaḥ pūrvakṣaṇavināśāviniścayānna vyavasyatīti
kathaṃ punargamyate sadṛśāparotpattyā vipralabdho na vyavasyatītyata āha
sadṛśakṣaṇāntarāpratisandhāyī kṣaṇo'ntyakṣaṇastaddarśināṃ naṣṭa iti niśca yāt
avagamyate prāgapyayampratikṣaṇameva naśyati kevalaṃ yathoktādeva vipralambhahetorna niścīyate
na brūmontyakṣaṇadarśanamātrānniścayo bhavatīti kintvantyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā paścād vi bhavati
evamparasparasahitau pratyakṣānupalambhāvabhimateṣveva kāraṇeṣvasandigdhaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ sādhyata iti
tacceti yathoktaṃ kāryalakṣaṇaṃ dhūmesti tasmādagnereva dhūmo bhavati
sarvakālaṃ cāgnisannidhāne bhavato dhūmasyānagnijanyatvaṃ kadācitsadasatorajanyatvā dahetutvādadṛśyahetutvādvocyate
tatra na tāvat prathamaḥ pakṣa iti tṛ tī ye pa ri cche de aśaktaṃ sarvamiti cedi tyatrāntare pra0 vā0 3
adṛśyasyāyaṃ svabhāvo yadagnyādisannidhāna eva dhūmaṃ karpūrādidāhakāle sugandhādiyuktaṃ ca karoti nānyadeti
dhūmotpattikāle cāgniḥ sarvadā pratīyamānopi kākatālīyanyāyenāvasthita ityalaukikoyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ
athavā sa evādṛśyasya svabhāvo yadyagninā nopakriyate tatkimagnyādisannidhāna eva dhūmaṃ karoti na pūrvanna paścāt
tasmādagnyādisannidhāna evāsvabhāvo dhūmajanako bhavati nānyadeti tatrāpi pāramparyeṇa dhūmasyāgnijanyatvameva syāt
yathā deśakālādikamantareṇa dhūmasyānutpattestadapekṣā pratīyate tathā sarvadāgnimantareṇānutpattidarśanādagnyapekṣā'sya kena vāryeta
yathā cādṛśyabhāva eva dhūmasya bhāvāttajjanyatvamiṣyate tathā sarvakālamagnibhāve bhāvadarśanādagnijanyatvaṃ kinneṣyate
yāvatāṃ ca sannidhāna evotpadyamāno bhāvo dṛśyate tāvatāmeva hetutvaṃ sarveṣāṃ prāgbhāvasya tulyatvāt
bhavatvagnidhūmayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvatastathāpi na tayorekena jñānena grahaṇambhinnakālatvāt
nāpyanena pūrvakeṇa hi nirvikalpakena pūrvakamvastu mātraṃ gṛhītaṃ na tu kāraṇarūpaṃ kāryasya bhāvitvenāpratyakṣatvāt
uttareṇāpyuttaramvastumātraṃ gṛhyate na tu kāryarūpaṃ kāraṇasyātītatvenāgrahāt
tenedamasmādutpannamiti na kenacid gṛhītamata eva na smaraṇenāpi gṛhyatenubhavābhāvāditi
kevalamasyedaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ceti kalpitoyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ
tena hetoḥ sakāśāt svarūpalābha eva kāryatvaṃ

kāraṇasyāpi kāryaṃ prati prāgbhāva eva kāraṇatvaṃ sa cātmalābhaḥ prāgbhāvaśca bhāvasyābhinnatvāt pratyakṣagṛhīta eva ceti kathaṃ na pratyakṣa grāhyaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kevalaṃ kāryadarśane satīdamasya kāryakāraṇaṃ ceti vyavahriyate
nāpi kāryakāraṇabhāvayogāttayoḥ kāryakāraṇatā'bhinnā karttuṃ śakyate virodhāt
svarūpeṇa kāryakāraṇayorapi kiṃ kārya kāraṇabhāvenārthāntareṇa kalpitena svarūpeṇaiva kāryakāraṇarūpatvāt
tena pūrvake vastuni gṛhyamāṇe kāryaṃpratyānantaryakāraṇātmakaṃ gṛhītameva
uttareṇa ca jñānenottaramvastu kāraṇānantaraṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ kāryātmakameva gṛhyate
a vi ddha ka rṇṇa stvāha
avinābhāvitvaṃ ekaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyādidarśane sati sidhyati
nanvevamapi kṣaṇānāmaniścayena kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayo na ca santānena tanniścayastasya santānibhyo bhinnasyābhāvāt kevalaṃ santānina eva pūrvāparakālabhāvinaḥ
tatra ca yadaikaḥ kṣaṇo na tadānya iti ekakṣaṇāvabhāsa eveti kathaṃ santānāvabhāsaḥ

ekaparamāṇvātmakasya vastuno bhāvāt sthūlātmanāṃ santānināṃ nairantaryapratibhāsa eva santānapratibhāsastatra ca kṣaṇavivekānavadhāraṇena sādṛśyena caikatvādhyavasāyādekasantativartināṃ kṣaṇānāṃ na kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayaḥ
bhinnasantānavartināṃ tu santānapravṛttyā vijātīyatvād bhavati tanniścayastenāgnisantānapūrvakasya dhūmasantānasya pratīteragnidhūmasantānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścaya ucyata iti yatkiñcidetat
svalakṣaṇayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇe sati kathaṃ sāmānyayorgamyagamakabhāvo bhinnatvāditi
sāmānyaviṣayaṃ proktaṃ liṅgaṃ bhedāpratiṣṭhiteriti || pra0 sa0
tena svalakṣaṇānāṃ sambandhagraha eva sāmānyānāṃ sambandhagraho na tvanyaḥ
nanvanumānavādinā bau ddhe na yāvanti svalakṣaṇāni trailokye
tāni sarvāṇyagni- vyāptāni gṛhītavyānyekasyāpyagrahīte naivānaikāntiko hetuḥ syāt
na caivaṃ pratyakṣaṃ karttuṃ śaknoti sannihitaviṣayatvāt
yathātra tathānyatrāpi deśā dāvetad rūpamagnijanyameveti cāvadhārayatyanyathātrāgnisambandhitayā na pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate
na ca sarvatra deśādāvāgnisambaddhadhūmavyaktiviśiṣṭasya dhūmasāmānyasya grahaṇaṅkenacit pramāṇena sambhavati
tasmāt sāmānyavyāptigrahaṇavādinopi kathaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ dhūmasāmānyaṃ sarvatrāgninā vyāptaṃ pratipannamiti tulyaṃ codyaṃ
atha dhūmasyānyatrāgnijanyatve na kiṃcid bādhakamasti tadevedamiti ca pratītestatsāmānyampratipannamiṣyate'smākamapi tadevedamiti pratyayasyotpattestatpratipannamiṣyata ityāvayoḥ ko bheda iti
yadvā sa dhūmognisambandhitayā pratītastadabhāvegnyabhāve bhavan hetumattāmagnisambandhitayā na pratyakṣeṇa pratīyeta
tasmāt sakṛdapi na kevalaṃ bhūyastathādarśanādityanantaroktāt pratyakṣānupalambhāta
etena vyāptiḥ kathitā bhavati ca dhūmognimantareṇa vyabhicāravādinaḥ
taditi tasmādagnimantareṇa bhāvānna taddheturnāgnihetustathā cāhetuḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ
tadabhāvepyanyakāraṇābhāvepi punaragnau bhavatīti tadapyanyatkāraṇaṃ na hetuḥ syāt
api ca yosau vahniryacca tatonyatkāraṇantatkiṃ dhūmajananasvabhāvamāhosvinna
yadyajananasvabhāvantadā kathantatogneranyato vā śakramūrddhāderatajjananasvabhāvatvāt adhūmajananasvabhāvāddhūmo bhavannaiva bhavet
atha dhūmajananasvabhāvonyastadā dvayorapi vahnitvaṃ dhūmajananasvabhāvalakṣaṇatvād vahneḥ
athavāgnijanito dhūmaḥ sa evānyato bhavatītyevaṃ nocyate
yadi sa evānyataḥ syād bhavedahetutvantādṛśasya vahnijanitadharmasvabhāvatulyasyānyato bhāvāt
anyādṛśādityādi si ddhā nta vā dī
tatkiṃ kāryasadṛśaṃ kāraṇamiṣyate yenaivamucyatenyādṛśād bhavan kathantādṛśa iti
yo hi dhūmajanako vahnirdṛṣṭastato visadṛśād bhavan dhūmaḥ kathantādṛśo bhavati vahnijanitadharmatulyasvabhāvo bhavati
yathā dhūmabhedānāntārṇṇaparṇṇādīnāṃ parasparāpekṣayā tādṛśatvantathāgnibhedānāmapi tārṇṇapārṇṇādīnāṃ dhūmajanakānāntādaśatvaṃ parasparāpekṣayaiva
tena yādṛśo dhūmabheda ekasmādagnibhedādutpadyamāno dṛṣṭastādṛśasya dhūmabhedasya tādṛśādevāgnibhedādutpattiḥ
nanvagnijanyena dhūmakṣaṇena tādṛśo dhūmakṣaṇajanyo dhūmakṣaṇastenānyādṛśādapi tādṛśo bhavatīti cet
agnijanyasya hi dhumakṣaṇasyāgnijanya evānyo dhūmakṣaṇastādṛśo bhavati nānyaḥ
dhūmakṣaṇajanyasyāpi dhūmakṣaṇasyānyo dhūmakṣaṇajanya eva dhūmakṣaṇastādṛśo bhavati nānyaḥ
śakramūrdhnastathā tasya kena vāryeta sambhava iti
prathamasya hyagnijanyasya dhūmakṣaṇasyāparognijanya eva dhūmakṣaṇastādṛśo dhūmakṣaṇajanyasya dhūmakṣaṇasya dvitīyasyānyo dhūmakṣaṇajanya eva dvitīyo dhūmakṣaṇastādṛśo bhavati
anyādṛśādapyavahnisadṛśādapi yadi tādṛśo bhaved vahnijanitadhūmatulyasvabhāvo bhavet
sadṛśāsadṛśayoḥ kāraṇayoryā śaktistasyā yo niyamaḥ sadṛśī sadṛśameva janayatyasadṛśī vilakṣaṇamiti tasyābhāvāt kāraṇānna hetubhedaḥ kāryasya bhedaka iti kṛtvā'kāraṇamviśvasya vaiśvarūpyaṃ syāt
yata utpadyamāno dhūmo dṛṣṭaḥ sa dṛṣṭākāro vahniḥ
tathā cetyahetukatve sati nityaṃ sattvamasattvamvā dhūmasya syāt
niṣpannasya tvasti svabhāvaḥ kevalaṃ saiva niṣpattiḥ kathaṃ kvacid bhavatīti codyate
tadāpi ceti dṛṣṭakālepi dhūmo na bhavet
yasmāt kāryasya yau bhāvābhāvakālau tayoryathākramantadbhāvasya kāryotpādasya ye yogyatāyogyate tābhyāṃ yogāt
dvāvapi tau kāryabhāvābhāvakālau kāryavantau syātāṃ yogyatāsādṛśyāt
yata evamahetutve nityaṃ sattvāsattvaṃ syānna ca bhavati
yadi nāma kvacid deśādau vṛttastathāpi kathantatsāpekṣa iti cedāha
tena tu deśādinā na tasyopakāraḥ kriyata iti cedāha
tasminnaiva deśādau tena na bhāvyamiti niyamāyogāt
yathoktena pratyakṣeṇa yeṣāṃ sannidhāne dṛṣṭasteṣāmevānyataravaikalye ca punarna dṛṣṭaḥ
anyatheti yadi tajjanyosya svabhāvo na syāt
yasmāt tajjanito hyagnijanito hi svabhāvaviśeṣo dhūma iti
yadi tasya dhūmasyāgneranyatopi bhāva iṣyate tadā na sa dhūmajananaḥ svabhāvastasyāvahneḥ
tathā hyanagneryadā dhūmasyotpattistadānagnereva dhūmajananaḥ svabhāvo jātaḥ
tayā dhūmajanikayā śaktyā karaṇabhūtayā vastvantarāt khadyotāderbhedavān visadṛśaḥ
adhūmahetorityavahnisvabhāvād dhūmasya bhāve utpāde'bhyupagamyamāne sa dhūmaḥ syādahetukaḥ
evañca sati cakṣuḥsvabhāvādapyutpadyate vijñānamacakṣuḥsvabhāvādapi rūpamanaskārāderna cedamahetukaṃ
cakṣurādiṣu tatsvabhāvaṃ janakasvabhāvaṃ sadekaikaṃ parasparānapekṣaṃ na vai janakaṃ
yadi hi syāt tadā pratyekaṃ kāraṇavyabhicārādahetukaṃ syāt
sāmagrī janiketyetāvataiva tatsvabhāvatvaṃ labdhamatatsvabhāvasyājanakatvāt tatkiṃ svabhāveti pṛthagucyate
svahetusāmarthyaniyatasannidhītyekasmin kārye samastāvanye kāraṇāni heturiti samudāyārthaḥ
atra tu vāśabdasya na kiṃcit prayojanamitya pa pāṭha evāyaṃ
yadi sāmagrītyuktvā sāmagryantarādapi cakṣurvijñānaṃ syāttadā bhinnādutpāderahetukatvambhavet
kāryeṇa na pratyekaṃ kāraṇādanyato nāsti vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ
syādetada agnyādisāmagrayā ādya eva dhūmakṣaṇo janito na ca tasya liṅga tvantasyāniścayāt
na ca tenārthakriyārthinaḥ kiṃcit prayojanamityetadapi codyamānenaiva parihṛtaṃ
saiva ca sāmagrī prabandhena pravarttamānā kāryasvabhāvasthiteḥ kāryaprabandhavṛtterhetuḥ pūrvapūrvamagnyādikṣaṇaṃ pratītyottarottarasya dhūmakṣaṇasyotpatteḥ
na hyayaṃ niyamo yadeka eva dhūmakṣaṇogninā janyo nāpara iti

dharmaśabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktaṃ dharmamiva pradarśya punarddhamiśabdena saṃcodyāparaṃ svabhāvaṃ dharmitayā vyavasthāpya tadeva bāhyaṃ vastu pradarśyate

tathābhūtānāmpratikṣiptabhedāntarāṇāṃ dharmabhedānāmbāhulyacodanayā vacanabhedaḥ sādhyasādhanabhedaśca kriyata iti sambandhaḥ
tasya tatastato vyāvṛttasya vastunaḥ svabhāvaḥ samāśrayo yeṣāntairddharmapratibhāsabhedairvikalpabuddhiprativimbairddharmātmakaiḥ pratibhāsabhedairityarthaḥ
tasyaiva vyāvṛttasya vastusvabhāvasya pratipattaye prāptaye vā
tasya vastusvabhāvasyānubhavādūrddhvaṃ yā dhīḥ prajñāyate vikalpikā
yataśca buddhipratibhāsi rūpannistattvamatastadviṣayo vyavahāro mithyārtha eva pravarttate ityāha
jñānaviśiṣṭā iti vikalpabuddhyārūḍhāste jñānaviśiṣṭāssantaḥ yato vijātīyād vyāvṛttirūpiṇo vyāvṛttirūpavantaḥ
tenetyantato vyāvṛttirūpeṇotpalatvenābhinnā ivābhānti na paramārthato buddhirūpasyālīkatvāt
ta eva jñānaviśiṣṭā arthā anyato vyāvṛttirūpiṇaḥ santaḥ punaranyataḥ sajātīyādapi vyāvṛttā bhānti
teṣāmiti buddhipratibhāsināmarthānāṃ vyavahāraḥ pratanyata iti sambandhaḥ

yadyapi śabdajñānātmaka eveha vyavahārastathāpi savyāpāratāmupādāya jñānaśabdayoḥ karaṇarūpatā
sa ca sarvaḥ jñānābhidhānalakṣaṇo vyavahāraḥ padārthānāṃ svalakṣaṇānāṃ yonyonyābhāvaḥ parasparavyacchedastatsaṃśrayaḥ
tenetyanyonyābhāvasaṃśrayatvena sa vyavahāronyāpohaviṣaya ucyate na tvanyavyāvṛttiviṣayatvāt
vastulābhasya ca vastuprāpteścāśrayo na bhavati vyavahāraḥ
na ca sarvaḥ kintu yatra vyavahāre'sti pāramparyeṇa tathābhūtavastusambandhaḥ

yadi sāmānyabuddhiḥ sāmānyākārā sa eva pāramārthikantarhi sāmānyambhaviṣyatītyāha
tenāyamartho yathoktena prakāreṇa svalakṣaṇātmakād bhedādabhedinonyaḥ pratibhāsamāna ākāro rtheṣu nāsti kintu svalakṣaṇātmaka eva bhedo vijātīyavyāvṛtterabhedī sarvatra vidyate'bhedādhyavasāyāt
abhedādhyavasāyasya ca sa eva bhedaḥ pāramparyeṇa nimittaṃ
nanu buddhāvabhinnākāraḥ pratibhāsate kathamartheṣu nāstītyucyata ityāha
sa hi vikalpapratibhasyākāro niḥsvabhāvastattvā nyatvena paramārthato vyavasthāpayitumaśakyatvāditi saṃpratyevoktatvāt
tatreti bhinnāsu vyaktiṣu tata eva sāmānyāttulyākārād buddhiriti na tulyaṃ codyaṃ
nanvityādi si ddhā nta vā dī
tatra vyaktiṣu tasya sāmānyasya satoṣyā bhāsa ākāro na lakṣyate
īdṛśamiti varṇṇasaṃsthānākāraṃ guṇatvād varṇṇasaṃsthānādeḥ sāmānyasya ca guṇavyatirekāt
evaṃ tāvad bhinnaṃ sāmānyaṃ nirākṛtyābhinnaṃ nirācikīrṣannāha
svalakṣaṇānāmātmabhūtameva sādṛśyamākṛtistadeva sāmānyantasya vādaḥ sa yasyāsti
tadvā vadituṃ śīlaṃ yasya sāṃ khya sya sa tathā
viśeṣavat svalakṣaṇavat tasya sāmānyasya svalakṣaṇādavyatirekāddhetorarthāntare dvitīyādivyaktiṣvavṛttiḥ
iti hetostadapi sāmānyaṃ svalakṣaṇameva jātantato bhedāddhetorvidyamānasya nābhinnaḥ pratibhāso yujyate vyaktiṣvityadhyāhāraḥ
tadevamu dyo ta ka rā dyabhihitamabhinnapratibhāsamabhyupagamya vyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya ca sāmānyasyāyogād bhrāntirevāyaṃ vyaktiṣvekākārapratibhāsa ityuktaṃ
nanu samānā iti grahe satyekapratibhāsaḥ kasmānna yujyata evetyata āha
kintarhi tadeveti yatpūrvadṛṣṭantadevedandṛśyata ityevaṃ syānna tu pūrveṇedaṃ samānamiti bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt samānavyavahārasya
yadi sāmānyameva kevalantābhirbuddhibhirgṛhyate tadā bhavedayaṃ doṣaḥ
kintu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaśca dvayamapi sāmānyabuddhyā gṛhyate
yatastenaiva sāmānyena yuktā viśeṣāḥ samānā iti gṛhyanta iti
tat sāmānyaṃ yatpūrvaṃ vyaktau dṛṣṭantadiha vyaktyantare dṛśyata ityevaṃ syānna tu samāna iti vyaktibhya ekāntabhinnatvāt sāmānyasya
tadevetyarthāntarabhūtaṃ gotvādikaṃ tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ sāmyaṃ yena tāssamānā iti cet
anyaḥ sāmānyāt sā'nyasya svalakṣaṇasya kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa sāmyaṃ
tathā hi vyaktirūpānukārāt sāmānyaṃ vyaktīnāṃ sāmyaṃ kalpyeta
na hi vyaktirūpānukārādinā sāmyaṃ kintu tatsambandhāt
samavāyalakṣaṇena sambandhena sambandhāt sāmānyasya sāmyebhyupagamyamāne'tiprasaṃgaḥ saṃkhyāsaṃyogakāryadravyāṇāmapi sāmānyarūpatā syāt
samānā iti grahaṇād vyaktiṣu pratibhāsabhedaḥ sādhyate
yasmāt samāścetā vyaktayaḥ kathambhinnadhīgrāhyā eveti sāvadhāraṇaṃ
tathā hi yatra kiñcit sāmānyaṃ kaścicca viśeṣastatra samānā iti grahaṇaṃ yuktamanyathā ghaṭapaṭādivadabhedapratibhāsaḥ syānna samānā iti
tadevaṃ sādhāraṇā'sādhāraṇarūpagrahaṇād vyaktayaḥ samānā gṛhyanta iti samudāyārthaḥ
sāmānyātmakatvād viśeṣāṇāṃ samānā iti pratibhāsa iti cet
na ca sāmānyāt teṣāṃ samānarūpatā yujyata ityuktaṃ
sāmānyamantareṇāpi svahetubhya eva gavādīnāṃ samānāmutpatteryadi nāma sārūpyamarthāntarabhūtaṃ neṣyate sarūpāstviṣyanta eva te
evaṃrūpāśca yena bhavantyaśvādayaste sarve'viśeṣeṇāgorūpatayā niṣidhyanta iti na kācit kṣatiḥ
ā cā ryastu na nāma svahetubhyaḥ samānā utpannāstathāpi na sāmānyabalāt samānā iti pratītiri ti darśayannāha
ekakāryataiva sādṛśyaṃ sāmyaṃ tenaiva samānā vyaktayaḥ pratīyanta ityarthaḥ
tenaikakāryatā sādṛśyaṃ yeṣānta evāpohaviṣayā yeṣāṃ tvekakāryatā nāsti te'pohyā iti siddhaṃ
yathā caikāntabhinnā apyekakārya kurvanti tathoktaṃ prāk
tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ dhīḥ kāryaṃ sā ca vibhidyata ityetāvān kārikābhāgaḥ
nānubhavajñānenaikakāryāḥ vyaktayaḥ kintu yattadvikalpakameka rūpādhyāropeṇa tadapekṣayetyata āha
taddhyanubhavajñānantāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ kāryaṃ na vikalpavijñānantasya vyaktyabhāvepi bhāvāt
tasyaiva ca vikalpasya samānā ityevamutpadyamānasya vyaktiṣu kiṃ sāmyaṃ
dravyasya dravyasya yo bhedastasmād bhedāt kāraṇabhedād bhidyata iti yāvat
ekapratyavamarśasyeti svaviṣayasyaikākārapratyayasya hetutvād dhīrnirvikalpikā savikalpikā vā'bhedinī bhāti
pratyekaṃ yadyapi vyaktisvarūpagrāhiṇyo dhiyo bhinnāsta- thāpi pratyabhijñayā tāsāmekatvamadhyavasīyate
atha tāḥ svabhāvata ekatvāvasāyaṃ janayanti vyaktayopyevambhaviṣyantīti kimekakāryatāsādṛśyena
tāmbhrāntimbhedinaḥ padārthā vyāvṛttāni svalakṣaṇāni krameṇa janayanti na sākṣāt
krameṇeti yaduktantasya vyākhyānaṃ vikalpahetavo bhavanta iti
sa tveṣāmityādinā kā ri kā rthamāha
sa cākāro bhedonyāpoha ityucyate na sāmānyaṃ
tathābhūtetyādinā vyaktīnāmapi vikalpaṃ prati pāramparyeṇa kāraṇatvamāha
abhedāvasāyo vidyate yasmiṃstasya jñānāde rityanubhavajñānasyodakādyāharaṇādeścārthasya hetutvāt kāraṇāt krameṇa vyaktayopyekaṃ pratyayaṃ janayantīti sambandhaḥ
saṃsṛṣṭo vyaktiṣvāropita eka ākāro yena sa tathā
svabhāvabhedonyavyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ sa eva paramārthonupacarito'syeti vigrahaḥ
nanu ca tāntu bhedinaḥ padārthā ityādinā'yamartho'nantaramevoktaḥ
kintu krameṇa vikalpahetavo bhavanta ityādyasyaivārtho'nena sphuṭīkṛtaḥ
atatkāryebhyo viśleṣo vyāvṛtta eva svabhāvo na vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ
kiṃ kāraṇantadanyasya svalakṣaṇādanyasyānuvarttinonvayino vastuno vyaktivyatirekeṇādṛṣṭeḥ pratiṣedhācca pūrvoktāt
sati vā sāmānye nityatvādanādheyātiṣayatvena kvacid vyaktyantare anāśritaṃ kathaṃ jñānahetuḥ
sarvaścārambhaḥ phalārtha iti vidirlābhārthopyākṣipta evānyathā saṃketakaraṇasya vaiyarthyāt
nanu tadvidartho yasyeti bahubrīhiṇā bhavitavyaṃ lāghavāt
tathā ca bhāṣya uktaṃ karmadhārayād bahuvrīhirbhavatītyādi
idamapi tatroktaṃ kvacitkarmadhāraya eva sarvasādhanādyartha iti
anyonyaṃ vivekonyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvo bhāvānānta tpratītaye tanniścayārthaṃ svapratibhāse'dhyavasitabāhyarūpe saṃketopi kriyamāṇaḥ śobheta yuktiyuktatvāt
vivakṣitārthakriyākāriṇo ye na bhavanti teṣāṃ vivekena parihāreṇa pravṛttyarthatayā
tasyānyaparihārasya pratītyartho yadi na saṃketastatkāriṇī tadanyaparihārasya vyavahārakālepyasaṃsparśāt
yadvā yadi na tatpratītyarthaḥ saṃketa iti vijātīyavyāvṛttasvabhāva pratītyarthaḥ saṃketaḥ
tadā tasyānyavyāvṛttasya svabhāvasya vyavahārakālepi na kevalaṃ saṃketakāle'saṃsparśācchabdenāviṣayīkaraṇānnānyaparihāreṇa pravartteta
yadi hi tasya viviktasya svabhāvasya pratītaye saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ syādevaṃ vyavahārepi śabdena codyeta
tathā cānyaparihāreṇa pravartteteti saṃketopi tadvidarthika eva yuktaḥ
nanu ca śabdajanitā buddhiḥ svākārameva bāhyatayādhyasya grahaṇādalīkā
tataśca tajjanakasya śabdasya kathamvastusamvādaḥ kathaṃ cānyāpohaviṣayatvamityata āha
tatkāri tulyarūpeṇārthakriyākāri bāhyaikarūpeṇāvabhāsodhyavasāya iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ sa yasyā vidyata iti paścāt matvarthīyaḥ
vastūnāmpṛthagbhāva itaretarabhedastanmātraṃ bījaṅkāraṇaṃ pāramparyeṇa yasyāḥ sā tathoktā
yataścānugataṃ rūpaṃ vyāvṛttaṃ caikīkṛtya gṛhṇātyatonarthikāṃ janayantyapi śrutirarthe na visamvādikā
yadyanyavyāvṛttavastvadhyavasāyinīṃ buddhiṃ janayecchrutistadā tadanyavyāvṛtta eva svalakṣaṇe puruṣaṃ pravarttayatīti samvādikā syāt
saṃketakāle ca śruteritaretarabhinna eva svabhāva āśrayastatrāsyāḥ saṃketitatvāt
vyavahārakāle saṃketakāle ca vastubhedāśrayadvāreṇa pravṛttestasminnapohe śruterāśritabhāvaḥ
tathā hyanityakṛtakādiśrutayo yathābhūtasya nityādivyāvṛttasya vastuno vyāvṛttimupādāya saṃketitatvād vyavahārepi tathā bhūtasyānyaparihārāṅgabhāvena prāptihetavo bhavanti

yadvā yathābhūte vyavacchede sā śrutiḥ saṃketitā tasya paramārthatosti vastuṣu sadbhāva itīyatā leśenāvisamvāditvaṃ na tu dhūmādivacchabdānāmāvaśyako vastuni pratibandhasteṣāmicchāmātrapratibaddhatvāt
teṣu bhāveṣu sa vyatireko vyavacchedo bhūtaḥ satyaḥ
ekaḥ sāmānyapadārtho vyaktervyatirikto vai śe ṣi kā dīnāmavyatiriktaḥ sāṃ khyā nāṃ na teṣu bhūta iti sambandhaḥ
yadi punaryathā pratibhāsamapi sāmānyaṃ śabdena codyeta tadā tasya sāmānyasya vastunyavidyamānasya samāveśane śabdena viṣayīkaraṇe
tasya vā sāmānyasya pramāṇabādhitasya vastuni bāhye niveśane'bhyupagamyamāne dūrotsṛṣṭamevātyantaviprakṛṣṭameva vastu syāt
vijātīyavyāvṛtteṣvartheṣu vyāvṛttibhedamvijātīyavyacchinnasvabhāvamaviśeṣeṇopādāya vijātīyavyāvṛttamātraṃ rūpamāśritya sajātīyavyaktiṣu śabdasya niveśanāt saṃketakaraṇādityarthaḥ
anya- parihāreṇa pravarttanādityanyāpohaṃ prati karttṛbhāvaḥ śruteruktaḥ
anyāpohavādinaḥ kila na vidhirūpeṇa vṛkṣārthasya grahaṇaṃ nāpyavṛkṣārthasya
evaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣayormadhye ekasya vṛkṣasyāvṛkṣasya vā grahābhāve dvayāgrahaḥ
yataśca dvayorapyagrahastasmāt kāraṇādanyavyavacchinnerthe śabdasya yaḥ saṃketa uktastasyāsambhava iti kecidācakṣate
tathā cāho dyo ta ka raḥ
sa yāvaccāgānna pratipadyate tāvadagavi pratipattirna yuktā
gavyasiddhe tvagaurnāsti tadabhāvepi gauḥ kuta iti
tatra vidhirūpeṇaiva saṃketa iti te manyante
avijñāto vṛkṣo yasya puṃsastena tadvyavacchedarūpasyeti vṛkṣavyavacchedarūpasya buddhāvanārūḍhertha iti
yadi vṛkṣāvṛkṣau buddhāvārūḍhau syātāṃ tadā'vṛkṣaparihāreṇa vṛkṣe saṃketaḥ syāt
anārūḍhe ca vṛkṣe'vṛkṣe cārthe kathaṃ saṃketaḥ
tataśca yastasya parihāro mamāpi sa eveti bhāvaḥ
anyavyavacchedena saṃkete kriyamāṇe ye vādina ekamvastu sāmānyamabhyugamyetaretarāśrayadoṣaṃ codayanti
teṣāntatrāpi vastubhūte sāmānye vṛkṣatvalakṣaṇe saṃkete kriyamāṇe dvayī kalpanā avṛkṣā vyavacchinnā na veti
ye tu prākśabdaṃ kā ri kā yāṃ paṭhanti tairarthaśabdo na paṭhitavyaḥ
na ca vṛkṣaniścayamantareṇa vṛkṣārthagraho yuktastasyāpi vṛkṣagrahaṇapūrvakatvāt
sa ca vṛkṣāvṛkṣa majānānaḥ kathamavṛkṣavyavacchedaṃ pratipadyeta saṃkete
avṛkṣavyavacchedāpratipattau ca satyāmaparihṛto na vyavacchinnastadanyastasmād vṛkṣādanyo yasmin vṛkṣārthe so parihṛtatadanyastasminniveśassaṃketaḥ
tasmādevaṃbhūtād vṛkṣaśabdād vyavahāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ vyavahārakāle tatparihāreṇāvṛkṣaparihāreṇa niyate śākhādimati pravṛttirna syāt
na hi vṛkṣaśabdāt prakaraṇādirahitād vṛkṣaviśeṣe khadirādau tadanyavṛkṣaparihāreṇa pravṛttirbhavati
saṃketakālaḥ saṃketaśabdenoktaḥ parārthavyavacchedeneti parasmādavṛkṣād vṛkṣād vṛkṣārthasyāvyavacchedena
śiṃśapādaya eva bhedā iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ vatiḥ saptamyarthe
śiṃśapādayo hi bhedā vṛkṣasya bhedā bhavantītyanurūpaiva vṛttiḥ teṣu ca yathā vṛkṣaśabdānna parasparavyavacchedena pravṛttistathā sūtravibhāga eva vyākhyātaṃ
pratiṣedhapūrvakaṃ vidhimakṛtvā vidhimātrameva kevalaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ ata
eva pradarśyaikamiti vṛttāvapi na kasyacid vyavacchedena kiṃcid vidhīyata ityanyaniṣedhapūrvakameva vidhānaṃ pratiṣedhati
etena sāmānye saṃketakaraṇāt sarvavyaktiṣu kṛta ityācaṣṭe
yadvastu pradarśya saṃketaḥ kṛtastat pratipadyate vyavahārepi
tathā dṛṣṭamevārthamiti sāmānyaṃ yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ
tatrāpīti vidhinā kevalenāpi saṃkete kriyamāṇe dvau vikalpau vṛkṣoyamiti saṃketaṃ kurvāṇaḥ tarurayamapīti vidadhīta
ādye pakṣe tarutvamanyasyāpyaniṣiddhamiti vyavahāre niyamena pravṛttirna syāditi sa eva prasaṅgaḥ
tataśca saṃketakāle pratipadyamānena kathaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣau jñātāviti tadavasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ

ekaṃ hi kiṃcit sāmānyaṃ vṛkṣatvādikampaśyatonyatra tatsāmānyarahite vilakṣaṇe vastuni tadākāravivekinīṃ yathā paridṛṣṭākāravilakṣaṇākārāmbuddhimanubhavataḥ puṃso yathānubhavantato yathā paridṛṣṭādanyadityevaṃrūpo vaidharmyaniścayo vailakṣaṇyaniścayaḥ
tadvivecana iti vyāpāraḥ pūrvadṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthavivecanaḥ pṛthagbhāvasya vyavasthāpayati
tatraitasmin krame sati yathānubhavamvaidharmyaniścayavān sa pratipattā
taṃ purodhāyāyameva vṛkṣa iti pradarśya vyutpāditaḥ saṃketaṃ grāhito
tadevamākārānta- rāt svayameva vivekenāvadhāritaṃ sāmānyātmānamupādāya saṃkete kṛte sarvāsu sajātīyavyaktiṣu kṛto bhavati
ayameveti cāvadhāraṇāt saṃkete kṛte dṛṣṭaviparītasya sujñānatvāt
tatonyatrāvṛkṣa iti niścayo bhavatīti na yathoktadoṣaḥ
ekatra saṃketakāle dṛṣṭasyāsādhāraṇasya rūpasya kvacid vyaktyantare'nanvayādananugamāt
tataśca saṃketakāle yo vṛkṣa ityeva gṛhīto bhedastasyānyatra darśanannāsti
tatra saṃketakāle dṛṣṭe paścād dṛśyamāne ca svalakṣaṇe yad bhinnapratibhāsi darśanamutpannantena hetunā
vṛkṣāvṛkṣayoḥ pratipattau kriyamāṇāyāṃ vyaktyantarepyanyasmin vṛkṣabhedepi na syāttathā vṛkṣa iti pratītiḥ
tathā hi yo vṛkṣabhedaḥ saṃketakāle dṛṣṭastasmād ghaṭādayo vilakṣaṇāstathānyopi vṛkṣabhedaḥ
tatra yathā ghaṭādiṣu vṛkṣa iti pratipattirna bhavati tathā vṛkṣabhedepi na syāt kintvavṛkṣa ityeva pratipattirbhavedityarthaḥ
evantarhītyā cā ryaḥ tatrāpīti vikalpākāropi sāmānye saṃkete kriyamāṇe tulyametaditītaretarāśrayapratividhānaṃ
sarvabhāvāḥ svahetuto bhinnā iti pūrvameva pratipāditaṃ
tena vṛkṣā avṛkṣāśca bhinnā eva nirvikalpake jñāne pratibhāsante
tathā'vṛkṣeṣu vṛkṣaniṣedhenāvṛkṣavikalpa utpadyata iti kuta itaretarāśrayatvaṃ
nanu yadyapi vidhirūpeṇa vṛkṣavikalpasya pratipattistathāpyavṛkṣādivyāvṛttidvāreṇotpadyamānatvādavṛkṣādipratipattyapekṣatvantataśca sa evetaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ
yato'vṛkṣādivyāvṛttirvṛkṣādisvarūpameva tadanubhavadvāreṇaiva vṛkṣādivikalpa utpadyate na tvavṛkṣādipratipattyapekṣa iti kuta itaretarāśrayatvaṃ
tatra vṛkṣavikalpe pratyekaṃ śiṃśapādyabhedena vṛkṣākāro'bhinnaḥ pratibhāsate
sa ca saṃketāt pūrvaṃ svasamvedanapratyakṣasiddhaḥ jñānarūpatvādatastatraiva śabdaḥ saṃketyate
tataśca vikalpavijñānāropitaikatvāsu vyaktiṣu yatra kvacit saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ sarvatra kṛto bhavatītyasya bījamākhyātaṃ
vijātīyapadārthākāravyāvṛttyā sajātīyeṣu sarveṣu yadekapratyavamarśajñānantatra sthita ityarthaḥ
eka śākhādimadākāraparāmarśahetūn tadviparītāṃśca pṛthak karoti svayameva saṃketāt
tānbhāvānayaṃ pratipattā svayameva śabdavyāpāraṃ vinā vibhajya vibhāgaṃ kṛtvā taddhetūnataddhetū~śca pratyeti
tasya pratipattustadbuddhiparivartina ityādi karmapadaṃ pratipadyetetyetat kriyāpadāpekṣaṃ
ataddhetubhyastaddhetūn vibhajya sthāpayati yā buddhiḥ sā
iva śabdasya vakṣyamāṇasya sambandhāddhetutayeveti draṣṭavyaṃ na tu te vikalpapratibhāsino hetavaṃsteṣāṃ bahirasatvāt
atatkāribhyo bhedena tān bhāvān pratipadyeteti kṛtvā
uktiḥ śabdo bhede vijātīyavyāvṛtte svabhāve vikalpena svākārābhedenādhyaste niyujyate saṃketyate
tasyāḥ śruteḥ sakāśād vyavahāre pratiyatī pratipadyamānā paridhīrbhrāntyā ekamvastvivekṣate
