yadvā kimudakādivat surā pātavyā kimvā neti praśne surā na pātavyetyukte suraiveti pratīternodakādipānavidhānaṃ prakṛtanniṣedhyate
paryudāsapratipādakantu vākyaṃ pratiṣedhapūrvakamanyavidhānaṃ prādhānyenāhetyastyeva viśeṣa iti
nanu yadyanyanivṛttirarthāt pratīyate saiva tarhi pāramārthikī bhāvānāmasti yayā viśiṣṭā gṛhyanta ityevaṃ kasmānneṣyate
kiṃ punarevantadgatestadupādhitvāt tadviśiṣṭo gata iti vyākhyāyata ityata āha
yo bhedo vyāvṛttilakṣaṇa ācārya di ṅ nā ge na viśeṣaṇatvenābhimataḥ sa cāyamarūpo niḥsva bhāvaḥ
kathantarhi bhāvānāṃ vijātīyād bheda iti pratītiriti cedāha
rūpavattvena bhāvasambandhitvena tasya bhedasya kevalandarśanampratītirviplavo bhrāntiḥ
kā ri kā yā mapyevaṃ vyākhyānaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ
nanu yadi rūpavattvena darśanaṃ kathaṃ buddhiviplava ityata āha
rūpavattvena bhāvasambandhitvena yaddarśanambhedasya tenaivāparamārtho na vastubhūto'sattvāt
na hi vastunaḥ svalakṣaṇasya sambandhinī vyāvṛttirvastu bhavati
yadi hi sā vastubhūtā syāt tadā vṛkṣebhyo'vṛkṣavyāvṛttirabhinnā bhinnā vā syāt
asmādavṛkṣād vṛkṣasya bheda iti vyatireka- pratītirna syāt
tatrāpyavṛkṣavyāvṛtteḥ sakāśāt palāśasya vyāvṛttiḥ syādavṛkṣavyāvṛtteśca vyāvarttamānasya palāśasyāvṛkṣarūpatā syādavṛkṣavat
tataścāsmādavṛkṣādasya vṛkṣasya bheda iti pratītirna syādiṣyate ca
bhedonyavyāvṛttiryadi rūpaṃ syād yadi svabhāvo bhavet

tādrūpye palāśādanyattve yayā vyāvṛttyā sāmānyabhūtayā sarve vṛkṣabhedāḥ vyāvṛttā dṛṣṭāstasyāstādrūpye palāśādananyatvebhyupagamyamāne tadeva palāśasvalakṣaṇameva vyāvṛttiriti kṛtvā palāśa evāvṛkṣād bhinnaḥ prāpnoti nānyo dhavādiḥ
na ca tasya rūpamanyasya dhavādeḥ syāt
na tadeva palāśasvalakṣaṇameva tasya bhedasya rūpaṃ
ūṣmādityavṛkṣāt tasya palāśasya bheda iti na syāt
mā vā bhūd vṛkṣāvṛkṣayorekatvantathāpi sosya bheda iti ca na syāt
yadi cāyamavṛkṣād bhedaḥ palāśādanyaḥ syāttadayamavṛkṣād bhedosya palāśasya sambandhīti na syāt
anyaḥ svatantronyasya sambandhī bhedo dharmarūpo bhavati
iti heto rūpaṃ vastvantarameva tajjanitantena vyāvṛttimatā svalakṣaṇena janitaṃ bheda iti
pādārthāntarasya nāma kṛtantasmāt kāryatvenābhimatād bhedākhyāt padārthād aviśeṣādanyatrāpi kāraṇānāṃ yāni kāryāṇi tāni sarvāṇi vyāvṛttayo bhedāḥ syuḥ
tadānyatrāpi bhedābhimate bheda iti vyapadeśo mā bhūt
atha kāryaṃ bheda iti nocyate kintu bhedaḥ kārya ityucyate
tataśca palāśasyāvṛkṣād yo bhedastasya bhedasya palāśād bheda iti kṛtvā sa bhedo bhedopādhiḥ sa palāśād bhedaḥ
upādhiviśeṣaṇaṃ yasya bhedasya sa bhedopādhistadbhāvastattvantasmādasāvavṛkṣād bhedaḥ palāśasya na bhedaḥ syāt
yathā hi dravyāntaraṃ ghaṭādika mapyaghaṭāpekṣayā yo bhedastadupādhitvānna palāśasya bhedastadvat
nanu yadi nāmaṃ bhedopādhirbhedastathāpi kimiti palāśasya bhedo na bhavatītyata āha
asya palāśasyāyaṃ bhedo'smādavṛkṣādityevaṃ viśeṣanirdeśāt pāratantryeṇa nirdeśāt palāśasya sambandhī bhedo dharmaḥ sidhyati
pāratantryeṇa ca nirdeśo bhedasyābhede sati sidhyati bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇa
arthāntaratve hi bhedopādhitvād ghaṭavanna palāśasya bhedaḥ syāt
tataścāsmādasya bheda iti viśeṣanirdeśo na syāt
tadevaṃ vyatirekapakṣe'vṛkṣād bhedasyāpi palāśād yo bhedaḥ sopi rūpavāniti tasyāpi svāśrayād bhedena bhavitavyaṃ
tathā ca sarvabhedānāṃ bhinnasvabhāvatayā bhedopādhitvena svayanna rūpabhedateti na kaścid bhedaḥ syāt
upādhyabhāva iti vyāvṛttilakṣaṇasya dharmabhūtasyopādherabhāve sarvasya svabhāvāntaratvena dharmitvād bhedasyaivābhāvaḥ syāt tasya dharmirūpatvāt
yadi rūpavatī vyāvṛttiḥ syāt syāt tattvānyatvapakṣabhāvī doṣo yāvatā nīrūpā sāsti tayā ca bhāvā viśiṣṭā gṛhyanta iti
nīrūpatvādeva ca na tasyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ grāhakaṃ nāpyanumānaṃ
svahetubhya eva ca niyatarūpāṇāmutpannatvāditi sarvabhāvā svabhāvena vyāvṛttibhāgina 1
kathaṃ śabdaviṣayatvantasmā danubhavadvāreṇa vṛkṣo'yaṃ nāvṛkṣa ityevaṃ niścaya utpadyate
nāpi paraparikalpitaṃ sāmānyamevaṃ sati bāhyamvastveva vācyamāpatitaṃ
abhinnasya niraṃśasya vastunaḥ śabdena codane upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat liṃgena pratipādane
tasyaivābhinnasya vastuna ekasmād bhinnasya punaranyatopi bhedāt
tathā hi yena svabhāveṃna na śabdo'kṛtakād bhinnastenaiva mūrttānityatvācca
anaṃśasya ca vastunaḥ kṛtakaśabdenaikasyākṛtakād bhedasya bhinnasya svabhāvasya codane
tathā liṃgena pratipādane sarvabhedagatessarvebhyo bhinnasya svabhāvasya pratipatteḥ
tatrānaṃśe vastuni kathaṃ śabdapramāṇāntarāṇi vyarthāni na syuḥ
ekena śabdena codane śabdāntarāṇāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt
ekena liṅgena pratipādane pramāṇāntarāṇāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt
tasmād yo yena dharmeṇa viśeṣaḥ saṃpratīyata 1
na punarbāhyambuddhyākāro vā kevalaḥ śabdavācyaḥ svalakṣaṇatvāt
tatra svārthābhidhānadvāreṇa samāropavyavacchede śabdapramāṇāntarāṇāṃ sāphalyamiti yāvat
yataśca śabdaḥ svābhidhānadvāreṇa vyavacchedaṃ karoti tataḥ kāraṇāt taṃ taṃ vyavacchedaṃ kurvannānāphalaḥ śabdo bhavatyekādhāraśca
te'nityādiśabdāḥ yathāsaṃketaṃ yasya yasya samāropasya vyavacchedārthaṃ
yato yathāsaṃketaṃ vyāpārastato na hyekaśabdasādhyaṃ vyavacchedamanyaḥ śabdaḥ karoti
nanvadhyavasitabāhyarūpatvācchabdārthasya tataśca śabdenanyalakṣaṇasya sarvātmanā viṣayīkaraṇāt kathaṃ na śabdāntarāṇāmvaiyarthyamityāha na cetyādi
naiva vicchinnaṃ jñānāṃśād bhinnaṃ kiñcid vastu
svalakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇād vyatiriktaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamanyanivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ vākṣipyate gṛhyate śabdena liṅgena vā
yasyābhidhānād vastubaleneti vastugrahe niraṃśatvād vastunaḥ sarvathā gatiḥ syāt
yato buddhyākāramabāhyambāhyamadhyavasyanti śabdāstato vicchinnavastugrāhakā iva bhavantītyarthaḥ
tena śabdo vikalpo vā na svalakṣaṇaviṣayo yathāvadekasyāpi bāhyasya jñānākārasya vā'grahaṇāditi
yadi buddhiviplavaviṣayā eva sarvaśabdāḥ kathaṃ kṛtakānityādiśabdānāntathābhūte vastunyavyabhicāra ityata āha
nānaikadharmabhedābhedā eva buddhau pratibhāsanta iti pratibhāsāsta eva viplavo bhrāntatvāt
iti hetostasya vyavahārasya tatpratibandhe tami~stathābhūte svalakṣaṇe pāramparyeṇotpattipratibandhe sati tadavyabhicāraḥ
yathā hi kṛtakādyākārāḥ śabdā viplavāstathāvastūnāmapi kṛtakādirūpeṇa paramārthatovasthānamityanenākāreṇāvyabhicāro draṣṭavyaḥ
tato buddhiviplavaviṣayācchabdād vyavahārāt parārthānumānalakṣaṇād vitathāditi bhrāntāt
pravṛttasyānte pravṛttiparisamāptau tathābhūta eva kṛtakādirūpa eva vastuni natvakṛtakādirūpe
jñānasamvādāt svalakṣaṇagrāhijñānotpatteḥ śabdasya vā jñānasya samvādāt
asminnevānyāpohe śabdārthe sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sidhyati na tu vastunītyāha
yadi hi bhinnākāraṃ jñānamekavastuviṣayampravartteta tatastadanusāreṇa śabdopi tathā syāt
tathā ca nānāphalaḥ śabda ekādhāra iti bhavetsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tacca nāsti vyāghātāt
tathā hi nīlotpalaśabdayorekaṃ vā vastuvācyaṃ syādanekamvā
ādye pakṣe ekenaiva śabdena niraṃśasya vastunaḥ sarvātmanābhidhānāt
dvitīyasya śabdasyāpravṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttau vā paryāyateti na nānāphalatvaṃ
tathaiva paryāyatā syādatha viśeṣaṇabhedād viśeṣyadravyasya bhedastadāpyekādhāratā na syāt
buddhipratibhāsa āśrayo yasya śabdārthasya sa tathoktaḥ
eko nīlaśabda ekaṃ vyavacchedamanīlavyavacchinnaṃ nīlasvabhāvaṃ sūcayannanyamanutpalavyavacchinnamutpalasvabhāvamapratikṣipya varttate na nirākārotītyarthaḥ
tena nīlaśabdena vyāpta ākrāntaḥ ākṣiptaḥ sannutpalaśabdaprayoge buddhāvekatvena pratibhāsate
nīlaśabdaprayogād buddhipratibhāsī dharmī nīlarūpa eva pratibhāsate
tatrārthādanīlaṃ vyāvarttyate na tvanutpalavyavacchinnaḥ svabhāva utpalaśabdaprayogādapyutpalarūpatayā pratīyamānonutpalaṃ vyāvarttyate na tvanīlavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvaḥ
śabdadvayaprayoge tu nīlotpaladharmadvayayuktaikadharmipratibhāsinī vikalpabuddhirutpadyate tato nānāphalaḥ śabda ekādhāro bhavatīti bhaved buddhyanurodhena sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti
tena yadu dyo ta ka re ṇocyate
yasya cānyāpohaḥ śabdārthastenānīlānutpalavyudāsau kathaṃ samānādhikaraṇāviti vaktavyaṃ
yasya punarvidhīyamānaḥ śabdārthasya jātiguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ dravyamabhidhīyate jātiguṇau ca dravye varttete
leśato vastudharmasya vastusvabhāvasya vijātīyavyāvṛttasya saṃsparśaḥ syāt prāptilakṣaṇaḥ
sattyamiti vidyamānaḥ sa hyadhyavasīyamānaḥ vyavacchinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ
tatra vastunīti kṛtvā naikavastvabhidhāyini śabdebhyupagamyamāne vastudharmasya saṃsparśaḥ sāmānyasyaiva vastuno'bhāvāt
yata evamvastuni śabdārthe doṣastena kāraṇenānyāpohaviṣayā vikalpabuddhipratibhāsaviṣayāḥ śabdā buddhayaśca proktā ācārya di ṅ nā ge na
buddhīnāmevaitad viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu śabdānānteṣāṃ sāmānyaviṣayavyabhicārāt
vastveva yadi viṣayīkriyeta gṛhyeta na tu vidhirūpeṇādhyavasīyeta
praṇetā ācārya di ṅ nā gaḥ
tadā bhinnaphalayoḥ śabdayorekatra dravye vṛttatvāt syāt sāmānādhikaraṇyametattu na sambhavati
tathā hi tacchabdavācyaṃ sāmānyaṃ svalakṣaṇāda bhinnaṃ bhinnamvā syāt
ekatvād vasturūpasya bhinnarūpā sāmānyaviśeṣākārā bhinnā matiḥ kutaḥ
śāvaleyātmako bhedo yato bāhule- yātmakād bhedād vyāvarttate
yadaika eva vastvātmā svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ ca tadā śāvaleyasvalakṣaṇasya gotvasāmānyātmakatvāt
tatraiva bāhuleye vṛttiḥ punaḥ svalakṣaṇātmakatvāt tatraivāvṛttistasmin kāle prayuktā
netyā cā ryaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ sāṃ khyādidarśanena bhedābhāvāt
yato na hyasati rūpabhede'yaṃ pravibhāga iti sāmānyaṃ viśeṣa iti ca
sati vā pravibhāge sāmānyaviśeṣayoravyatireko na syādityuktaṃ prāk
yadāpi nīlaśabdo nīlaguṇābhi dhāyīṣyate tadāpi bhinnārthābhidhānamastyeva
eko dharmī artho viṣayo yasyā buddhessā
tadā tasya nirviśeṣaṇatvāt tāvataivāsau nirākāṃkṣa iti kathandhavādīnākṣipet
anākṣiptāśca kathaṃ vṛkṣaśabdārthasya bhedā dhavādayo'tadbhedatvācca kathaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ
sāmānyaviśiṣṭasya dravyasyābhidhānānna yathokto doṣa iti cenna
viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyāpi dravyasyābhidhāne vastusāmarthyādekasmādapi śabdādakhilagateḥ śabdāntarasya tatrāpravṛttiḥ pravṛttau cāparyāyateti
tathā hi yadā tāvatsvalakṣaṇādavyatiririktaṃ sāmānyantadā svalakṣaṇavad vyaktyantarānanugamādasāmānyaṃ
ato vijātīyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvaḥ sarvatra tulya iti bhedasya vijātīyabhinnasya svabhāvasya vikalpabuddhyā sarvatra svākārābhedenādhyastasyāsāmānyadoṣo nāsti
evantāvad vijātīyavyāvṛttaṃ svabhāvaṃ sarvatra buddhyā svākārābhedenādhyastamekaṃ śabdābhidheyaṃ pratipādyādhunā'bhinnākāramantareṇāpyekakāryeṣu bhāveṣvekaḥ śabdo niyujyata ityāha
ekakāryeṣu bhedeṣvekasya bhāvarahiteṣvapi samā ekā śrutiḥ
tatkāryāṇāmbhedānāmatatkāryebhyo yā yāvṛttistannibandhanā vijātīyavyāvṛttatayaikakāryeṣvekā śrutirnibadhyata ityarthaḥ
nanu yadi na sāmānye śabdaniveśaḥ svalakṣaṇe tarhi śabdaniveśaḥ syādanyasyābhāvāt
yataḥ pratipādakastāvat trikālasthān bhāvān ekakāryāt saṃketakaraṇābhiprāyeṇa viṣayīkṛtya teṣveva saṃketaṃ karoti vyavahārakāle paricodanārthaṃ
tena yadyapi buddhiparivarttino bhāvāḥ sāmānyarūpāstathāpi teṣveva bahuṣu bahiriva parisphuratsvekaḥ śabdo niveśyate
na tu teṣu sarveṣu bhinnarūpe sāmānye sthite prativyakti bhinneva śrutiḥ kasmānna saṃketitetyāha
gauravād sāmānyaṃ aśaktervaiphalyācca bhedākhyāyā bhinnāyāḥ śruteḥ
na bhāve vastubhūte sāmānye samā śrutiḥ kṛtā
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvasya svarūpasya vyavasthiterasāṃkaryāt
vyatiriktamapi svasmin svabhāvevasthitaṃ tadapi kathaṃ vyaktīnāṃ samānaṃ rūpaṃ
saivārthābhedaḥ śabdābhedasya kāraṇameṣṭavyaṃ yatorthādabhedena vinā śabdābhedo na yujyate
kathantarhi bahuṣvekā śrutirarthābheda eva pravṛtterityata āha
yāpīyantatkāryataikakāryateṣṭā yasyāḥ paricodanārthambahuṣvekā śrutirityuktaṃ sāpyatatkāryādeva bhinnatā draṣṭavyā
vināpi ca sāmānye yathā vilakṣaṇeṣvekaśabdaniveśo na viruddhastathā darśayannāha
athavā kvacit kāle sāṃketikīṃ śrutiṃ kuryāditi sambandhaḥ
tatkāryasya cakṣurvijñānaikakāryasya kāraṇakalāpasya parebhyaḥ prakāśanasambhave sati
sattaivaṃ teṣāṃ sāmānyamiti cenna tasyā aviśeṣāt sarvadā sarvatra cakṣurvijñānaprasaṅgāt
yadi teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ syāttadā tatra sāmānye śabdaniveśāt sarvatra bhede niveśitaḥ syāt
ekantu sāmānyaṃ vinā bahuṣvekaśabdasanniveśo na yuktaḥ
tataścāsau śabdaḥ saṃketyamāna ekatraiva bhede saṃketitaḥ syāt
tathā caikavṛtterekatra bhede kṛtasanniveśasyānyatra bhede vilakṣaṇe pratyayājananāt
dvitīyā govyaktistataḥ śabdād gaurityevaṃ na pratīyeta
svabhāvānugamā- bhāvepi śāvaleye niveśito'pratyāsanne bāhuleye pratyayaṃ janayiṣyatīti cedāha
yadyekasminnarthe śabdasya niyogaḥ syāt tadā bhavedekārthapratipādanaṃ
yathācoditānāmityasaṃkareṇa pratipattyarthaṃ coditānāṃ vibhāgāparijñānāt tasmānna teṣu śabdaniyogaḥ phalavān
evaṃ hi svalakṣaṇeṣu pṛthak pṛthakchabdaniyogaḥ phalavānbhavati
kriyate ca bahuṣvekaśabdaniyogastasmād vastubhūtena sāmānyena bhāvyamityabhiprāyaḥ
tatraitasmin nyāye'nekaṃ kāraṇamekatra kārye upayujyeta vyāpriyeta
te tu kāraṇabhūtāḥ padārthā ekena vā śabdena codyeran bahubhirveti svātantryamatra codane vaktuḥ
yata evantaditi tasmādiyamekā śrutirbahuṣu vācyeṣu vakturabhiprāyavaśād hetoḥ pravarttamānā nopaālambhamarhati
tathā hīcchayaiva tatra paraparikalpite sāmānye na vastusthityaiva ekasyāḥ śruteḥ pravattiḥ
tadā bahuṣvapi na kaścid vyāghāta ityāha
tadgobhedasādhyaṃ vāhadohādikaṃ kāryaṃ prayojanaṃ na bhavati yeṣāmaśvādīnāntebhyo bhedeneti
kiṃ punarvastubhūtamevaikatvaṃ na codyata ityata āha
na punaḥ svabhāvasyaikatvānna punarvastubhūtasya sāmānyasyaikatvād bhinneṣvekā śrutiḥ
bhavatu nāma sāmānyaṃ vyatiriktantadapi tasmin svabhāve vyavasthitamamiśrameva
yasya yallakṣaṇantena vyavasthitasvabhāvānāmanyonyarūpāsaṃśleṣāt kathamekanimittaḥ sāmānyanibandhanaḥ śabdo bhinneṣu bhavet
atatprayojanebhyo vyāvṛttistu bhinnānāmapyaviruddheti kṛtvā sa evātatprayojanebhyo bhedastatprayojanānāmabhedastadvyāvṛtteḥ sarvatra bhāvāt
yataśca na kathaṃcid vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ ghaṭate
anyavyāvṛtta eva svabhāva eṣāmabheda iti yāvat
etena tatkāryatāpītyādi kā ri kā bhāgo vyākhyātaḥ
yathetyādinā cakṣurādau yathā rūpavijñānaikaphala ityādi vyācaṣṭe
tadrūpavijñānaṃ kāryaṃ yeṣāntāni tatkāryāṇi teṣāṃ sāmānyamaviśeṣeṇaikakāryakaraṇasāmarthyantasya codanā prakāśanā
vyavahāralāghavārthamekena śabdena bahūnāṃ pratipādanārthaṃ rūpavijñānasya hetuścakṣurādikalāpaḥ saraḥ śaro vetyevaṃ śrutinniveśayediti sambandhaḥ
na ca sambandhibhedāt sattāyā bhedo nityatvenānādheyātiśayatvāt
atadarthebhyo rūpavijñānājanakebhyo bhinnā iti kṛtvā bheda evātatkāryebhyo vyāvṛttireva
yathā cakṣūrūpādiṣvekaṃ sāmānyaṃ vināpyekakāryatvakhyāpanāyaikaḥ śabdo niveśyate
samūhasya santānasyāvasthāviśeṣasya ca vācakāḥ śabdāḥ samūhasantānāvasthāviśeṣaśabdāḥ
sarveṣāṃ hyekaṃ kāryamiti kṛtvā tenaikakāryatvena viśeṣābhāva ucyate
prati rūpādibhinnena śabdena codanāniṣphaleti kṛtvā sakṛdekakālaṃ sarveṣāṃ kvacit kārye niyojanārthaṃ rūpādiviśeṣeṣūdakadhāraṇādikāryasameṣu ghaṭa ityekaṃ śabdaṃ prayuṃkte'yaṃ loka iti vyavaharttā
nanu bhinnā eva rūpādayaḥ kathamekasmād ghaṭaśabdād abhedena pratīyanta iti cadāha
tadanyebhya iti tatkāryakaraṇāsamarthebhyaḥ paṭādibhyo bhidyanta iti bheda evaiṣāmabhedastato'bhedāt
tasmādabhedādaviśeṣeṇaiva sāmānyenaivaikasmād ghaṭaśabdāt sarve rūpādayaḥ pratīyante
yadi rūpādaya eva kevalā ghaṭo na tu tadvyatiriktaṃ dravyaṃ
kathantarhi ghaṭasya rūpādaya iti vyatireka iti cedāha
ghaṭasya rūpādaya ityapi yo vyatirekastasyāyamartho ghaṭasvabhāvā rūpādayo na paṭādisvabhāvā iti
ghaṭaśabdastu viśiṣṭakāryaśaktiyogena paṭādisvabhāvebhyopi rūpādibhyo bhedena viśiṣṭān rūpādīnāha
ato ghaṭasya rūpādaya iti śabdadvayavyāpāreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣākārabuddhyutpatteḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo vyatirekavimatiśca prayujyata iti
sāmānyakāryaṃ rūpādimātrasādhyantasya siddhiḥ sādhanantasmin prasiddhenātmanā svabhāvena
itthaṃbhūtena rūpeṇa hetunā vā rūpādiśabdaiḥ karaṇabhūtaiḥ prasiddhāssantaḥ viśiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ ghaṭasādhyaṃ ghaṭasādhyamevodakāharaṇādi
tathābhūtā ākhyā saṃjñā yasya sa tathā tena viśiṣṭāḥ
na punaratra rūpādisaṃhatau hyatra vā ghaṭa iti vyavahāre yathāvarṇṇitalakṣaṇamiti rūpādivyatiriktandravyaṃ
upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaścāvayavī parairiṣṭo dārśanaṃ spārśanaṃ dravyamiti vacanāt
yathāvāntareṇāpyavayavinaṃ paramāṇava eva pratyakṣasya viṣayastathā dvitīye paricchede pratipādayiṣyate
yadi rūpādaya eva saṃhatā ghaṭaḥ kathantarhi bahuṣu ghaṭa ityekavacanamiti cedāha
hetuphala viśeṣo vā bhūto niṣpanno yeṣāmiti bahavrīhiḥ
tenaikakāryatvenaikakāraṇatvena vā sāmyena brīhyādiśabdaiḥ santānābhidhāyibhiḥ kṛtasaṃketāḥ saṃketakāle
nanu brīhyādiśabdā api samudāyaśabdā eva rūpādisamudāyābhidhāyitvāt
yathā ca ghaṭasya rūpādayaḥ ghaṭa iti caikavacanaṃ yena nibandhanenoktaṃ
tathā brīhe rūpādayo brīhiriti naikavacanaṃ draṣṭavyamata evāha
yepi nīlā diparamāṇavaḥ pṛthagiti nīlapītādayaḥ parasparānapekṣāḥ samastā veti parasparasahitāḥ
kvaciditi cakṣurvijñāne svadeśe parasyotpattipratibandhe vā sakṛdeva pratyāyanārthaṃ
nanu nīlapītādayo'tyantabhinnāste kathamekena sanidarśanādiśabdenocyanta ityata āha
tadanyebhyo'nidarśanāpratighebhyo yo bhedasya eva teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ sarveṣāntato vyāvṛttatvāt
sanidarśanādiśabdā api paramāṇusamudayā'bhidhānāt samudāyaśabdā eveti cet
tadudakadhāraṇādyekaṃ kāryaṃ yasya rūpādisāmarthyasya tasya codanāyāmekaśakticodanāyāmityarthaḥ
tathā kāraṇāpekṣayāpyanekorthaḥ ekena śabdena kṛtasamayaḥ khyāpyata iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ vyavahārārthameva lāghavenetyarthād draṣṭavyaṃ
yathā śavalāyā gorapatyāni sarvāṇyevaikakāraṇatvena śāvaleyaśabdenocyante bahulāyāścāpatyāni bāhuleyaśabdena
yāvāṃśca puruṣaprayatnena kāraṇena janitaḥ śabdaḥ sarvaḥ samānakāraṇajanyatvena prayatnānantarīyakaḥ kathyate
kāraṇāyattajanmanaḥ prayatnānantarīyakasyānyasya ca sarvasya kṛtaka ityabhidhānāt
tasya cākṣuṣasya nīlāderyat kāryañcakṣurvijñānantasya pratiṣedhenācākṣuṣaḥ śabdaḥ
tathā hi nityaṃ parairvastveveṣṭantaccāsādhyasādhanabhūtaṃ vyavahārapathaṃ nāvataratīti sādhyasādhanaṃ cāṅgīkartavyaṃ
ātmaśabdopi kvacit kārye svatantrasya khyāpanāya kṛta ityanātmaśabdo'tatkāryavyavacchedena syāt
tasya sasvāmikasyāśūnyasya ca yatkāraṇantasya pratiṣedhenāyaṃ śabdādiko bhāvosvāmikaḥ śūnya iti vyavahārārthaṃ khyāpyata iti sambandhaḥ
tathā hi svatantreṇātmādinā yodhiṣṭhitassa sasvāmikaḥ parairiṣyate
na pratikṣaṇaviśarāruṣu bhāveṣu sāmagrīmātrapratibaddheṣu vyavasthitasvabhāvaḥ kaścidadhiṣṭhātāsti yatpratibaddhāssaṃskārāḥ pravarttante

yathākathitamiti yasya yādṛśī siddhāntāśrayaṇakalpanā tayā samīhito racito śūnyanityādīnāṃ ya ākārastaṃ vikalpya buddhāvāropya tadvyavacchedena paraparikalpitā'śūnyādyākāravyavacchedena śūnyādivyapadeśaḥ kriyate
sāṃkaryaṃ yasya śabdasya sa tathā tadbhāvastasmāt
na vastusvalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaiḥ svarūpeṇa vidhīyate'panīyate vā
durmatīnāmu dyo ta ka ra prabhṛtīnāṃ vispanditāni vijṛmbhitānyasambaddhānīti yāvat
ataśca te doṣopakṣepā upekṣaṇīyā nāvadhānārhā ityarthaḥ
ekasya vastunaḥ sāmānyasya vṛtterapi kāraṇādaneko vyaktibhedaḥ
ekakāryatvenaikaḥ śabdabahuṣvekena vā sāmānyeneti na kaścid viśeṣa iti manyate
api tvekavṛttyāpyekasya sāmānyasya varttanenāpyanekaḥ padārtha ekaśabdenocyeta ko virodhaḥ syāt
yathaikakāryatvena bahuṣvekaśabdapravṛttau nāsti virodhastathā vastubhūtenāpi sāmānyena
abhimatatve upalabhyatvaṃ karaṇatvena vivakṣitamiti karttṛkaraṇe kṛtetyeva samāsaḥ
bahuṣvekaśabdo vyapadeśastulyākāraṃ jñānaṃ pra tya bhi jñā naṃ
ādiśabdāt sāmānyāśrayā vyaktau pravṛttirna bhavedityādeḥ parigrahaḥ
na bhaveyurityādīnyanena cādiśabdenānyasyāpi pūrvoktasya doṣasya grahaṇaṃ
ekakāryatve tu virodhābhāvāt tatkṛtameva vyapadeśapratyabhijñānādikaṃ yuktamiti
sā ca sāmānyasya svāśraye pravṛttirādheyatā vā bhavet
yadetadekamiti vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyamanekatrāśraye varttamānamekāṃ śrutiṃ varttayati
tasya sāmānyasya svāśraye keyaṃ vṛttiriti praśnayitvā svayameva vikalpadvayamāha
tathā hi vṛtteḥ svāśraye ādheyatā vā syāt
yathā kuṇḍe ādhāre badarāṇi varttanta iti
vyaktirvā tasya sāmānyasyāśraye vṛttiḥ syāt tairāśrayairvyakteḥ prakāśanāt
nityaṃ ca sāmānyamabhyupagataṃ vyaktyutpatteḥ pūrvvantadanādheyantato nityasyāśrayairanupakāryatvāddhetorāśrayābhimatā vyaktayo nādhāraḥ
atha nityaṃ neṣyate tadāpyanityatve'parāparotpatteranyasyānyasyotpatteranekaṃ sāmānyamanekatvāt kāraṇād bhedeṣviva bhedavat tasmin sāmānye ekapratyayāyogādekasya jñānasyāyogāt kāraṇāt
nityasya ca sāmānyasya kiṃkurvāṇa āśraya ādhāraḥ syānnaivetyabhiprāyaḥ
nopakārakatvādādhāraḥ kintu tasya sāmānyasya tatrāśraye samavāyāt
yadā ho dyo ta ka raḥ
tadityādi si ddhā nta vā dī
nanūpakārakābhāve gotvavat sarvasyaiva sarvasamavetatvenaikasmānna pratītirbhavatītīdameva codyate
nāpyasamavetānāṃ samavāyosti yena samavetatvaṃ syāt sarveṣāṃ sarvatra samavetatvaprasaṅgāt
apṛthaksiddhayoḥ samavāyo yathārabhyārambhaka- yordravyayoḥ pṛthaksiddhānāṃ saṃyogaḥ
vastubhūtāḥ sambandhā vastūnāṃ vā sambandhā iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā
apratibadhannasya cāsambandhāt kāraṇāt sarvavastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvānna vyatiricyanta iti prakṛtena saṃbandhaḥ
nanu cāśrayāt satyupakāre āśritayoḥ parasparamupakāryopakārakabhāvo naivāstīti kimarthamanyato vetyasyopanyāsaḥ
kintu yadyapi sākṣādanyonyaṃ nopakārastathāpyekakāraṇāyattatayā pāramparyeṇāpi sambandhaṃ kalpayedityupanyāsaḥ

atiprasaṅgabhayādityukto doṣaḥ yataśca svāśrayādekārthasamavāyinoravaśyamupakāro'taḥ svāśrayakṛtaḥ samavāyinoryaḥ svopakāra ātmopakārastena dvāreṇa paramapi dvitīyamapi samavāyinaṃ saṃghaṭayya pratipādayitrā khyāpyate samavāyināviha sambaddhāviti
yathā parasyaikārthasamavāyinoḥ parasparāsambaddhepyekārthasamavāyāt sambandhastathāsmākamekakāryatvena tayoḥ sambandhaḥ
yata evantasmāt tatrāpyekārthasamavāyini kāryakāraṇabhāvakṛta evāśrayeṇa saha yaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvastatkṛta eva yaddvāreṇāropita eva sambandhaḥ
svātmani sāmānyasvabhāvenupakurvāṇaḥ sāmānyasyānapekṣasyādhāra iti yā ci ta ka ma ṇḍa na me tat
tathā sāmānyāśrayasya parasmāt prārthitenādhārabhāvenādhāravyapadeśo na vastusthityā tata upakārābhāvāditi
tataśca yaduktaṃ sarvatra vastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvānna vyatiricyanta iti tadanekāntikamiti manyate
pravisarppato deśāntaravisarppaṇaśīlasya badarādestaddeśajananamupādānabhūtasya pūrvakasya badaralakṣaṇasya yo deśaḥ kuṇḍasambaddha- stasminneva deśe jananamanyatrāgamanāt
tasyotpādanaṃ tadeva dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya guruṇo dravyasya badarādeḥ pūrvakṣaṇasaṃgṛhītasya
yata evantasmāt pāścātyasya badarakāryasya yaḥ pūrvakṣaṇaḥ upādānabhūtastasya sahakāri kuṇḍaṃ
tatraivopādānakṣaṇadeśa eva badarakārya janayat kuṇḍamādhāra ityucyate
anyathā yadi kuṇḍena badarāṇāṃ yathokta upakāro na kriyate tadeha kuṇḍe badarāṇītyevaṃ vyāpadeśo na syāt
tadupakārakṛta ityādhāropakārakṛtoyaṃ vyāpadeśa iha kuṇḍe badarāṇīti
kimpunarityādi si ddhā nta vā dī
tābhyāṃ kuṇḍabadarābhyāṃ saṃyogasya jananāttayoḥ saṃyoga iṣyate
pareṇokta ityavamṛśya si ddhā nta vā dyā ha
sa saṃyoga ekatraiva kuṇḍe badare vā kinna samavaiti janyate vā
ekena kuṇḍena badareṇa vā pṛcchataścāyaṃ bhāvo yadi tau kuṇḍabadarākhyau bhāvau saṃyogajanane
kṣaṇikāstu pratyekaṃ pṛthagasamarthāḥ paścāt sahakārikṛtaviśeṣāssahitāssamarthā ityaviruddhaṃ
tasmāt kuṇḍād yo yo badarātmā tasmāt kuṇḍasyopakārāt
badarasvarūpasyānyataḥ hetoreva siddherakāryatvānna badarāṇāṃ janyatvaṃ nāpi janakatvaṃ kuṇḍasyeti bhāvaḥ
na hi paro badarādīnāṃ kuṇḍādeḥ sakāśāt svarūpotpattimvāñchati
na kuṇḍena badararūpameva kriyate kintu tatonyadrūpamityata āha
ayaṃ cārthaḥ kāryaśca tāsāṃ prāptosau jananaṃ yadupakriye 1
sarva eva vastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvāddhetorvyavasthāpyanta iti sambandhaḥ
yadvā kāryakāraṇabhāvāt sakāśāt pravibhāgena bhedena vyavasthāpyante
pradīpakṛtena ca vijñānajananasamarthasvarūpotpādena ghaṭapradīpādīnāṃ vyaṅgyavyañjakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandha ityevamanyasminnapi sambandhe yathāyogaṃ vācyaṃ
nanu sarva eva vastusambandhā ityādinā na saṃyogalakṣaṇasya sambandhasya kāryakāraṇabhāventarbhāvaḥ samānakālabhāvinorevāsya sattvāt
kṣaṇike tarhi bhaviṣyati saṃyuktāsaṃyuktāvasthayośca kuṇḍabadarayorna svarūpabhedaḥ pratīyate
yadi saṃyogo na nārthāntarambhavettadā kṣetrabījodakādayo nirviśiṣṭatvāt sarvadaivāṃkurādikāryaṃ kuryu rnacaivaṃ
yo sau kṣetrādinirapekṣaḥ sa saṃyoga iti siddhaṃ
kiṃ cāsau saṃyogo dravyayorviśeṣaṇabhāvena pratīyamānatvāttatorthāntaratvena pratyakṣasiddha eva
tathā hi kaścit kenacit saṃyukte dravye āharetyukto yayoreva dravyayoḥ saṃyogamupalabhate te evāharati
kiṃ ca dūrataravarttinaḥ puṃsaḥ sāntarepi vane nirantararūpāvasāyinī seyaṃ buddhirudayamāsādayati mithyābuddhirmukhyapadārthānubhavamantareṇa na kvacidupajāyate
na hyananubhūtagodarśanasya gavaye gauriti vibhramo bhavati tasmādavaśyaṃ saṃyogo mukhyobhyupagantavyaḥ
tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalītyanena pratiṣedhavākyena na kuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate tasyānyatra deśādau sattvāt
tathā caitraḥ kuṇḍalītyanenāpi vidhivākyena na caitrakuṇḍalayoranyataravidhānantayoḥ siddhatvāt
1 yathā kṣetrādīnāṃ viśiṣṭāvasthāpratilambhena saṃyogārambha katvamiṣyate tathā saṃyogamaṃtareṇa kāryārambhakatvameva kinneṣyate
2 nāpi nirvikalpakena pratyakṣeṇa saṃyukte dravye svarūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇe tṛtīyaḥ saṃyogaḥ pratibhāsate
3 nāpi savikalpake jñāne saṃyukte dravye muktvā saṃyogaśabdaṃ cāparaḥ saṃyogo viśeṣaṇabhāvena pratibhāsate
yāvacca tasyāmavasthāyāṃ saṃyogajanakatvena saṃyuktapratyayaviṣayo tāviṣyete tāvat saṃyogamantareṇa saṃyuktapratyayahetutvena tadviṣayau kiṃ neṣyete
5 nāpi sāntare vane nirantarāvabhāsinī buddhirmukhyapadārthānubhavapūrvikā skhalatpratyayaviṣayatvenānupacaritatvāt
6 tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalītyādau caitrasambandhikuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate vidhīyate vā
kevalaṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇa saṃyuktāvetau saṃyogasyeti vā pratītirna punarvastubhūtasaṃyogabalāt
badarādiṣu jananaśaktireva kuṇḍādīnāmādhāra iti sambandhaḥ sāmānyasyāśrayo jananaśaktyaivādhārostviti cedāha
svopādānadeśa eva jananaṃ jananaviśeṣaḥ sa lakṣaṇaṃ yasyādhārabhāvasya sa tathā
tasyeti sāmānyasya tadabhāvepīti vyaktyabhāvepi vyaktiśanye deśe sāmānyasya sthānāt
yadi hi vyaktiśūnye deśe sāmānyaṃ na bhavettadā tatrāpūrvavyaktyutpāde sāmānyasambandho na bhaveta
na hi tasyānyata āgamanaṃ niṣkriya tvāt
na ca bhinnadeśāvasthitā vyaktistasya sāmānyasyādhāro bhinnadeśatvāt
atrāpi pātapratibandhāt sthāpakābhyupagame yadi nyāyavādī kaścit pātapratibandhaṃ na paryanuyuñjīta
yaḥ sthāpayitrā kriyate pātapratibandhaḥ sa sthāpyasyātmabhūto vā syāt tatorthāntaraṃ vā pātābhāvamātramvā
aryāntaratvebhyupagamyamāne tatraiva pratibandherthāntarabhūte'syādhārasyopayoga iti kaḥ patato badarādeḥ pratibandho vighātaḥ
ādhārakṛtenārthāntareṇa pātapratibandhena badarāderapātaḥ kriyata iti cedāha
yoyaṃ pratibandhākhyena padārthenāpātaḥ kriyate sa kiṃ badarāderātmabhūtorthāntaramvā
atha tenāpyapātākhyenārthena badarāderapātaḥ kriyate tatrāpi tulyaḥ paryanuyoga ityāha
abhāvaṅkarotīti vyapadeśe nābhāvo nāma kaścit kārya iṣyate
nanu yathā ghaṭavat kāryatvāt paṭasya na ghaṭarūpatā
taccābhāvepyastīti kathaṃ na bhāvarūpatvamabhāvarūpatvena pratibhāsanānna bhāvarūpateti cet
yata evantasmād bhāvasya yā kriyā tasyāḥ pratiṣedhanirdeśo'bhāvaṃkarotīti
apiśabdādādheya ityanenāpi vyapadeśena kṣaṇikānāṃ pūrvakṣaṇasaṃgṛhītenopādānena samānadeśasyottarakṣaṇasaṃgṛhītasya kāryasyotpādanamucyate
tasmāt sāmānye'yamapi prakāro na sambhavatīti khyāpanāyābhyupagamyaitaduktaṃ pātapratibandhādajanakopi sthāpaka iti
gatimato dravyasyeti sakriyasya sāmānyasya punaramūrttatvādakriyasya kiṃ lakṣaṇāṃ sthitiṃ kurvāṇa āśrayaḥ sthāpakaḥ syāt
na hi sāmānyasya pāto'sti yena tatpratibandhaḥ sthitirbhavet
tāmevāśrayādanyāṃ sthitiṃ sa āśrayaḥ karoti na sāmānyaṃ
sā sthitiḥ sāmānye pratibaddhā tataḥ sambandhasambaddhāt sāmānyamupakṛtamevetyata āha
na hi tasyāḥ sāmānye pratibandhakāraṇaṃ kiṃcidasti kiṃ sāmānyasyāśrayeṇa kṛtambhavatītyadhyāhāraḥ
abhyupagamyata eva sthiteḥ sāmānye pratibandha iti cedāha
āśrayeṇa janitā yā sthitistasyāḥ sthiteḥ sthitiḥ sāmānyena kriyate
yā sā cāśrayapratibaddhāyāḥ sthiteḥ sāmānyena sthitiḥ kriyate sā āśrayahetukāyāḥ sthiterātmabhūtā vā bhaved vyatiriktā vā
ātmabhūtatve āśrayeṇaiva sā kṛteti kathaṃ sāmānyena kriyate
vyatiriktatve ca saiva sthitiḥ sāmānyena kṛtā āśrayajanitāyā ādyāyāḥ sthiteḥ kiṃ sāmānyena kṛtaṃ syāt
sāmānyajanitāyāḥ sthiterāśrayajanitayā sthityā'parā tṛtīyā sthitiḥ yata iti tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ityanavasthā syāt

tatra tayoḥ pakṣayormadhye yadi svāśrayamātragataṃ apūrvaghaṭādyutpattau ghaṭatvādiśūnye pradeśe paścādutpannād ghaṭāderbhinnadeśaṃ yad dravyantadvarttinaḥ sāmānyasya
bhavet sambhavo yadi tasmāt pūrvadravyāt tatsāmānyampaścādutpadyamānandravyaṃ yāti
taditi sāmānyaṃ pūrvadravyāditi yatra tatpūrvaṃ samavetaṃ tasmādutpitsu dravya mutpattumicchu pūrvaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ na yāti
pūrvadravyādacalatopi bhinnadeśena yogo bhaviṣyati vimbasyādarśa iveti cedāha

anyadravyavṛtterityutpitsudravyād bhinnadeśadravyavṛtterbhāvasya sāmānyākhyasya tataḥ pūrvakādāśrayādacalatastadubhayāntarālāvyāpinaḥ pūrvapaścādutpannadvayāntarālāvyāpinaḥ svāśrayād bhinnadeśena dravyeṇa yogo na hi yukta iti sambandhaḥ
bimbasya tu bhinnadeśe nādarśena yogostīti bruvāṇaḥ kathannonmataḥ syāt
sāmagrībalād bhrāntaṃ jñānaṃ pratibimbānugatādarśapratibhāsi tatra jāyate
utpitsudravyāt prāk sāmānyātmā na ca tatrotpitsudeśe āsīt
na ca tatra deśe vyaktyā sahotpannaṃ nityatvāt
na ca vyaktyutpāda eva sāmānyasyotpādo bhinnatvāt
abhinnatve vā tato na sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ syāt
yāvadbhiḥ prakāraiḥ sāmānyasya vyaktyantare sambhavaste prakārā neṣyante tatra ca sāmānyamiṣyata iti vyāghātaḥ
sa ca vyaktisamavetatvapratibhāsonutpādepi sāmānyasya vidyata eveti kimutpādena vyaktisamavetañca sāmānyasya rūpamiṣyate
tena tatpūrvadravyasamavetamapi tato'vicaladutpitsudravyasamavetaṃ ca pratibhāsata iti kathanna yātītyādi dūṣaṇāyocyatebhīṣṭatvāt
yo hi sāmānyasya pratibhāsaṃ necchati tasyedaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ syāt pratibhāsata iti
yastu sāmānyapratibhāsolīka iti manyate tasya kathaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ
alīkatvaṃ cotpitsu dravyaṃ na yāti na ca tatrāsīnna cotpannamityādinā granthena sāmānyābhāvepi sāmānyāvabhāsino jñānasyotpatteḥ pratipāditamā cā rye ṇa
yadi tadaṃśavat syāttadaikenāṃśena pūrvambhinnādhāre sthitamaṃśāntareṇotpitsu dravyaṃ vyāpnuyāt
ye ca tadaikadeśāḥ sāmānyasya pratyekampiṇḍeṣu varttante
yadi sāmānyātmakā ekamekatra varttata iti prāptaṃ
ekadeśeṣu ca sāmānyasya yadyekadeśāntareṇa vṛttistadānavasthā syāt
kiṃ kāraṇantasyānavayavasya sāmānyasyaikena dravyeṇa sambandho ya ātmā
tasmādekavyaktiniyatātmanaḥ sāmānyasya nāsti tasminneva kāle bhinnadeśena dravyeṇa sambandhaḥ
sambandhe vā pūrvavyaktiniyataikātmakatvena sāmānyasya pūrvavyaktau sthitistasminneva kāle bhinnadeśavyaktisambandhenāsthitiretaccaviruddhamityāha
tasyāmeva vyaktau sthitāsthitātmanoḥ svabhāvayorekasya sāmānyasya yugapad virodhāt
nanu yathaikatyāgenāparatra vṛttirevamaparāparāvayavairbahuṣu ca vṛttirdṛṣṭatvāditi dvividhābhyupagamyate
tathā sāmānyaṃ yadā yenaiva rūpeṇaikatra vṛttantadaiva tenaiva rūpeṇānyatra varttate dṛṣṭatvāditi sāpi tṛtīyā vṛttiḥ kinnābhyupagamyate
trividhāpi hi dṛṣṭatvāt sambhaved dvividhā yatheti
u dyo ta ka ro pyāha
na gotvamavayavī na ca samudāyastasmānna tatra kṛtsnaikadeśaśabdau staḥ
na cet tatraitau śabdau staḥ tasmād gotvaṃ kiṃ kṛtsnamvarttate utaikadeśeneti na yuktaḥ praśnaḥ
vattiḥ samavāya iha pratyayahetutvāttena sarvatra pūrvadravya utpitsudravye ca samavāya eva vṛttirataḥ kathamucyate
sarvadevotyatsudravyotpādepi yadā varttate tadāpi dravyanna jahāti
vastu caikaṃ sāmānyaṃ yadi kathamanyatrāpi vartteta
asya tu vastupratibhāso bādhako na cānugataṃ vastvastītyuktaṃ
nanu yāvadasyāprāmāṇyaṃ na tāvadanumānasya prabṛttiryāvacca nānumānasya pravṛttistāvannāsya pratyakṣābhāsatetyanyonyāśrayatvaṃ syāditi cet
sāmānyasvabhāvasya darśanamāśrayo yasya pratyayasya sa sarvatra bhinnajātīyepi dravye sarvākārasyāt
aśve sthita ātmā yasya dravyatvasyeti vigrahaḥ
aśve sthita iti vā sādhanaṃ kṛteti samāsaḥ
tatsvabhāvapratipattyā cāśvasthitasvabhāvadravyatvapratipattyā ca tathā niścayād gaurdravyamiti niścayāt
tasmādaśvasamavetenaiva dravyatvena viśiṣṭāṃ gāṃ dravyamiti pratipadyamānośva iti pratīyāt
yasya tvaśvavyatiriktameva dravyatvasāmānyantena ca viśiṣṭamasau gāṃ pratipadyamāno niyamenāśva iti pratīyāt
anavayavaṃ sāmānyamanekadeśe'neko deśo'syeti tasmin ghaṭādau yugapannādhīyate
anyatreti pūrvavyaktau varttamānasya sāmānyasya svasmāt pūrvādhāradeśād acalatastataḥ pūrvādhāradeśādanyatra sthāne janma yasya dravyasya tasmin vṛttirityatiyukti madityupahasati 156
tena deśena sāmānyaṃ na sambadhyate svavyaktisarvagatatvābhyupagamāt
yatra deśe sāmānyaṃ na varttate taddeśinaṃ ca paścāt kālabhāvinambhāvaṃ vyāpnotīti nyāyātikrāntatvāt kimapyetanmahādbhutamiti prakārāntareṇopahasati
na hi yo yatra deśe na varttate sa taddeśaṃ vyāpnotīti nyāyānusāriṇā śakyamavasātuṃ 157
tasyāpi sarvagatasāmānyavādinaḥ sarvatragā yadi jātistadaikatra śāvaleyādau yā tasyāvyaktirabhivyaktistayā karaṇabhūtayā
vijātīyavyaktibhede ca vyaktaiva prakāśitaivābhedādekatvāt sarvatra vyaktiśūnyepi deśe dṛśyeta

yadyapi vyaktiśūnye pradeśe vijātīyavyaktau ca svavyaktervyañjikāyā abhāvastathāpi svavyaktyabhivyaktenaiva rūpeṇa tatrāvasthānājjāterupalambhaḥ syānno cet svabhāvanānātvaṃ prāpnotītyekarūpā ceṣyata iti bhāvaḥ
atha na yogyā tadā kadācid daśyeta
asamarthā vyaktyasannidhāne tatsannidhāne tu samarthā bhavati
yadi jāternāsti vyaktistatkiṃ vyaktyaivaikatra sā vyaktetyādyucyata ityata āha
ekatrāśraye vyaktā bhedābhāvādekatvājjātervyaktaiva prakāśitaiva sarvatra vyaktiśūnye deśe
api ca na ca sā jātirvyaktyapekṣiṇī
tadā vyañjakāpratipattau na vyaṅgyasya pratītiḥ syānna hi pradīpādyapratītau ghaṭādeḥ pratītirbhavati
tathā hi nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇāviśeṣye buddhirvarttata iti niyamāt
tato vyañjikāyā vyaktergrahaṇamantareṇāpi vyaṅgyābhimatasya sāmānyasya pratipattiriṣṭeti viparyayaḥ
sāmānyagrāhakamindriyaṃ ca tayossaṃyogastadapekṣā pratītiryasya sāmānyasya tattathoktaṃ
kvacid vyaktirdarśane satyastyevāśrayendriyasaṃyogo jāteḥ sarvatra sthitāyā upakāraka iti
tata āśrayendriyasaṃyogāddhetostaddarśī kvacid vyaktibhede jātidarśī yathāsthitāṃ sarvadeśavyāpinīñjātimpaśyet
yatraiva vyañjikā vyaktistatraiva jāteḥ svarūpaṃ dṛśyaṃ nānyatreti cedāha
na hyekasya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭamastyato'pūrvapakṣa evāyaṃ kevalandoṣāntarābhidhānārthaṃ gajanimīlanaṃ kṛtvopanyastaṃ
yasmādagṛhītvāpi vyaktiṃ sāmānyamādau gṛhyata itīṣyate pareṇa
seti vyaktiḥ sāmānyasya vyañjikā ca syāditi sambandhaḥ
yathā pradīpena ghaṭo vyaṅgyastadvatsāmānyena vyaktirvyaṅgyā prāpterthaḥ
vyaṅgyā ca saivaṃ prasajyata ityatra caśabdena sāmānyavyañjakamityetadupāttaṃ
ye pācakādiśabdā na kriyānimittānicchanti tān pratye taduktaṃ
abhinnena sāmānyākhyenārthena vinā pācakādiṣu kathamekaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ
vācakagrahaṇena pratyayonvayī gṛhīta eva tena vinā śabdasyāpravṛtteḥ
u dyo ta ka re ṇāpi gavādiṣvanuvṛttipratyayaḥ piṇḍādivyatiriktanimittād bhavati viśeṣapratyayānāmanākasmikatvānnīlādipratyayavat
atha manyase yathā pācakādiśabdā anuvṛttāśca bhavanti na ca pācakatvannāma sāmānyamasti
bhāvotpattikāla evābhivyaktaṃ syāt tathā gavādiṣvanuvṛttipratyayā iti
viśeṣapratyayānāmanākasmikatvādityasya hetoḥ piṇḍapratyayavyatiriktasya pratyayasya nimittāntarādutpāda ityayamarthaḥ
tacca prādhānyaṃ pācakāntareṣvapyastīti na doṣa iti vadatā pācakatvādisāmānyamvinā pācakādiśabdānāṃ vṛttiriṣṭaivo dyo ta ka re ṇetyanenābhiprāyeṇā cā rye ṇāpyuktaṃ kathamityādi
ta nnimittatve hi pradhānaṃ pradhānamityanugāmī śabdaḥ syānna pācaka iti
evaṃ sarvaśaktiṣvabhinnaṃ yenaikena te pācakādayo bhinnāssantopi tathetyabhedena pratīyeran jñānena
etadeva cedabhinnapratyayanibandhanaṃ na tu tato vyatiriktaṃ dharmāntarantadā pācakasya pācakatvamiti vyatirekapratītirna syāt
na hi tasyaiva tato vyatireko yuktaḥ
tatonyenaivākāreṇa pācakapratyayaḥ pratiṣedhapratyayassa yadi dravyanimittameva syāt tadā dravyamātrapratyayāviśiṣṭaḥ syāt
ucyate'bhedākāretyukte dravyasyābhāva iti pratiṣedhapratyayopyatadākāra iti śakyeta vyapadeṣṭuṃ na cāsau vastvantaranibaṃndhanaḥ pareṇeṣṭaḥ
tasmāt tatra dravyavyatirikte na nimittāntareṇa bhāvyamiti
yathā vyatireko gorgotvaṃ pācakasya pācakatvamityādiko yathā ca viśeṣapratyayā anantaroktāstathoktamiti sambandhaḥ
yathāsvamiti yasya śabdasya yathāsaṃketaṃ yo vyavacchedastasmādityarthaḥ
tato dharmadharmibhedakalpanayā pācakasya pācakatvamiti vyatirekavibhaktiḥ prayujyate
evaṃ dravyaśabdasyāpyadravyavyavacchinne svabhāve saṃketitatvāt tadanusāreṇādravyāvyavacchedānusāreṇādravyavyavacchedānukāriṇī buddhi rutpadyate
pācakaśabdāt tvapācakavyavacchinnānukāriṇyeva buddhirato yathāvyavacchedaṃ saṃketānusāreṇa viśeṣavatī buddhirekatrāpyaviruddhā
yathā vyaktīnāṃ bhedastadvat karmaṇopi bhedāddhetorasya pācakādyabhedapratyayasya na hetuḥ karmeti sambandhaḥ
teṣāṃ pācakānāṃ yāni karmāṇi pākākhyāni teṣu karmasu yā pācakatvajātiḥ samavetā saivābhedāddhetuḥ pācakābhedapratyayasya
tasya pākākhyasya karmaṇa āśrayo dravyaṃ pācakaśabdenocyate
tata iti karmajāteḥ karmaviṣayasyābhidhānasya pratyayasya ca hetutvāt karmajāterityabhiprāyaḥ
na karmajātiḥ pācakapratyayaṃ janayati kintu karmajātisamāśrayāt karmaivetyata āha
niruddhe karmaṇi puruṣaḥ pācaka iti nocyeta
atītasyāpi karmaṇostitvādadoṣa iti cedāha pacata evetyādi
yadyatītasya sattvaṃ syād varttamānavadupalabhyetopalabdhilakṣaṇa- prāptaṃ ca karmeṣyate
karmajātiḥ karmaṇi samavetā karmāpi dravye samavetantataḥ sambaddhasambandhāt karmajātirdravyaviṣayasya pācakapratyayasya heturiti cedāha
tata eveti karmaṇo vinaṣṭatvādeva na sāmānyasya karmaṇā sambandhaḥ sākṣāt
nāpi karmadvāreṇa pāramparyeṇa dravyasambandhosyāsambandhāt kāraṇānna sāmānyaṃ pācakādyabhidhānapratyayasya hetuḥ
ataḥ sambaddhasambandhopyasya sāmānyasya dravyeṇa saha nāsti
athāsatopi hetutvamiṣyate tadā tasya vastutvameva syānnāsattvaṃ
karmaṇaḥ sakāśādanyacca vyaktyādikaṃ jñānābhidhānayornimittatvena neṣṭaṃ sāmānyavādinā
tathā cetyanvayinoḥ pācakādiśabdajñānayoranimittatve sati na jātisiddhiḥ
te animitte pravarttete tathā gavādāvapīti kena nibandhanena jātiḥ kalpyeta
na hi dravyādanyaiva śaktiryadi syāttadā tasyā ekaśakteḥ pākādyarthakriyāsūpayogena kāraṇena dravyasya śaktyādhārasyānupayogitvaprasaṅgāt
evamapi pāramparyeṇa pākādau dravyamupayuktaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
kimityādi si ddhā nta vā dī
tathā hi pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ prathamāyāṃ śaktau dravyaṃ yayā śaktyopayujyeta
sāpi śaktiryadi vyatiriktā'bhyupagamyeta tadā pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktau dravyasyopayogāya śaktyantarasya dravyād vyatirekiṇo'bhyupagame'tiprasaṅgāt
tasyāmapi śaktāvupayogāyāparā vyatiriktā śaktiḥ kalpanīyā tatrāpyaparetyanavasthā syādityarthaḥ
tasmādantareṇa vyatiriktaṃ śaktiṃ dravyameva prathamāyāṃ pākādinirvirttikāyāṃ śaktāvupayujyata iti vācyaṃ
tato dravyāt pācakaḥ pācaka ityanvayī śabdo na syājjñānañca
pācakādiṣu dravyeṣu pācakatvādisāmānyamasti tadanvayi śabdajñānanibandhanamiti cedāha
tadā pākādinirvarttanaśaktyavasthāyāḥ prāgeva dravyasyotpattisamakāla eva dravyasamavetantad bhavedityarthaḥ
tathā ca tadaharjātopi bālaḥ pācakādijñānābhidhānaviṣayaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ
no cet prāgeva bhavet tadā paścādapi na bhavet
utpādasamakālameva dravyeṇa saha sambadhyata iti yāvat
sā mā nya vā di naḥ siddhāntaḥ
abhāve tau viśeṣaṇapratyayau na ca viśeṣaṇapratyayau viśeṣyasambandhamantareṇa bhavato na ca prāg gotvayogād vastu vidyate
na cāvidyamānaṃ gauriti vā'gauriti vā śakyate vyapadeṣṭuṃ
yadaiva ca vastu tadaiva sattayā sambadhyata iti
atha siddhāntamatikramya paścād bhāvitvaṃ sāmānyasya kalpyate
tasya sāmānyasyāśrayasya dravyasya paścādapyaviśeṣānna tatsamavāyaḥ syāt
yathā phalaikasvabhāvasyāpi raktatā prāṅ na bhavati
na hyaviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya tatsambandho na bhavet
tatraiva ca sāmānyasamavāyaviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya dravyasya paścāt sāmānyasamavāyo bhaviṣyatīti duranvayandurbodhametat
sāmānyasambaddhameva tadā dravyaṃ kriyopakārāpekṣantu sāmānyaṃ vyanakti
sā ca prāṅnāstīti na prāk sāmānyābhivyaktirityata āha
tatkṛto ya upakārastadapekṣasya sāmānyaṃ prati vyañjakatve'bhyupagamyamāne
atiśaye vā dravyasya kriyākṛtebhyupagamyamāne'tiśayādhāyakasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaṇikatvāt tasyāpyupakāryasya dravyasya svabhāvabhūtenānyenātiśayenotpattavyaṃ
yadi kriyākṛto'tiśayo na svabhāvabhūto dravyasya tadarthāntarasya karaṇād dravyaṃ naivopakṛtaṃ syāt
tasmād yathākriyākṣaṇaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ svabhāvabhūtasyānyānyasyātiśayotpattestadapi dravyaṃ devadattādi kṣaṇikaṃ syāt
svotpattisthānavināśinaḥ svasminnevotpattideśe vināśinaḥ puṃsaḥ kṛtaḥ pākalakṣaṇā kriyā
nanu ca prathamādikriyākṣaṇadvāreṇa dravyasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ kriyā'bhāve ca kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvamiti cet
yathetyādi si ddhā nta vā dī
yathā-pācakādiṣu pācakatvādisāmānyannāsti tathā prasādhitamatha ca tatra pravarttete anvayinau jñānaśabdau
tathā teṣu pācakatvādi sāmānyaṃ sa na sambhavatīti
yadyanvayi rūpannāsti tatkimidānīmanimitte te śabdajñāne syātāṃ
netyādi si ddhā nta vā dī
astyeva tayornimittaṃ yat pareṇeṣyate tasya pratikṣepaḥ
vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyambāhyatatvaṃ nimitte te na bhavataḥ
tato vikalpotpatteḥ sakāśād yathāvikalpaṃ śabdā bhavanti

tathā hi yathāsvaṃ samavāyavāsanāvaśāt siddhāntāśrayeṇa jñānavāsanānurodhād virodhirūpasamāveśena parasparaviruddharūpādhyāropeṇa pra dhā na kāryamī śva ra kāryamahetukaṃ samvṛttimātraṃ jagadityevaṃ sarvabhedeṣvanvayinostayoriti jñānābhidhānayoḥ
na ca tatreti pradhānādikāryatvena parasparaviruddhena rūpeṇa kalpiteṣvartheṣu
nanu yathāsvaṃ vāsanāprabodhād vikalpotpatterityādinā tayoranimittatvaṃ pratiṣiddhamityanavakāśameva codyaṃ
āntarameva nimittantayoriṣyate tasya ca nimittasya kenacidāsattiviprakarṣābhāvāt
nānimitte iti si ddhā nta vā dī
na cāsati tasminnanvayini bāhye nimitte vikalpena na bhavitavyambhavitavyameva
suptaśca taimirikaśca tābhyāmupalabdheṣvartheṣu gavādiṣu keśamakṣikādiṣu ca yathākramaṃ
yathā svaṃ siddhāntaṃ saṃketavāsanā tadbalenāropitarūpaviśeṣe pradhānakāryādiṣu
na ca te vikalpāḥ svapnādyupalabdheṣvasatsu vastubhūtānvayirūpamantareṇāpyutpadyaṃta iti sarvatrārthāḥ sarvākārā bhavantyapi tu pratiniyatā eva
api ca yathā dhavakhadirādayaḥ parasparabhinnāstathā gavādayaḥ
tatra tulye bhede kasmād vṛkṣatvaṃ dhavādiṣveva varttate na gavādiṣviti pṛṣṭena pareṇaitadeva vaktavyaṃ bhāvaśaktireva sā dhavādīnāṃ yena ta eva vṛkṣatvaṃ prati pratyāsannā na gavādaya iti
tadā tulye bhedye yayā pratyāsattyā bhāvaśaktilakṣaṇayā jātiḥ kvacit svāśrayābhimate'rtharāśau
tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syurviṣayādṛte
na hi yathā sāmānyamantareṇa keṣucit sāmānyavṛttiriṣyate
yena tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syuriti parasyottaraṃ syāt
kevalaṃ yathā parasya sāmānyamantareṇa keṣucit padārthaṣu yayā pratyāsattyā sāmānyavṛttiḥ saiva bhrāntānvayijñānaśabdanimittamastu kiṃ sāmānyenetyayamarthotra vivakṣita iti na kaściddoṣaḥ
yo hi tasya bījasyāṃkurajanana svabhāvo na hi sonyasya pṛthivyāderasti
yosti buddhyāropito vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo na sa janakaḥ
tasmād bījasvalakṣaṇameva janakaṃ yacca janakarūpantadeva vastu
sa pṛthivyādistenāṃkurajananena bījasvabhāvena tato bījādabhinnaḥ syāt
yadītyādinā si ddhā nta vā dī
sa ātmā teṣāṃ kāraṇānāmmadhye ekatrāpi kāraṇestīti
tenaikena kāryaṃ kṛtamiti kṛtvā vyarthāḥ syuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ

sambandho nāstītyeva svaśabdena na vai sambandhasya niṣedhaḥ
yathā sambandhasya svaśabdena svarūpeṇābhidhānannāsti tathā niṣedhepi
nānena deśena kālena vāsya ghaṭasya sambandhostīti pratītiḥ
tathā naivannā'nena prakāreṇa ghaṭostītyuktau naitaddharmā ghaṭa iti pratītiḥ
nedānīmityādināpi kathaṃ sambandho niṣiddho yāvadasya puṃsaḥ sambandho dharmo vā nāstīti matirbhavati
neha nedānīmiti pratiṣedhe sambandho nāstīti matiḥ
na cāsyāssambandho nāstīti mateḥ kathaṃcid bhāve sambandhādisattāyāṃ sambhavaḥ
sā tadabhāve sambandhābhāvapratītyabhāve na syāt yadvā seti sambandhābhāvapratītiḥ
vikalpānāmviṣayaḥ sambandhābhāvo na śabdā- nāmiti cedāha
yo na vitarkāṇāmviṣayaḥ sa eva na śabdānāmviṣayaḥ
savikalpanirvikalpayostu yaugapadyādabhimāna eṣa mandamatīnāṃ vikalpaḥ svalakṣaṇākāra iti
vicāritaṃ caitat pramāṇaviniścaye śāstrakāreṇeti neha pratanyate
nanu yadi vikalpabuddhyā viṣayīkṛtatvāt sambandhābhāvo vācyaḥ
evantarhi sambandhopi vācyaḥ syād vikalpabuddhyā viṣayīkṛtatvād
kathantarhyācārya di ṅ nā ge na tasyāvācyatvamuktamityāha
tena ca rūpeṇa tasyābhidhāyakaḥ śabdo nāsti
sambandhaśabdo hi tasyābhidhāyaka eṣṭavyaḥ sa ca prayuktaḥ kayorityākṣipati
tatra rājapuruṣayoḥ sambandha ityucyamāne rājapuruṣayorityasya vyatirekasya hetuḥ sambandhastadā sa sambandhaḥ sambandhirūpeṇa pratīyate
rājapuruṣayoḥ sambandha ityabhidhāne rājapuruṣābhyāṃ parasparasāpekṣābhyāṃ niṣkṛṣṭarūpasyaiva sambandhasya sambandhitvena buddhāvupasthānāt
rājñaḥ puruṣa iti parasparāpekṣālakṣaṇassambandho yathā jñātumiṣṭastena rūpeṇāpratītiḥ
tasmānnābhāvavat sambandhepi prasaṃga iti sambandhābhāvo yathā buddhyā viṣayīkriyata iti vācyaḥ prasakto naivaṃ sambandhepi vācyatvamityarthaḥ
sambandhābhāvo hi svena rūpeṇa buddhyā viṣayīkriyate
tataśca yadi nāsti sambandha iti matistadā tatprabhavopi śabdaḥ pravarttata eva
atha mābhūdayandoṣa iti sambandhasya nāstīti buddhyā viṣayīkaraṇaṃ neṣyate
api cābhāvamabhidheyaṃ yo brūte taṃ bruvāṇaṃ prati ayamabhāvānabhidhānavādī abhāvo na vācya iti pratividadhan pratikṣipannabruvāṇaḥ kathaṃ pratividadhyāt
na hyabhāvaśabdamuccārayatā abhāvasya vācyatvaṃ śakyaṃ pratipādayituṃ
atha pareṇābhāvasya vācyatvaṃ yaducyate tadanuvādena niṣedhaḥ kriyate
nanvanuvādepi kimabhāvasya vācyatā na bhavati yenaivamucyate
abhāvo hyasya vācyaḥ sa ca nābhyupagamyate
iyatā ca granthena yaduktanteṣvavaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyamiti tadevācā rye ṇa samarthitaṃ
yadyabhāveṣvapi śabdāssanti teṣvabhāveṣu kathaṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ śabdapravattiheturyenāpohaviṣayatvamabhāvapratipādakānāṃ syāt
yataste śabdā abhāvaviṣayā vyavacchedasyānyāpohasya vācakāḥ siddhā eva
kevalaṃ kecicchabdā bhāvādhyavasāyād bhāvaviṣayāḥ kecidabhāvādhyavasāyādabhāvaviṣayā ucyante
vastuni vṛttirvyāpāro yeṣāṃ śabdānānteṣāṃ kiṃ rūpamabhidheyaṃ vidhirūpeṇa vastugrāhyamāhosvid bhedo'nyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvodhyavasīyata iti śaṅkā syāt
abhāvastu vivekalakṣaṇa iti svabhāvavirahalakṣaṇaḥ kasmānnimittīkarttavyasya rūpasya vastusvabhāvasya
tasya rūpasya bhāvastadbhāvaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇaṃ yasya bhāvasya sa tathoktaḥ
tathā hyakṛtakavyavacchedena yadeva vastu kṛtakaśabdasya vikalpasya vādhiṣṭhānantadevānityānātmādiśabdānāmvikalpānāṃ ca
te tathābhūtā api bhinnaviṣayā eveti sambandhaḥ
yā vyāvṛttiryato vyavasthāpyate sā tasyā avadhiḥ
teṣāṃ yathāsvamavadhīnāṃ bhedāstairbhedairupakalpitā racitā anitya tvādīnāṃ vivekināṃ bhedāḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣāḥ
yadvā kāraṇena kṛtaḥ śabdo na bhavatītyasya samāropasya vyavacchedena kṛtako dvitīyādikṣaṇe sthāyitvasamāropavyavacchedenānitya ityucyata ityastyevāvadhibhedaḥ
teneti yathoktena vyāvṛttibhedena svabhāvahetau svabhāvasyaiva sādhyasādhanabhāvepi na sādhyāsādhanayoḥ saṃsarga ekatvaṃ
tataśca yaduktaṃ svabhāve sādhye pratijñārthaikadeśo hetuḥ syāditi sa doṣo nāstītyāha
yadyapi kṛtake sattvamasti satsu ca kṛtakatvantathāpi hetukṛtoyaṃ svabhāva ityetāvanmātravivākṣāyāṃ kṛtako heturucyate
sāmarthyamastyetāvanmātravivakṣāyāñca sattvaṃ heturucyate tena tu hetukṛtatvavivakṣāyāṃ
kṛtake sattvaṃ vidyate na ca tasyānityatve vyabhicārosti
svabhāvaniṣpattau svabhāvaniṣpattinimittamapekṣitaḥ paravyāpāro yena bhāvena sa kṛtakaḥ
saṃjñāyāṃ kano vidhānāt saṃjñāśabdoyaṃ kṛtaka iti
yata evanteneyaṃ kṛtakaśrutiḥ svabhāvābhidhāyinyapi satī paropādhimatyantaviśeṣaṇamenaṃ svabhāvamākṣipati
pratyayānāṃ kāraṇanāmbhedastena bhettuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathoktastadbhāvastattvaṃ
sāmānyena anitya eva sādhye yathā sattvaṃ
kṛtakatvādau parabhūta upādhirahitatvātmabhūta eva dharmaviśeṣa ityetāvān viśeṣaḥ
yadi sattākhyaḥ svabhāvo hetuḥ sattvamiti yāvat
atha sattā-sāmānye sādhye siddhasādhyatā syādataḥ sattāviśeṣassādhyastasmiṃśca sādhye viśeṣasyānanvayāt sādhyaśūnyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ syādato na sattā sādhyate
tadā hetāvapi sattve viśeṣasyānanvayāt sādhanaśūnyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt
asti pradhānamityādinā pradhānalakṣaṇayogena viśeṣībhavati na ca viśeṣaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyate tasyānanvayāt
asti pradhānamityanena pradhānasvalakṣaṇameva sādhyata iti yatsāṃ khye noktaṃ tatpramāṇasyānumānasya viṣayājñānāt
bhāvaḥ sattā saā upādānamviśeṣaṇaṃ yasya dharmiṇastanmātre
sāṃ khya sya na kaścidarthaḥ siddhaḥ syāt
kintu sa vādī tathā sāmānye nāsti kaściditi kañcanāsya dharmiṇo bhedaṃ viśeṣaṃ nityatvādikamaparāmṛśannasaṃspṛśan
triguṇātmako nitya ityādi nopāttabhede sādhyesmin pradhānādike dharmiṇi
anye tu sattāyāmityādi paścād dharmādau vyākhyāya
sa ca dharmī tatheti viśiṣṭena svabhāvena nānveti sapakṣe
evaṃ prasaṅga iti yaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavikalpena sattāyāmuktaḥ
na ca tena siddhena kiñcit tasyāpravṛttyaṅgatvāt
viśiṣṭa ādhāro yatrāgnyādikaṃ sādhyate sa viśeṣaṇaṃ yasyāgnyādikasya sa viśiṣṭādhāraviśeṣaṇaṃ
na vai sa ādhāro viśeṣaṇabhāvena gṛhītopi tamagnimviśeṣīkaroti
tasya dharmasya tasmin dharmiṇyayogo ya āśaṃkitastasya vyavacchadena viśeṣaṇāt
yatra yatra dhūmastatra ta-trāgniriti vyāptiṃ pratiyatā sāmānyenābhimatadeśāyogavyavacchinnopi bahnirākṣipta eva
tadayogavyavacchedeneti tasmin pradeśādau dharmiṇi sādhyadharmasyāyogavyavacchedena sāmānyasyāgnimātrasya sādhanāt nāstyanvayadoṣaḥ
tatkimidānīṃ jñeyannirviśeṣaṇamastītyetāvatā pra dhā na sya siddhirastu
jñeyādyartho hi pradhānārthaḥ śabdārtharūpaḥ syānna nityādiguṇopetaḥ
pradhānantāvatsiddhambhavatyanye ca dharmā anyaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ setsyaṃte iti cedāha
anyatra tu tadevāgnisāmānyaniyatādhāramasiddhantatra deśe na siddhamiti sādhyate
nanu tatrāpi tadayogavirahiṇeti tena pradeśenāyogastadayogastena virahaḥ pradeśena yoga ityarthaḥ
na vai kaścinnyāyajñaḥ tathābhūtena pradeśasambandhinā'gnisāmānyena vyāptiṃ karoti
tasmāt paraṃ prativādinaṃ pratipādayatā dhūmognināntarīyakognyavinābhāvī darśanīyaḥ
sa dhūmastatheti sarvopasaṃhāravyāptipradarśanenāgnimātreṇa vyāptaḥ siddho yatraiva pradeśe dharmiṇi svayaṃ svena rūpeṇa dṛśyate tatraivāgnibuddhiñjanayati
tatraitasyāṃ sāmarthyādanumeyapratītau sādhyanirdeśena na kiñcit prayojanantena vināpi sādhyasiddheḥ etadevāha
tatra sādhyadharmiṇi liṅgasya darśanāt sambandhākhyānamātrācceṣṭasya sādhyasya siddheḥ
yataśca na sādhyasya dharmadharmisamudāyasya nirdeśastadā tadanirdeśe ca kathantadviśiṣṭe sādhyadharmeṇānvayaḥ
taditi tasmādayandhūmognyavinābhāvitayā siddhaḥ sāmarthyādeva tena pradeśenāyogamvyavacchinatti
yadi hi tatra nāgniḥ syānnaiva dhūmo bhavediti sāmarthyaṃ
anvayastu kevalenaiva sādhyadharmeṇa darśanīyo na sādhyadharmadharmisamudāyena
sādhyanirdeśapūrvakāle vānvayasyeṣyamāṇe naiva sādhanavākyāt kaścit pratijñāvākyamapanayet
tathā cāha ācārya di gnā gaḥ
liṃgasya dhūmādeḥ sādhyenāvyabhicāronyatra sāmānye na dharmimātre darśayitavyaḥ
niścitāvyabhicāraṃ ca liṅgantatreti sādhyadharmiṇi prasiddhaṃ sat
tadevaṃ siddhasādhyatāprasaṃgādananvayācca na pra dhā nā deḥ sattā sādhyā
asiddhe pradhānādau dharmiṇi na bhāvadharmostītyasiddho hetuḥ
yastu bhāvābhāvobhayāśrayo dharmaḥ sa sattve sādhye vyabhicāryanaikāntiko yopyabhāvasya dharmaḥ sa sattve sādhye viruddho sattvasyaiva sādhanāt
yasyāṃ pradhānādisattāyāṃ sādhyāyāṃ heturyaḥ kaścidupādīyate sa sarvo doṣatrayaṃ nātivarttate
iha ca hetoḥ siddhatvamabhyupagamya viruddhānaikāntikāntikatve ukte hetvasiddhāvanayorasambhavāt
nanu sarvajñādisattāyāmapi sādhyāyāṃ hetorasiddhatādidoṣasya tulyatvāt kathantatsattāsiddhiḥ
tasmāttadapi jñānapūrvakameva yasya tajjñānaṃ sosmābhiḥ sarvajñobhyupagamyata iti
bhāvadharmaḥ pra dhā nā dessiddho na tu bhāva ityāha
yo hi pradhānādibhāvadharmmahetuntatra pradhānādāvicchati sa kathaṃ vādī pradhānādikambhāvaṃ siddhaṃ necchet
kathantarhi bhāvasyāyaṃ dharma iti kathyata iti cedāha
kadācidapekṣayeti bhedāntarapratikṣepalakṣaṇayā vyatirekīva bhinnarūpa iva dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād dharmo nirdiśyate
yathā kṛtakatvamasye- tyakṛtakavyāvṛtta eva bhāva ucyate
natvanya eva dharmo dharmaśabdenocyate'nyaśca dharmī dharmiśabdenetyāha
yasmādanyavyāvṛttinirapekṣaḥ pumān yadā śabdasyākṛtakādevaikasmād vyāvṛttiṃ jijñāsate
yadānyavyāvṛttisākāṃkṣo'kṛtakatvādevaikasmād vyāvṛttiṃ jijñāsate tadā kṛtakaḥ śabda ityucyata iti
dharmo hi svabhāvo yaśca bhāvasya svabhāvaḥ kathamabhāvasya syādityāha
prasajyopasarjano vidhiḥ paryudāsaḥ sa ceha nāśritaḥ
yathā na bhavati mūrtta ityamūrttatvaṃ mūrttatvanivṛttimātraṃ bhāvepi vijñāne nirūpākhyepyabhāvepi syāt
taditi tasmādetadanantaroktamavyavacchedamātraṃ dvayorapi bhāvābhāvayoḥ sambhavat sattve sādhye gamakatvaṃ kathamātmasāt kuryāt
vipakṣe prayoge vṛttirhetostasya śaṅkā tasyā api vyavacchedena na labhyanna cobhayadharmasya vyavacchedamātrasya vipakṣād vyāvṛttirastīti kathantad gamakatvamātmasāt kuryāt
sattāsādhanasya hetorubhayadharmatāṃ bruvāṇassataḥ sādhyādanyatrāpyasati asyobhayadharmasya hetorvṛttimbhāṣate
sa eva ca sattāyāṃ sādhyāyāmavyabhicāranibandhanatvād gamakatvasyetyavyabhicārambhāeta iti hetoḥ kathaṃ nonmattaḥ
abhāvadharmantu hetuṃ sattāyāmvadatosya vādino viruddhaḥ syāt
vyavacchedaṃ kīdṛśambhāvamātravyāpī sāmarthyalakṣaṇastasya vyavacchedo niyamenābhāvasyaiva bhavati
tasya bhāvamātravyāpyarthavyavacchedasya bhāve kvacidabhāvādabhāve ca sarvatra bhāvād viruddhatvaṃ
tasmādayaṃ triprakāropi bhāvābhāvobhayasambandhī dharmaḥ sattāyāssādhranena hetulakṣaṇamuktaḥ
na ca triprakārādadharmādanyā gatiranyaḥ prakārosti yatastasmānna sattā sādhyate
dharmisamāśraye vā pakṣadharmatve vā'niścite sati tatsvabhāvatayā niścitatrairūpyasvabhāvatayā yo gamako'bhimato heturna sa kaścid gamakaḥ
ata eva kāraṇāt svadharmeṇa svena sādhyarūpeṇa vyāptaḥ sādhyadharmiṇi siddho niścito hetusvabhāvo vācyaḥ

prakāśatayā prabhāsvaratayā ghaṭādīnprakāśayan yadā kadācid ghaṭādyudarāntarvarttī bhavati tadā tadrūpāpratipattau prabhāsvaratā'pratipattau satyāṃ svāmarthakriyāṃ ghaṭādiprakāśanalakṣaṇāṃ na hi karoti
yosau gamako vyāpyaḥ svabhāvastasya vyāpakaḥ svabhāvaḥ niścito gamyaḥ
ayamiti vyāpako dharmaḥ svayaṃ nivṛttau satyāṃ tasya vyāpyasya nivarttakaḥ
ayaṃ vyāpako dharmaḥ svayannivarttamānastasya vyāpyasya nivarttaka iti sambandhaḥ
yasmādevaṃ hyasyāyaṃ sādhyo dharmo vyāpakaḥ siddho bhavati

anenānantaroktenānuvarttyānuvarttakabhāvasya nivarttyanivarttakabhāvasya ca pradarśanena dvividhasyāpi sādharmyavato vaidharmyavataśca sādhanaprayogasya gamakalakṣaṇaṃ sādhyasādhakatvalakṣaṇamuktamveditavyaṃ
yathāhureke iti nai yā yi kāḥ
tathā vaidharmyaprayogepi pakṣadharmatvaṃ vyatirekaśceti dvirūpantarhi liṅgamprāptamityāha
tasmāttāvevānvayavyatirekau kadācitsādharmyaprayogeṇa pratipādyete kadācid vaidharmyaprayogeṇeti prayogamātrambhidyate na tvarthaḥ
evaṃ hi sādhyenānvito hetuḥ syād yadi sādhyābhāve na bhavet
tasminnityanvaye yadi hi sādhyena hetoranvayaḥ syāt tadāyaṃ sādhyanivṛttau nivartteta
etacca vya ti re ka ci ntā yāmvakṣyāmaḥ
yatkiñciditi sarvopasaṃhāreṇa vyāptikathanenārthānnityād vyāvṛttiḥ kṛtakatvasyokteti vyatirekamatiḥ
anityatvena vyāptaṃ kṛtakatvaṃ yadā śabdena kathitantadā niyamena svaṃ vyāpakaṃ sannidhāpayatīti sāmarthyādevānityaḥ śabda iti bhavati
tadabhāva ityanityatvābhāve sati na bhavataḥ kṛtakatvasya śabde ca bhāvakhyātau sadbhāvakathane kṛte sati tadātmanaḥ sata ityanityasvabhāvasya sataḥ kṛtakatvasya śabde bhāva iti
yata evantasmāt svayantādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ hetoḥ sādhye niyamaṃ pramāṇena prasādhya sādhyanivṛttyā mūḍhaṃ prati hetornivṛttirvaktavyā
prasādhya śabdārthādākṣepavacanastenāyamartho niyamaṃ prasādhya niyamamarthādākṣipya nivṛttirvaktavyeti
idānīmiti niścite vyāpyavyāpakabhāve gamako heturityabhyupagame satītyarthaḥ
kathaṃ kena pramāṇena kṛtakovaśyamanitya iti pratyetavyo niścetavyo yena tvayaivamucyate
kuta eva tadahetutvād yato na janakāddhetoranyo vināśasya hetuḥ
vināśarūpatayā ca na pratītiḥ syāt ghaṭasya sattvāt

nirhetuke tu vināśe svarasato nivarttamāna eva ghaṭo mudgarādisahakārī kapālajanakatvena sadṛśakṣaṇānārambhakatvāt mudgaravyāpārānantaraṃ ghaṭanivṛtteḥ kapālasya ca sadbhāvāttayorvināśarūpatayā vināśasya ca sahetukatvena mandamatīnāmavasāyo yujyata eva
naśyanta iti yeṣāntāvat kṛtakānāṃ nāśo dṛśyate te vinaśyantaḥ
yataśca naśvarasvabhāvaṃ pratyanapekṣatā bhāvānāntasmād yaḥ kaścid kṛtakaḥ sa svabhāvenaiva naśvaraḥ
tasmāt nirapekṣobhāvo vināśe vinaśvare svabhāvo hetusāpekṣatve hi ghaṭādīnāmmadhye keṣāñcinnityatāpi syāt
taddhetoriti vināśahetosteṣāmapi vināśakāraṇānāṃ nāvaśyaṃ sannidhānamiti sambandhaḥ
na ca vināśakāraṇāntaṃ kāraṇāni sarvatra sannihitāni
yato na hyavaśyaṃ hetavaḥ phalavantaḥ vināśākhyakāryavantaḥ
sarveṣāṃ nāśahetūnāṃ nāśasya liṅgatvena ye hetava upādīyante teṣāṃ
na sambhavati pratibaddho yasyāṃ sā kāraṇasāmagrī
anyānapekṣaśca kṛtako bhāvo vināśa iti svabhāvahetuḥ
kvacit kārye'napekṣāṇāmapi keṣāṃcit kāraṇānāṃ nāvaśyantadbhāva ityāha
tatra yathoktāyāṃ sāmagryāṃ santānasya pariṇāmaḥ svabhāvāntarotpattilakṣaṇastatra sāpekṣatvāt
kṛtakasyāpyasti vināśaṃ prati kālāntarāpekṣā tato heturasiddha ityāha
kṛtakasya bhāvasya nāśe kācit kālāntarāpekṣeti vakṣyati
na bhūmibījādaya ekasvabhāvāḥ paścādiva prāgapi kāryotpādanaprasaṅgāt
tatreti tasyāṃ santānapariṇāmena bhinnāyāṃ sāmagryāmantyā yā sāmagrī
kāryotpādane lakṣaṇāntareṇāvyavahitā sā phalavatyeveti kuto hetoranaikāntikatvaṃ
pūrvā sāmagrī janikāpi satī na niyatetyāha
saivetyantyā sāmagrī tatra tāsu madhye'ṅkuraheturnānyā kācit
tena kāryotpādaniyamābhāvāt sādhyaśūnyo dṛṣṭānta ityāha na cetyādi
vikārasyotpattau vā tasyāntyasya kṣaṇasyaikatvahāneḥ pūrvasya pracyutervikārākhyasya ca dvitīyasyotpatteḥ
svabhāvādapracyutasya tadutpādanaṃ kāryotpādanaṃ prati vaiguṇyamakurvāṇasya pratibandhahetorapratibandhakatvād vighātakaraṇāt
te nirapekṣā api na śālyakuraṃ janayantītyanaikāntika eveti
kathamiti si ddhā nta vā dī
eṣāmiti yavabījādīnāṃ śālibījasya yastadutpādanaḥ śālyaṅkurotpādanaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa evaiṣāṃ nāstītisambandhaḥ
kadā ca kathaṃ nirapekṣatvaṃ syādevantarhīti paraḥ
sa eva svabhāvo nāsti yo naśvaraḥ
tasmāt tatsvabhāvāpekṣatvād vinaśvarasvabhāvāpekṣatvānna vinaśvarā ityasiddhatvaṃ hetoriti
sa svabhāva ityabhimatetarakārya jananājananasvabhāvaḥ svahetoriti kṛtvā
na hetukṛtaḥ svabhāvabhedo bhāvānāṃ kintu svabhāva eva kasyacit
kvacicca śālibījādau dravye śālyaṃkurotpādanasya svabhāvasya niyamo na syāt
yathā śālibījādīnāṃ svabhāvaniyamastathātrāpi kṛtakeṣu, satsu vā niyamaheturvaktavyo yato niyāmakāddhetoḥ kṛtakāssanto vā kecinnaśvarātmāno jātā nānye
yadi nāma niyāmako heturna śakyate darśayituntathāpi sambhāvyata ityāha
na cātra loke naśvarasya svabhāvasya niyāmako heturasti
yadi sarvajanmināṃ vināśasiddhirevantarhi sattvāditi heturanaikāntikaḥ syāttadāha
na hi janmavaśād bhāvasya svabhāva utpadyate
tasmānnātra kṛtakeṣu satsu vā hetornaśvarānaśvarajanakatvena svabhāvapravibhāgaḥ
tadbhāvāddhetupravibhāgābhāvāt phalasya kṛtakasya sato vā naśvarānaśvarapravibhāgo nāstītyasamānaṃ yavabījādinā
kadācit kāle vināśasya yo bhāvastena virodhinī karoti tadabhāvaṃ
tasya kvacita kadācicca vināśasyābhāvaṃ svabhāvena sattayā sādhayati
tatkāladravyāpekṣa iti yasmin kāle bhavati yatra vā dravye
taṃ kālaṃ dravyañcāpekṣata iti nirapekṣa eva na syādityuktaṃ prāk
nanu vināśakahetvanapekṣatvena vināśasyānapekṣatvaṃ, na tu kālādyanapekṣatvena
tatkathamucyate tatkāladravyāpekṣa iti nirapekṣa eva vināśo na syāditi
yadi ca kālānapekṣo vināśaḥ dvitīyepi kṣaṇe vināśo na syāt tatkālāpekṣatvāt
dravyānapekṣatve ca kasya tarhi vināśaḥ syāt
dvitīya eva kṣaṇe vināśo bhavati nānyasmin kṣaṇe
tathā sarvasya jātasya bhavati na dravyaviśeṣasya
tena dravyā'napekṣatve kasya tarhi vināśo bhavatu
kālāntare dravyaviśeṣe ca nāśasya bhāve kālāntarasya dravyaviśeṣasya ca vināśakatvameva syāt
tasmāt tatkāladravyāpekṣatve nirapekṣa eva na syādityucyate
sato hi bhavata iti sattāṃ pratipadyamānasya tādṛśasyaiva naśvarasvabhāvasyaivaā bhāvāt
nāvaśyaṃ sataḥ padārthasya kutaścit kāraṇād bhāva utpādana iti cet
keciddhi santopi notpattimanto yathākāśādaya iti paro manyate
neyaṃ sattā kasyacidarthasya kadācit kāle kvacid dravye virameta
nanu ca ghaṭādīnāṃ svahetutaḥ sattāniyame kathamākāśādisattāprasaṅgaḥ
na sa kaścid bhāvo yatsvabhāvosāvākāśādirna syāt sarvātmakaḥ prasajyata ityeke
yadi hi ghaṭādirūpamākāśe syādahetukaṃ syāt tasya mṛtpiṇḍādikamantareṇa bhāvāt
kasyacidātmādeḥ kadācit kāle kvacid deśe virameta
yadi sattāhetoreva vinaśvarasyotpādaḥ kathamidānīmahetuko vināśa ukta iti vyāghātamāha
uktaṃ cātra prāk yathā na vināśo nāmānya eva kaścid bhāvāt kintu bhāva eva hi nāśaḥ
nanu ca pradhvaṃsābhāvo nāśaḥ sa kathambhāvasvabhāvo bhavatītyāha
yasmāt svahetoreva kṣaṇasthāyī jātastasmād bhāva eva nāśa uktaḥ
ya eva sattākālo bhāvasya tamevaikaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthātuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathā
yadyekakṣaṇasthāyī bhāvo vināśaḥ kasmāt pravāhavicchedāt prāgapi tathā na niścīyate'niścayāccākṣaṇikaḥ sa ityāha
taṃ nāśasvabhāvamasya ghaṭāderāsaṃsāramavidyānubandhāt mandā urdhvaṃ pravāhavicchedakāle vyavasyanti na prāk sattākāle
yataśca santānavicchedakāle nāśasvabhāvasya niścayastasmāt tadvaśena niścaya vaśena
paścāditi yasmiṃn kāle nāśasvabhāvasya niścayastatkālopādhireva sa bhāvasya vināśasvabhāvo vyavasthāpyate
yathā viṣadravyaṃ gṛhītamapi bhrāntisadbhāvāt prāganavadhāritamajñaiḥ puruṣaiḥ paścād viṣakṛtasya vikārasya lālāsrutyāderdarśanena viṣaṃ vyavasthāpyate tadvat
etāvanmātreṇāyaṃ dṛṣṭānto na tu māraṇaśaktirgṛhītā paścādavadhāryata iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ
vastuno yā sattā tadvyatirekeṇa na kicid vināśakāraṇamapekṣata iti tadvyāpī sattāvyāpī
na tāvadādyaḥ pakṣaḥ siddhe hi bhāve kārako nāśahetustambhāvaṃ na karoti siddhatvādeva
yato nāpyanya- kriyāntasya bhāvasya na kiñcit
bhāvarūpasya tatonyasya ca vināśasya kāraṇāccākiñcitkaro vināśaheturato nāpekṣyata iti siddhamasāmarthya
vināśa iti hi bhāvasyābhāvante hetumannāśavādino manyante
taditi tasmādayaṃ vināśaheturvināśaṃ karotyabhāvaṃ karotīti prāptaṃ
tatraitasmin prāpte sati yadyabhāvo nāma kaścit svabhāvaḥ kāryaḥ syāt
tadā kāryatvādaṃkurādivat sa eva bhāva iti nābhāvaḥ syāt
atha yathā ghaṭo ghaṭarūpeṇa kāryaḥ paṭaśca paṭarūpeṇa kāryo na tu kāryatvād ghaṭaḥ paṭo bhavati
tathā bhāvo bhāvarūpeṇa kāryo'bhāvopyabhāvarūpeṇa kāryaḥ syāt
tadayuktambhavatīti hi bhāvo na bhavatīti cābhāvastenābhāvo bhāvavirodhī
bhavanadharmatvenābhāvarūpatayā pratibhāsa eva na syāditīdameva codyate
yataścābhāvasya nīrūpatvādakāryatvantasmādabhāvaṃ karotīti bhāvaṃ na karotīti vākyārthaḥ syāt
kimiti nāśe'pekṣyate bhāveneti siddhā vināśaṃ pratyanapekṣā bhāvasya
nanu nirhetukepi vināśe kathamvināśaṃ pratyanapekṣā bhāvasya
svabhāvo hi sa tasyetthaṃ yenāpekṣya nivarttate virodhinaṃ
yato virodhyapekṣasvabhāvatvaṃ yadi vastuno na pūrvamapi tadāsya pūrvottararūpayorbhedād nityatvameva
atha pūrvamapi sa svabhāvosti tadā pūrvamapyasya nivṛttiḥ syāt
upakāre vā virodhisannidhānepyaparasya bhāvasyotpattiriti pūrvako bhāvastadavastho dṛśyeta
na ca kṣaṇikavādināṃ virodhisannidhāne sattā no nivarttate
tathā hi nirodhamupagacchanneva ghaṭo mudgarādisahakāryapekṣaḥ kapālajanakatvena sadṛśakṣaṇānārambhako bhavatīti santānānutpattirna tu virodhinamapekṣya pravāho nivarttate
yataśca pūrvaṃsantānenotpitsorbhāvasya virodhisannidhāne santānānutpattirata eva mandamatīnāṃ sahetukanāśādhyavasāyo mudgarādau ca virodhitvāvasāya iti sarvaṃ susthaṃ
tasmānnirapekṣatvādeva yatra nāma kvacid bhavaddṛṣṭo vināśastatraiṣa svabhāvata eva bhavati
nanvahetukepi nāśe yadaiva ghaṭādernāśaḥ pratīyate tadaivāhetukaḥ syānna pūrvamapratīterarthaikakṣaṇasthāyitvena ghaṭāderutpatteḥ pūrvamapi nāśaḥ
virodhi sannidhānāt pūrvamapi svabhāvata eva vināśo bhavati
yeṣāntāvadvināśo dṛśyate teṣāṃ yadi na pratikṣaṇaṃ vināśaḥ syāt tadā vināśapratītireva na syāt
tathā hi yadi dvitīye kṣaṇe bhāvasya sthitistadāsau sarvadaiva tiṣṭhet
aparasminnapi kṣaṇe kṣaṇadvayasthāyisvabhāvatvādaparasmin kṣaṇe'vasthānaṃ syādevamuttarottare kṣaṇe draṣṭavyamityāsaṃsārambhāvasya sthitiḥ syāt
atha prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasya kṣaṇadvayasthāyī svabhāvo dvitīye kṣaṇa ekakṣaṇasthāyī
na tvevamapi prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasyānekakṣaṇāvasthāyisvabhāvādakṣaṇikatvaṃ syānnāsaṃsāraṃ sthitiprasaṅgādityuktatvāt
nanu dvitīyepi kṣaṇe bhāvasyottarakṣaṇānavasthānepi pūrvakṣaṇasthāyī rūpābhedena pūrvamapi sthānāt kṣaṇadvayasthāyitvamastyeveti cet
pūrvambhāvasya hyeṣa svabhāvo yadekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhatyanyasmin kṣaṇe sthāsyati
sa eva cetsvabhāvo dvitīye kṣaṇe tadāpyekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhatyanyasmin kṣaṇe dvayaṃ sthāsyatītyevamuttarottarakṣaṇepi draṣṭavyamiti na vināśo bhāvasya syāt
adṛṣṭeṣu tarhi kṛtakeṣu kathaṃ pratikṣaṇavināśitvānumānaṃ vināśasyaivādarśanāt
naiṣa doṣo yasmāt teṣāmapi prathame kṣaṇe ya eva svabhāvaḥ sa eva cet dvitīyādikṣaṇe tadā'bhūtvā bhavanameva prathamakṣaṇavat
atha prathame kṣaṇe tasya janmaiva na sthitirdvitīye ca kṣaṇe sthitireva na janma
na ca dvitīye kṣaṇe janma vinā sthitiryuktā
dvitīyādau kṣaṇepyevamiti sarvatrotpattireva na sthitiriti kṣaṇikatvaṃ
kvacid ghaṭādau mudgarādisannidhāne tathānyatrāpīti mudgarasannidhānāt pūrvamapi
tata iti tasmād yā kācid bhāvaviṣayā kāryasvabhāvābhyāṃ liṅgābhyāṃ dvidhaivānumitiḥ
evaṃ svabhāvo liṅgaṃ yasyā iti vigrahaḥ
yathāsvaṃ vyāpini sādhya iti kāryasya kāraṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ sādhyaṃ
svabhāvasyāpi svabhāvo vyāpakaḥ sādhyastasmin sādhye liṅgini tayoreva kāryasvabhāvayorliṅgayoḥ pratibandhāt
tadbhāvānupalambhane tasya pravṛttiviṣayasya bhāvasya pratyakṣānumānābhyāmanupalambhane prekṣāvatā pravarttitavyaṃ netīyatā leśenādṛśyaviṣayāyā apyanupalabdheruktā pramāṇatā
teṣāṃ pratiṣedhe hi sarvaiva dṛśyaviṣayā'dṛśyaviṣayā ca
nanu kā ri kā yāṃ pravṛttirityuktantatkathaṃ vṛttau sanniścayetyādi vyākhyāyata ityāha
yasmāt satāṃ vidyamānānāṃ niścayācchabdavyavahārāḥ pravarttante tasmātte sanniścayaśabdavyavahārāstrayopi pravṛttyaṅgatvāt puruṣapravṛtternimittatvāt pravṛttirityuktaḥ
tasmānna sū tra vṛ ttyorvyāghāta iti
tasmāt tāvaddhi sa viprakṛṣṭo bhāvosya pratipatturnāsti yāvadatrāpratipattiḥ
yasmānna hyasti sambhavo yadupalabdhiyogyo bhāvaḥ sakaleṣvanyeṣūpalambhakāraṇeṣu san vidyamāno nopalabhyeta
tatra śāstrasyādhikārosmin prakaraṇe tatrāsambaddhā anāntarīyakā bahavorthāḥ svabhāvādiviprakarṣiṇaḥ śāstre nādhikriyanta iti yāvat
tasyeti śāstrasya kvacit puruṣārthānupayoginyarthe'nadhikāre viniyogābhāve pravṛtteḥ
evaṃbhūtāścetovṛttayo nāvaśyaṃ sākalyena pratipadaṃ nirdeśyā aśakyatvāt
kāladeśavyavahitā vā puruṣārthānupayogino dravyaviśeṣā nāvaśyaṃ nirdeśyāstato na tacchā stramviṣayīkaroti
pumān striye ti puṃsaḥ śeṣaṃ kṛtvā
pratyakṣamapi hi pramāṇaṃ sarvākāragrahepi yeṣvākāreṣu niścayamāvahati teṣveva
niḥśaṃkaparicchedamiti niḥśaṃkaḥ paricchedo yasya cetasa iti vigrahaḥ
saṃśaye sati na pravarttitavyama vaśyamityevaṃ niścitaṃ ceto na karotityarthaḥ
tathā tena rūpeṇaitadapravṛttikāraṇamanupalambhākhyaṃ niravadyaṃ nirdoṣaṃ yadi niścayapūrvaṃ vyavaharet kaścit
ityanena dvāreṇa seyamadṛśyānupalabdhirapravṛttiphalā proktā niścitasadvyavahārādipratiṣedhaphalā proktā
sandigdhastu sadvyavahārādirna niṣidhyata iti puruṣasya pravṛttirbhavatyapi
liṅgātiśayabhāvinīti liṅgamanupalabdhistasyā atiśayo viśeṣa upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvantasya bhāvassadbhāvassa yasyāmasti sā tathoktā
adṛśyaviṣayāyāḥ pratyakṣānumānanivṛtterayaṃ nyāya udāhṛta iti samudāyārthaḥ
tathā jñāpakasya liṅgasyābhāvāt svabhāvaviśeṣo vā pratikṣipyate
atra cetanānāṃ na svarūpaṃ pratikṣipyate tāsāṃ pratyakṣatvāt
mūṣikasyālarkkasya conmattakukkurasya viṣavikāra iva sa hi na viṣasaṃcārakāla eva bhavati kintu sahakāriṇaḥ kālaviśeṣasya sannidhauniṣpadyate
mūṣikādiviṣavikārasya kālāntare dṛṣṭatvāt sadbhāvo yukta eva
dānādiphalantu na kadācanāpi dṛṣṭamiti kathantasya sadbhāva ityāha
bhāve'stitve kiṃ pramāṇannaivāsti pramāṇamataḥ sattāniścayo na yukta iti paraḥ
yadi vā yad vastu nirākarttunna śakyate na ca tasya sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratibhāti
tasyaivaṃ sambhāvanā yuktā bhavedasya kadācit sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ kasyacit pratibhāvataḥ
anye tu viraktacitte'bhyudayahetutve cāta eveti sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt saṃśayostviti vyākhyāya
tacca pramāṇaṃ dvitīye paricchede'bhidhāsyata iti vyācakṣate
tattasmādatra evātīndriyeṣu madhye keṣāṃcidarthānāṃ svabhāvānāṃ ceti yadyapi pāṭhakramaḥ
na hi kāryadvāreṇaiṣāṃ niścayaḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāryotpādananiyamābhāvāt
na hi kāraṇairavaśyamātmajñāpakaṃ kāryaṃ santānāntare janayitavyamiti niyamaḥ
yasmāt pratyakṣānumānābhyāmanupalabdhānāmapi keṣāṃcidarthānāṃ punarapi paryāyeṇa krameṇa kuḍyavivarāvasthitānāmarthānāṃ pratyakṣeṇānumānenābhivyakteḥ pratīteḥ
kārye tu svabhāvādiviprakarṣiṇyapi kārakājñānaṃ kāraṇānupalabdhirabhāvasya sādhanameva
nanu viprakṛṣṭaviṣaye kāraṇānupalambha eva niścetumaśakyastatkathaṃ kāryābhāvaṃ sādhayet
tathā cāsatyapi kāraṇe kāryaṃ dṛṣṭamiti vyabhicāraḥ
asati kāraṇe kāryanna syādityanena vākyena kāraṇasthitikālabhāvi kāryaṃ
yāvat kāraṇasattā tāvat kāryasattetyevanna brūmo yena kāraṇanāśepītyādikaḥ prasaṃgaḥ syāt
kṣaṇikatve tu kāraṇe vinaṣṭe kāryaṃsthānameva nāstīti kuto vyabhicārāśaṃkā
yaśca paścāt sthāyī dhūmaḥ sa dhūmahetuka eva nāgnihetukaḥ
tasmād yasya kāraṇasya pāścātyamapi kāryamityevaṃ vyapa deśaḥ
yadyasya hetoḥ kathaṃcitpramāṇenābhāvaḥ sidhyet tadā tatphalantasya hetoḥ phalannāstīti niścīyate
arthasyeti vyāpakasya svabhāve'vyatirikte liṅginyasattvena sādhye svabhāvānupalambhaśca vyāpakānupalambhaścābhāvasya sādhanamiti prakṛtaṃ
yadyanupalabhyamāno vyāpakaḥ svabhāvosya vyāpyasya siddhaḥ syāt tadā bhavet pramāṇaṃ
kāraṇavyāpakānupalambhaśca bhavet pramāṇaṃ yadi tadabhāvastayoḥ kāraṇavyāpakayorabhāvaḥ pratīyeta hetunā kenacit
yadītyādinā kā ri kā rtha māha
soyaṃ kārako vyāpako vā'sanneva siddho yathākramaṃ kāryaṃ vyāpyañca nivarttayati
tadabhāvāsiddhau kārakavyāpakayorabhāvāsiddhau nivarttyepi kārye vyāpye ca saṃśayāt
yathāsva grāhakeṇa karaṇeneti yasya yad grāhakamindriyantenopalabhya eva bhavet
ya evāyaṃ svabhāvasyābhāvaniścaye dṛśyasya darśanetyādinokto'yameva heturveditavyaḥ
yasyābhāvassādhyastena yo viruddhastasyopalabdhau ca syādasattāyāḥ pratiṣedhyābhāvasya niścayaḥ
tayorviruddhayorye upādāne tayoranyonyaṃ parasparaṃ yad vaiguṇyantasyāśrayatvena
yadyapyatrānupalabdhiriti na śrūyate tathāpīdaṃ svabhāvaviruddhākhyaṃ liṅgamanupalabdhessakāśānna pṛthagucyate
asaditi kathaṃ kena pramāṇenāvagantavyaṃ yenaivaṃ syāddṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt
yathā svabhāvānupalabdhau nābhāvaḥ sādhyate kintvabhāvavyavahāra iti śrṛṇvannapi devānāṃ mūrkhāṇāṃ priyo nāvadhāraṇa paṭuryena satyapi dṛṣṭānte tadasiddhiścodyate
svanimittān svamanupalabdhirūpaṃ nimittaṃ yeṣāntānetānasadvyavahārān sādhayatīti kṛtvā sarvotra dṛṣṭāntaḥ
svakāraṇānāṃ sāmagrī tasyāṃ yogyaṃ sannidhānaṃ yasyāṅkurādessa tathoktaḥ
yasya yatra nimittaṃ sakalamapratibadvamasti tatra tena bhavitavyantadyathāṅkurādi
atrābhāvavyavahāra eva sādhyate na punarabhāva evetyāha
yata evātrābhāvavyavahāraḥ sādhyate'ta eveyamanupalabdhiḥ svabhāvahetāvantarbhavatīti sambandhaḥ
kāraṇād dṛśyānupalambhāt kāryasyāsadvyavahārasyānumānaṃ tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ yasyeti sāmānyenānyapadārthamupadarśya paścād bhāvapratyayaḥ
samagrāt kāraṇāt kāryānumāne ca yogyatānumānamiti svabhāvahetāvantarbhāvaḥ

sacchabdetyādi deśādiviprakṛṣṭeṣu pramāṇanivṛttyā sadvyavahāraniṣedhe sādhye kāraṇābhāvāt kāryasyābhāvaḥ sādhyastenātra na kevalannirupākhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ kintu nimittasya kāraṇasya vaikalyenābhāvinoṅkurādayopi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
tadasannirupākhyaṃ kathaṃ pratipattavyamiti tatrāpi nirupākhye dṛṣṭānte
saiva lakṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ śaśaviṣāṇāsattāyāḥ sā siddhaiva

sahakāriṇāṃ jñānotpādanahetūnāṃ pradīpādīnāṃ sambandhād yogyadeśāvasthānāt sakāśāt tadutpādanayogyatvena svānurūpajñānotpādanasāmarthyena ghaṭādiṣvapi vyaṃgyeṣu yotpattiḥ saiva yuktijñairnyāyavidbhirvyaktiriṣyate
svairvyañjakaisteṣāṃ jātyādīnāṃ korthaḥ ka upakāraḥ kṛtaḥ
sahakāriṇaḥ pradīpādeḥ sakāśāt kimbhūtādupādānāpekṣāt pūrvakojñānajananāsamartho ghaṭādilakṣaṇa upādānakāraṇaṃ samarthasya ghaṭādilakṣaṇasya ghaṭāpekṣatvāt
anyathā yadi pradīpādessakāśāt jñānotpādanayogyatāṃ na labhante ghaṭādayastadānapekṣya tadupakāraṃ pradīpopakāraṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ jñānajananaprasaṅgāt
atha pradīpādiḥ prāgasamarthasya vyaṃgyasya sāmarthyaṃ karotītīṣyate
atha mābhūdeṣa doṣa iti pradīpādikṛtasya sāmarthyasya vyaṃgyādarthāntaratvamiṣyate
yacca pradīpādikṛtaṃ sāmarthyamarthāntarantasmācca ghaṭādijñānotpattessāmarthyameva sarvakālaṃ gṛhyeteti svaviṣayajñānājananānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ nityamagrahaṇaprasaṅgāt
yeyaṃ ghaṭādīnāmālokānapekṣā prasaktā sā ātmānupakārāt pradīpādibhirghaṭādyātmanonupakārād vyatiriktasya hi sāmarthyasya karaṇena ghaṭādīnāṃ kaścidupakāraḥ
tata iti parasmāt svabhāvātiśayaṃ jñānajananayogyaṃ svarūpaṃ svīkurvanti
tena kāraṇenāsya pradīpādeste vyaṃgyābhimatā janyā eva
yadi janyāḥ kasmād vyaṅgyā ityevamvyapadiśyanta ityāha
vyañjakāt pradīpādessakāśājjñeyarūpasya grāhyarūpasyāsādanāllābhāttu kāraṇādavaśyaṃ tadviṣayaṃ jñānambhavati
yattu naivaṃbhūtantatkāryamevetyucyata ityevaṃ prasiddhyarthaṃ vyaṅgyāḥ khyāpyanta ityarthaḥ
tenānu pakāriṇā naiva vyaktā yujyanta iti sambandhaḥ
sambandhasya ca vastutve sambandhibhyāṃ sambandhasya bhedāt tṛtīyaḥ sambandhākhyo bhāṃvo jātaḥ
sa ca yadyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptastadā padārthatrayālambanatvena syād buddhicitratā
sa cāyaṃ śabdārthayossambandho vastu bhavanniyamena śabdārthābhyāṃ bhedābhedau nātivarttate krāmati
rūpaṃ hīti yato rūpaṃ svabhāvo vastu tasya svabhāvasyātattvamevātadbhāva evānyattvamityuktaṃ prāk
sa cāyaṃ sambandha aindriyaḥ san svabuddhau sambandhālambanāyāṃ buddhau
tasmātsambandhādanyassambandhī tato vivekenārthāntareṇa rūpeṇāpratibhāsamānaḥ kathantathā syāt tadanyaviveki rūpaṃ kathaṃ syāt
yadyatorthāntaramabhyupagataṃ dṛśyaṃ ca tasya tasmādaviveke satyadarśane ca yadi vivekaḥ sattā ca kalpyate
tathā hi dṛśyāvivekādarśane asyā vyavasthāyā nimitte
te ceti vivekābhāvayorna sādhanamiṣṭe tadā tadvyavasthocchidyate
atīndriyatvāt sambandhasya vivekena buddhāvavapratibhāsanepi na yathoktadoṣa indriyādivaditi cet
yathendriyañcakṣurādi rūpādibhyo vivekena buddhau na pratibhāsate'tha ca vyatiriktamasti
na hi yena saha yasya sambandho na gṛhyate taddvāreṇa tasya pratītiryuktā
sambandhasya sannidhimātreṇa sattāmātreṇārthajñāpanebhyupagamyamāne śabdārthasambandhampratyavyutpannānāmapyasyārthasyāyamvācaka iti pratipattiḥ syāt
sā tu na pratyakṣāt kintarhyanumānādityata āha
na hi kvacid dṛṣṭānte sambandhakāryā'rthapratītiḥ pratipannā
tadetad dṛṣṭāntarahitatvamindriyādiṣvatīndriyeṣu sattāsādhakenumāne kriyamāṇe tulyamiti cet
kintu jñānaṃ kāryabhūtaṃ pratyakṣaṃ keṣucidālokādiṣu satsu vyatirekānvayavat
na hi tatra sambandhaviśeṣe śabdarūṃpamartho vā liṅgaṃ
sarvasya śabdasya sarvasminnarthe vācakatveṃna yogyatvāt sarvasya cārthasya sarvasmin śabde vācyatvena yogyatvāt
arthaviśeṣapratīteśca kāraṇaṃ sambandhaviśeṣastasya cārthaviśeṣapratītisamāśrayasya sambandhasyāniyatābhyāṃ śabdārthā bhyāmapratyāyanāt
pratyāyane vā viśeṣābhāve na sarvasambandhapratītaḥ sarvārthagatiḥ syāt
sarvasya cārthasya sarvasmin śabde vācyatvena yogyatvāt-- added
yadi ca śabdārthānāṃ sambandhena saha sambandhaviśeṣaḥ siddhaḥ syāt kvacittadā sambandhaviśeṣapratītiḥ syāt
na hyasatyāṃ sambandhaviśeṣeṇa śabdānāṃ sambandhasiddhau sā sambandhaviśeṣapratītiryuktā

atha punassambandhamantareṇa śabdāt sambandhaviśeṣapratītiriṣyate tasyāmvā sambandhapratītāvanimittāyāmiṣyamāṇāyāntadviśeṣaḥ pratītiniyamavat sambandhaviśeṣapratītipratiniyamavad arthapratipādanamapyanimittaṃ śabdānāṃ kinneṣyate
tataścāviśeṣeṇa śabdaḥ sarvaṃ sambandhaṅgamayet tadā'viśeṣeṇaiva sarvasyārthasya pratītiḥ syāt
tasmād yathoktena nyāyena sambandhasiddhyā'rthapratīteḥ kāraṇānna kaścit puruṣorthapratītau saṃpradāyaṃ paropadeśamapekṣeta
na kevalasya śabdasya sambandhasiddhau liṅgatvaṃ kintu saṃpradāyasahitasya liṅgatvamiti cet
sampradāyastataḥ śabdasya liṅgatvantasmāt sambandhapratītistatorthasya pratyāyanamiti kimanayā paramparayā
sa eva śabdaḥ kevalo vastubhūtasambandharahitassampradāyāpekṣorthajñāpanaṃ kinna karoti yena sambandhoparaḥ kalpyate
sa ca śabdo yadabhiprāyairyadarthapratipādanābhiprāyaiḥ puruṣaiḥ prayujyamāno dṛṣṭaḥ samayakāle'nyathā na dṛṣṭa iti vivakṣitārthaviparyayeṇa prayujyamāno na dṛṣṭaḥ
sa eva darśanādarśanaśabdābhyāṃ sūcitaḥ śabdārthayoravinābhāvākhyaḥ sambandhaḥ
na cātrāpratītijanane yathoktamavinābhāvaṃ muktvānyasya vastubhūtasya sambandhasya sāmarthyampaśyāmaḥ
nāpi tasya sambandhasya siddhyupāyaṃ siddhinimittaṃ kiṃcit paśyāmaḥ
tāveva sambandhināveva śabdārthau kevalamiti na sambandho nāma kaścit
yattu na bhinnarūpaṃ kintu tadrūpaṃ sambandhirūpameveṣṭaṃ sambandhākhyamvastu
na tu vastubheda ekatrāviruddhaḥ kintu viruddha eva
ekasya paramārthena nānātvāyogāt na bhedābhedau muktvā vastunonyā gatiḥ
na rūpaśleṣalakṣaṇassambandho bhāvikaḥ kintu kalpanākṛta evetyuktaṃ prāk
puruṣasya vyavahārābhyāsādasaṃsṛṣṭāvapi saṃsṛṣṭau tau bhāsete tadvaśātsambandhavyavasthetyā dinā
na hi śleṣalakṣaṇassambandhinoḥ parasparammiśratālakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'śliṣṭeṣvasaṃsṛṣṭeṣu padārtheṣu sambhavati
yadi nāmārthāntaraṃ kasmāt parādhīnaṃ na bhavatītyāha
sa kathaṃ parabhāvasya sambandhinoḥ śleṣaḥ syāt
yasmānna svabhāvāntarasya tṛtīyasya sattayānyaḥ sambandhinoḥ svabhāvaḥ śliṣṭo nāmābhūdaśliṣṭenāsambaddhena sambandhākhyena śliṣṭo bhāvaḥ
tasyaiva sambandhākhyasya tābhyāṃ sambandhibhyāṃ śleṣā siddheḥ
yassambandhaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ san tau sambandhinau śleṣayet
sarvo yena kenacit tṛtīyena śliṣṭaḥ syāt
na hi sambandhābhimatasyānyasya ca padārthāntareṇa sambaddhatve kaścid viśeṣosti
varṇṇā ye santo vastusantaste tāvannirarthakāstato na te vācakāstena na tatra vācyavācakasambandhasya vṛttiḥ
kathaṃ sambandhasya vācyavācakatvalakṣaṇasya vastuno vastusvabhāvasya kathampravṛttirnaiva
vācako hi vacanāṃgenoktinimittena sambandhākhyena tadvān sambandhavān syāt
taditi tasmānna teṣu varṇṇeṣu vācyavācakabhāvasambandho varttate
tadvṛttau teṣu vācakeṣu varṇṇeṣu sambandhasya vṛttau satyāṃ sambandhasya yaṃdvācakatvāṅgatvantasya hāniprasaṅgāt
kramaviśeṣeṇānupūrvī viśeṣeṇaikaprayoktṛprayuktā varṇṇā eva vācakāstato na yathoktadoṣa iti cet
bhāvāstathā krame śaktā yaugapadye na śaknuyuḥ || sphoṭa0 73
rathāṅgāni hi dṛśyante śaktāni vahanādiṣviti || sphoṭa0 86
rasa ityatra yadrūpantataḥ kramāntare sā ityetasminnapi varṇṇavadaviśeṣāt tulyā syādarthapratipatiḥ
vyatiriktastarhi varṇṇebhyaḥ krama ityata āha arthāntaratvamapīti
tathā hi laukikāḥ kramaṃ kathayanto'yugapadutpādameva kathayanti
tasmāt pūrvāparayorbhāvayoḥ svarūpameva krama ucyate iti vakṣyati
pūrvāpararūpe ca krame tathāpi na varṇṇāḥ krameṇārthādhigamanimittambhavaṃti
yathā kevalasya bījasyāṃkuraṃ pratyakārakatvepi sahakārisannidhāne viśiṣṭatvāt kārakatvaṃ
tathā varṇṇāḥ pratyekamasamarthā apyānupūrvīviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭā arthapratītihetava iti
antyasya hi varṇṇasya varṇṇāntarasahitasya kevalasya coccāraṇe ko viśeṣo yatkṛtāvarthapratītibhāvābhāvau syātāṃ
na ca te yadā santastadā vyāpriyanterthapratītau
eṣa tarhi viśeṣo yeyaṃ kvacit pravṛttā pūrvavarṇṇopalabdhiḥ kvacinneti
aviśeṣe ca yatra kārye varṇṇānāṃ pratyekamaśaktistatra sahitānāmapyaviśeṣāt
tena na ca yatraikaśo śaktirityādi nirastaṃ
rathāṅgānāṃ hi viśeṣotpattau satyāṃ sāhityāvasthāyāmvahanādau sāmarthyamanyathā pratyekavat sāhityepi sāmarthyanna syāt
na ca parasparamvarṇṇānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo yena pūrve varṇṇāḥ pāramparyeṇārthapratītau śaktāḥ syuḥ
nāpi pūrvavarṇṇajanitasaṃskārasahitasyāntyasya varṇṇasyārthapratītihetutvāt pūrvavarṇṇānāṃ pāramparyeṇa sāmarthyaṃ
saṃketaśca sāmānyaviṣayo na varṇṇasvalakṣaṇaviṣaya iti kathamvarṇṇāḥ kramaviśeṣeṇa vācakāḥ
kevalasya varṇṇasyārthāpratipādakatve saṃskārasahitasyāpi na tat syāt
tatkathaṃ kaścidvarṇṇaḥ sākṣādarthapratipādane samarthaḥ kaścit pāramparyeṇetyucyate
evaṃ kramapratipannānāmvarṇṇānāṃ nityatvād vyāpitvāccākāśadeśe yā yugapat sthitiravasthānantadeva nimittamarthapratītiṃ pratīti
pratīyamāno hi śabdārthaṃ pratipādayati na sannidhānamātreṇa
nāpi nityatvaṃ vyāpitvaṃ ca yujyata iti vakṣyatītyasārametat
tatra jñāne ca varṇṇānāṃ yaugapadyaṃ pratīyate
tatra jñāne ca varṇṇānāṃ yaugapadyaṃ pratīyate
kecidāhuryayā varṇṇo gṛhyate'ntyaḥ pade pade || sphoṭa0 11
pratipadamantyo varṇṇo yayā buddhyā gṛhyate sā sannihitāsannihitavarṇṇaviṣayatvena smaraṇapratyakṣarūpābhyāmubhayarūpeti kecidāhuḥ
ata eva ca padādigrāhakajñānaṃ kalpitaviṣayaṃ syāditi
antyavarṇṇe hi vijñāne sarvasaṃskārakāritaṃ smaraṇaṃ yaugapadyena sarveṣvanye pracakṣate
tena śrotramanobhyāṃ ca kramād varṇṇeṣu yadyapi
kevalaṃ smaraṇenāspaṣṭasvabhāvānāmvarṇṇānāṃ svākārarūpāṇāṃ bāhyavarṇṇābhedenādhyavasāyāt bāhyavarṇṇānāmeva vācakatvamucyate
evaṃ mī māṃ sa ka pakṣe varṇṇānāṃ vācakatve niraste padādyapi nirastameva
asati varṇṇānāmvācakatve padādi vācakaṃ syāttacca padādi na kiñcit
sabhāgavāsanā sajātīyavikalpaśaktirupādānaṃ yasya vikalpasya sa tathoktaḥ
kramavarṇṇānubhavapṛṣṭhabhāvi manovijñānantān varṇṇān padādirūpatayaikasvabhāvānadhyavasyatīti padādiparikalpitaṃ mithyaiva

sāckastu mātrākālaḥ pratīyata iti kathamekavarṇṇarūpaṃ padamvidyate yadekabuddhigrāhyaṃ syāt
yadi vā naiva gṛhṇāti varṇṇamvā sakalaṃ sphuṭaṃ
