tato vedādhyayanaṃ ca syānna cādhyayanapūrvakamiti virodhābhāvāt sa eva vyabhicāraḥ
yasmānna hi viśeṣaṇaṃ vedatvamaviruddhaṃ vipakṣeṇānadhyayanāntarapūrvakatvena saha
ko hyatra virodho yad vedādhyayanaṃ ca syānna cādhyayanāntarapūrvakamiti
nāpyadarśanamātramabhāvaṃ gamayatīti kṛtvā vyabhicāra eva vedādhyayanatvādityasya hetoḥ
tasmāt vedatvaṃ viśeṣaṇa madhyayanasya hetoratiśayabhāg na bhavati viśeṣādhāyakanna bhavati
yatkiñcida vedādhyayanaṃ sarvantadadhyayanāntaraparvakamiti vedena viśeṣitepi hetau vyāptirna sidhyati
yādṛśaṃ tvadhyayanaṃ svayaṃ karttumaśaktasya tannimittamadhyayanāntaranimittaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tattathetyadhyayanāntarapūrvakameveti syāt
svayaṃ kṛtvādhyetumaśaktasya yadadhyayanantasya dṛṣṭe viśeṣajāḍyādilakṣaṇaṃ tannimittatayā parapūrvādhyayananimittatayā
tattyāgena tasya jāḍyādinimittasyādhyayanasya yathā paridṛṣṭe viśeṣasya tyāgena

dṛṣṭe'vagate viśeṣesvayaṃ kṛtvādhyayanalakṣaṇe tattyāgena tasya viśeṣasya tyāgena vedādhyayanatvasāmānyasya grahaṇaṃ śaktasyāśaktasya vā sarvaṃ vedādhyayanamadhyayanāntarapūrvakamvedādhyayanatvasāmānyāditi kriyamāṇaṃ vyabhicāryeva
agnisādhye dhūme yaḥ pāṇḍuviśeṣo dṛṣṭastattyāgena pāṇḍudravyasāmānyamupādīyamānamagnisiddhau yathā vyabhicāri tadvadityarthaḥ
yādṛśo rāgādiprabhavo vacanaviśeṣo dṛṣṭastattyāgena vaktṛtvasāmānyasya vyabhicārāt
parato vā śrutvādhīyate teṣāṃ puṃsāmavyāpatakaraṇānāmavyāpṛtatālvādīnāṃ svayaṃ śabdā dhvanayanti
kintu puruṣavyāpāreṇaiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ dhvananāllaukikavākyavat pauruṣeyatvameva
api syurapauruṣeyāssambhāvyata eṣāmapauruṣeyatvaṃ yadi puruṣāṇāmādiḥ syāt
tatprathamodhyetā tasya vedasya prathamodhyetā svayamabhyuhya vedamadhīta iti kartaiva syād vedasya
sopyanyamiti pūrvapūrvadarśanapravṛttonādiḥ puruṣavyavahāra iti puruṣairevāyaṃ racito vyavahāra iti syānnāpauruṣeya eva
ḍimbhakā bālāsteṣāṃ pāṃsukrīḍā yathā pūrvavatdarśanapravṛttatvādanādiḥ puruṣavyavahārastadvat
anāditvād vedasyāpauruṣeyatvebhyupagamyamāne mle cchā divyavahārāṇāmiti svakulakramāgatānāṃ mātṛvivāhādilakṣaṇānāmanāditvāt tathābhāvo vedavadapauruṣeyatvaṃ syāt
mṛte pitari putreṇa mātṛvivāhaḥ kārya iti
ma da na tra yo daśyāmparvaṇi madanotsavaḥ

te ca vyavahārāstāni ca nāstikyavacāṃsīti napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccānyatarasyāmiti napuṃsakasyaikaśeṣaḥ

svapratibhayā svabuddhyā racitassamayaḥ kāvyādilakṣaṇo yaisteṣāmapi tāvat puruṣāṇāṃ yathāśrutaḥ parasmāt samasto vyasto vā yorthaḥ
tatra ye vikalpāsteṣāṃ saṃhāra ekatropādānamvargīkaraṇamiti yāvat
tadevaṃ svapratibhāracitopi tāvad granthaḥ paramārthataḥ parapūrvaka eva
samyag mithyā ca pravṛttirācaraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ lokavyavahārāṇānte tathoktāḥ
na hi taiḥ pūrvebhyo vyavahārā upalabdhāsteṣāmeva prathamatvāt
tādṛśenāditvamātreṇa sarvavyavahārāṇāmapauruṣeyatve siddhepi ko guṇo bhavet
taccāpauruṣeyatvaṃ visamvādakānāmapi keṣāṃcillokavyavahāraṇāmastīti nāpauruṣeyatvamavitathatvasya sādhakaṃ vyabhicārāditi kintenāpauruṣeyatvena kalpitena
tadā vedavākyānāmevāpauruṣeyatve satyapi tadvācyeṣvartheṣu saṃśaya eva punariti bhūyaḥ
apauruṣeyatvamapi kalpayitvā bhūyaḥ saṃśaya eva prāpta ityarthaḥ
vedavācyārthālambanāmbuddhipravṛttikāmasya yadi janayettadā viparītārthasamāropābhāvādāśvāsanaṃ syāllabdhāśvāsaḥ puruṣo bhavet
ādiśabdād vai yā ka ra ṇā diparigrahaḥ
na ca te parasparavirodhino vyākhyābhedopanītā arthāsteṣāmvedavākyānānna saṃghaṭanta eva sambhavantyevetyarthaḥ
teṣāṃ ca niyatārthatvānna vedavākyeṣvanekārthavikalpasambhava ityapi mithyā
ruḍhimāśritya vedārthavyākhyānāt prakṛtipratyayānāmanekārtha- pāṭhepi na saṃśaya ityapyasat
arūḍhā eva ye loke śabdāste vede bāhulyena dṛśyante
api cāyaṃ ve da vā dyapauruṣetvaṃ sādhayan varṇṇānāmvā sādhayed vākyasya vā
satyapi pratyabhijñāne yadi laukikebhyo vaidikānāṃ varṇṇāṃnāṃ bheda iṣyate
atha syād vaidikeṣu varṇṇeṣvekatvanimittatvāt pratyabhijñānaṃ pramāṇamevānyatra tu sādṛśyena bhrāntatvādapramāṇamityata āha

teṣāñca varṇṇānāmapauruṣeyatvasādhanebhyupagamyamāne te varṇṇāḥ sarvatra loke vede ca tulyā iti kimanena mī māṃ sa ke naivamapauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhayatā pariśeṣitaṃ parityaktamvarṇṇajātaṃ yat pauruṣeyaṃ syāt
tathā vai laukikavaidikavarṇṇānāmapauruṣeyatve sati sarvaḥ śābdo vyavahāro laukiko vaidikaścāpauruṣeyo na ca sarvo'vitatho na ca sarvaḥ sattyārthaḥ
devadattādipadeṣu vākyeṣu ca dakārā-dīnāṃ varṇṇānāṃ yaḥ pratibhāsastaṃ muktvā'nyavarṇṇātmakaṃ pada vākyapratibhāsaṃ buddheḥ paśyāmaḥ
yathā dakāre pratibhāsamāne tatsamānakālameva dvitīyo varṇṇo na pratibhāsate
na cāpratibhāsamānaṃ grahaṇe buddhau grāhyatayeṣṭamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sadastīti śakyamavasātuṃ
yadi teṣu varṇṇeṣu satsvapi tadarthapratītilakṣaṇaṃ kāryanna syāt
yāvān varṇṇasamudāyorthapratipādanāya saṃketitastāvato yadyarthapratītirna syāt syādetat
yadi hi varṇṇebhyorthapratītiḥ syāt tadā sara ityasmin pade yādṛśyarthapratītistādṛśyeva rasa ityatrāpi syād ubhayatra varṇṇānāntulyatvāt
tathā hi ya ekatra vākye varṇṇā na ta eva vākyāntareṣu puruṣaprayatnabhedena varṇṇānāṃ prativākyambhinnānāmevotpatteḥ
sa evāyamvarṇṇa iti pratyabhijñānāt prativākyaṃ varṇṇānāmaviśaṣo'bhedaḥ siddha iti cet
dṛśyate hi lūnapunarjāteṣu keśeṣu bhinneṣvapi sādṛśyagrahaṇād vipralabdhasya pratyabhijñānaṃ
sādṛśyagrahaṇaṃ ca sadṛśasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na tvanyasadṛśa iti grahaṇaṃ
nāpi pratipadaṃ varṇṇaikatvagrāhakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ sambhavati
dṛśyamānasya cedānīntanakālatvād yaścedānīntanakālasambandhī svabhāvaḥ sa kathaṃ pūrvakālasambandhī
pūrvāparakālayoḥ parasparavirodhāt kathaṃ pratyakṣeṇa tattvagrahaṇa ucyate
na ca varṇṇasya sannidhānaṃ sambhavati sāṃśatvāt
tena na varṇṇeṣu pratipadamekatvagrāhakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ sambhavati
tasmāt sthitametat prativākyaṃ bhinnā eva varṇṇāsteṣāmeva bhedārthapratīterbheda iti
nanu varṇṇā nirarthakā ityuktantatkathanteṣāmeva bhedādarthapratīterbheda ityucyate
santo varṇṇā nirarthakā vikalpaviṣayāstu sāmānyarūpā eva prativākyaṃ bhinnā varṇṇā varṇṇasvalakṣaṇā bhedenādhyastā vācakā iṣyante
yadi tu varṇṇabhedādayamarthapratītibhedo neṣyate kintu varṇṇāviśeṣepi
anekāvayavātmatve vākyasya kalpyamāne teṣāmavayavānāṃ pṛthak pratyekaṃ nirarthakā yadi
tasya vākyasya bahavovayavāḥ pṛthak prakṛtyā svabhāvena yadyanarthakāstadā vākyamapyanekāvayavasamudāyātmakaṃ tadvadevānarthakaṃ
teṣu ca svayamanarthakeṣvavayaveṣu sorthavān vākyātmā kalpanāsamāropitaḥ syāt
iti hetossa vācaka ātmā kalpanāracitatvāt pauruṣeya eva
atha mābhūdeṣa doṣa iti pratyekaṃ vākyasyāvayavāḥ vākyārthena sārthakā iṣyante
tadā pratyekamavayavānāṃ sārthakatve mithyānekatvakalpanā ekasyāpyavayavasya parisamāptārthatvādavayavāntarāpekṣā vākyasya na yujyata ityarthaḥ
tathā yadeva prathamaṃ padamupādīyate tasmin sarvarūpārthopagrāhiṇi niyamānuvādanibandhanāni padāntarāṇi vijñāyanta iti
nāpi kaścidavayavaḥ kārakaviśeṣasyābhidhāyakonyaśca kriyāviśeṣasyābhidhāyaka iti vākyāvayavānāṃ pratyekaṃ sārthakatvāt sāphalyaṃ yuktaṃ
te cāvayavā vākyagatāstathāvidhā iti parisamāptārtharūpāḥ pṛthak pratyekaṃ
pratyekaṃ cāvayavānāṃ sārthakatve ekāvayavapratipattyā samastavākyārthapratipattyā samastavākyārthapratipatteravayavāttaraṃ prati apekṣā śroturna syāt
tasya vākyārthasya niṣkalātmano nirvibhāgasya kṣaṇenaikena pratipatteḥ
ekāvayavapratipattyā ca vākyārthapratipattau tasyāvayavasya kālakṣepaśca na syāt
anyatheti yadyekajñānakṣaṇena sarvasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt tadā gṛhītāgṛhītasvabhāvayorekatvavirodhāt
tadā sakṛcchrutau ca sarveṣāmavayavānāṃ kalpyamānāyāṃ kālakṣepo na yujyate
avayavāntarāṇāmapratīkṣaṇenaikasmādevāvayavād vākyārthasiddhervākyārthaniścayāt kāraṇād anekāvayavatvahānirvākyasyeti kṛtvā sarveṣāmvākyāvayavānāṃ sakṛcchravaṇamiṣyate
sakṛcchrutau sarvāvayavānāṃ yugapadgrahaṇebhyupagamyamāne pṛthak pratyekamartheṣu vācyeṣvadṛṣṭasāmarthyānāmavayavānāṃ sahitānāmapyarthavattā ca na sidhyati
kevalānāmavayavānāṃ yadrūpantatonyadeva samuditānāmarthapratipādanasamarthaṃ rūpamu papadyata ityata āha
tasya vādinaḥ pṛthagasamarthānāmapyasamarthānāṃ punaḥ puruṣaprayatnakṛtādupakāraviśeṣāt sahitāvasthāyāmarthapratipādanasāmarthyalakṣaṇenātiśayenātiśayavatāmarthapratītilakṣaṇe kāryaviśeṣa upayogāt
na hi tasya gṛhītāt svabhāvādagṛhītonyaḥ svabhāvosti yasya krameṇa grahaṇaṃ syāt
sarvasya vākyasya yo vyavahārakālo vaktuḥ śrotuśca śravaṇakālaḥ smaraṇakālaśca
anekaḥ kṣaṇo yasminnakṣinimeṣe sonekakṣaṇanimeṣaḥ tasyānukramaḥ paripāṭistenānukramaṇotpatteḥ kāraṇāt
varṇṇānāmidaṃ krameṇa grahaṇaṃ vākyasya tvakrameṇaiveti cedāha
na hi kramapratibhāsaṃ varṇṇakṛtaṃ muktvā'paro krama pratibhāsassampadyate śrotrajñāne
yatastadaviśeṣepi tvanmate na teṣāṃ varṇṇānāmaviśeṣepi varṇṇānukramakṛtatvād vākyabhedasyānukramavatī vākyapratītirna yugapadbhāvinī
tadā tairvarṇṇairyathākathaṃcit tatkramairanyakramairapi prayuktairyatkiñcid vākyaṃ pratīyeta
kramavadbhiḥ kramavānevopakāraḥ karttavyastathā copakāryasya kramavattvaṃ syāt
akramā eva varṇṇā vākyasyopakārakā bhaviṣyantīti cedāha
na ca kramākramopakāravyatirekeṇānyaḥ prakārostīti gatyantarābhāvānnopakārakā varṇṇā vākyasyeti sthitaṃ
vyañjakā dhvanayonukramavanto viśiṣṭenānukrameṇa vyañjayanti na vyutkrameṇa
sphoṭarūpāvibhāgena varṇṇānāṃ nādarūpāṇāṃ grahaṇād varṇṇavibhāgavacca puruṣasya pratibhāti
na hyavadhṛtarūpādanyadanavadhṛtaṃ rūpāntaramekasyāsti yena tatpaścād vyajyeta
varṇṇebhyo bhinnameva vākyaṃ pratibhāsate na tu dhvanisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ
avidyamānā varṇṇarūpā bhāgā yasmin vākye tasminnabhyupagamyamāne puruṣasyāsakalaśrāviṇo samastavarṇṇānukramaśrāviṇaḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ śroturityarthaḥ
ekatvād vākyasya yadi pūrvabhāgaśravaṇantadā sakalaśrutiḥ sarvātmanā vākyasya śravaṇaṃ syāt
atha na sakalaśrutistadā na vā kasyacichrutiḥ syāt
tena yaducyate ma ṇḍa ne na
vyañjakasādṛśyācca vākye tadātmagrahaṇābhimānastena nāśravaṇaṃ sakalaśravaṇaṃ veti
na hi vyaṅgyavyañjakayoḥ sādṛśyamvarṇṇāvarṇṇātmakatvena visadṛśatvāt tatkathaṃ vākye varṇṇātmagrahaṇābhimāna iti yatkiñcidetat
khaṇḍaśaḥ śroturapi sakalasya niṣkalasya vākyasya śrutiḥ syāt
atha neṣyate tadā na vā kasyacit puṃsaḥ syāt
sakalavarṇṇāśrāviṇopi na vā niṣkalasya vākyasya śrutiḥ syāt
yathā śloka ekadā prakāśito nāvadhāritonyadā prakāśane tvavadhāraṇasaho bhavati
samastairvarṇṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ vākyābhivyaktipūrvakā ye kṛtāḥ saṃskārā vidyante yasyā buddhessā tathā
tayā samastavarṇṇasaṃskāravatyāntyayā 'ntyavarṇṇaviṣayayā buddhyā niṣkalasya vākyasyāvadhāraṇamityapi kalpanā mithyā
varṇṇarūpasaṃsparśarahitasya śrotrajñāne kasyacit puruṣasya kadācidapyapratipatteḥ prativarṇṇoccāraṇaṃ pratibhāsābhāva ityarthaḥ ślokasya tūccāraṇaṃ pratibhāsosti
varṇṇānāṃ cākrameṇāpratipatteḥ krameṇaiva pratipatteḥ kāraṇāt kutokramamekabuddhigrāhyamvākyannāma
antyavarṇṇapratipatterurdhva mānasena jñānena niravayavasya vākyasyāvadhāraṇamastyeveti cedāha
tathā hi tadāpi vākyamavadhārayan varṇṇānukramameva bāhyarūpatayāvadhārayati
kevalamayaṃ vaktā yathā mayoktaṃ samāptakalaḥ śabdontyāyāmbuddhau bhātītyevaṃ yadi syāt
smaraṇajñānena tarhi padavākyamakramaṃ gṛhyata iti cedāha

na hi smaryamāṇayorapi padavākyayoḥ sambandhino varṇṇāḥ padavākyayorbhedavyavasthāpakāḥ kramaviśeṣamantareṇākramāyāmekasyāṃ buddhau na hi vibhāvyante kintvanubhavakramavat smaraṇamapi krameṇaiveti yāvat

tadā tasyāmakramāyāṃ buddhau paurvāparyābhāvād varṇṇā yugapadeva vibhāvyanta iti kṛtvā teṣāṃ padavākyabhedānāṃ padabhedānāṃ vākyabhedānāṃ ca tatkṛto varṇṇapaurvāparyapratibhāsakṛto bhedo viśeṣo na syāt
varṇṇānāṃ krama viśeṣapratibhāsādeva padavākyānāmparasparambhedastadabhāve sa na syāditi yāvat
na vidyate varṇṇakramo yasmin śabdarūpe tadakramaṃ śabdarūpamvarṇṇebhyonyanna paśyāma ityuktaṃ
yadyanityantadā puruṣaprayatnasambhūtaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ kathaṃ na tadvākyaṃ
tacca vākyaṃ puruṣaprayatnena preritānyaviguṇāni karaṇāni yeṣāṃ puṃsānteṣāmbhavad dṛṣṭaṃ punaranyathā vaktukāmatābhāve karaṇavaiguṇye vā neti
na dṛṣṭamiti puruṣavyāpārānvayavyatirekalakṣaṇasya kāraṇadharmasya vākyaṃ prati darśanāta puruṣavyāpāra eva vākyasya kāraṇamataḥ kāraṇāt pauruṣeyamapi vākyaṃ
atha nityantad vākyaṃ tadāsya nityatvebhyupagamyamāne nityopalabdhirvākyasya syāt
sa upalabhyaḥ svabhāvastasya vākyasya kadācinnāpaiti na hīyata iti kṛtvā nityamupalabhyeta
yasmādevaṃ hi sa nityaḥ syād na kutaścidapi jñānajananalakṣaṇādapi sāmarthyāt pracyavet
satopi vā vidyamānasyāpi cāvaraṇasya tadātmānamakhaṇḍatayo nityaśabdātmānamapracyāvayataḥ
akiṃcitkaraścārthaḥ kaḥ kasyāvaraṇaṃ jñānavibandhakamanyadveti prakārāntareṇopaghātakaṃ naiveti yāvat
te kuḍyādayaḥ kañcid ghaṭādikamatiśāyayanti viśiṣṭaṃ svabhāvaṃ kurvantīti na brūmaḥ
tatra śaktasvabhāvasya nityaṃ kāryajananaṃ syādajananamanyasyetyaśaktasvabhāvasya syādityuktaṃ prāk
tena pratighātinā kuḍyādinā'vyavahitā yadā bhavanti tadānyonyasyopakāriṇaḥ
na vidyate vyavadhānaṃ yasya deśasya sovyavadhānadeśastasya yogyatā sāmarthyantatsahakāritvāt teṣāṃ viṣayādīnāmanyonyātiśayotpatteḥ
yata evaṃ kṣaṇikeṣu na sarvakālamekasvarūpānuvṛttistasmāt parvotpannasya samarthasyendriyādikṣaṇasya svarasata eva nirodhāt
sati ca vyavadhāyake kuḍyenyasyotpitsoḥ samarthasya kṣaṇasya yathoktakāraṇābhāvenānutpatterjñānakāraṇavaikalyamataḥ kāraṇavaikalyāt
ghaṭādiṣu kuḍyādivyavahiteṣu jñānānutpattiriti kṛtvā kuḍyādaya āvaraṇamucyate
na punaḥ prāg vijñānajananayogyasya ghaṭādeḥ pratibandhāt
sambhavatyapi bhāvānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ kṣaṇikānāmanyonyopakāraḥ kuḍyādikṛtopyukāraḥ sahakārikṛte upakāre vivādābhāvāt
naivaṃ cintayituṃ śakyaṃ dūradeśavartyāvaraṇaṃ kathaṃ viṣayasyopakārakaṃ
apiśabdaḥ sambhāvanāyāṃ sambhāvyateyamartho na hyatra kiñcid bādhakamastīti

sa ca janakaḥ śabdasvabhāvaḥ karaṇavyāpārādeva siddha iti kṛtvā sarvakāryatulyadharmā
tasya tādṛśasya kāryatulyadharmaṇaḥ śabdasya vyaktāviṣyamāṇāyāṃ sarvamaṅkurādyapi vyaṅgyaṃ syāt
anyathā vāpi yadi vyaṅgyaḥ prāgasiddhaḥ syāt

nanu ca pradīpādirapyupalabdhiyogyaṃ ghaṭakṣaṇaṃ prāgasiddhameva janayati

anupalambhayogyaḥ pūrvako ghaṭādikṣaṇaḥ samānajātīya upādānakṣaṇastasya vyañjakavyāpārāt prāk siddheḥ kāraṇāt sa cet prāk siddhaḥ syādityucyate
na tasyaiva vyañjakāllabhyasya jñānahetoratiśayasya prāk siddheḥ siddha ucyate
sā vyañjakasāmagrī pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ

na tu vyañjekebhyo dhvanibhyonyo gakāraḥ pratibhāsate
gakāro gakāra iti teṣu nāmasāmyameva kevalaṃ pratīyate
yato dhvaniviśeṣā eva mātrākālaṃ prayujyamānā hrasvokāro bhavati
tathāpare dhvaniviśeṣā dvimātrākālaṃ prayujyamānā dīrgha ākāro bhavati
akāra eva tu mātrādikālamuccāryamāṇo yathākramaṃ hrasvadīrghaplutāḥ pratīyanta iti śabdamātrameva kevalaṃ
sarvadā yasya sadbhāvaḥ sa kathaṃ mātrikaḥ svayaṃ
dvimātramvā trimātramvā na śabdo mātrikaḥ svayamiti

arthābhedena viṣayaikatvena vyāptyā na sādhyate tāvat sandigdho vyatirekaḥ

vyāpṛteṣu karaṇeṣu na hi kadācicchabdānupalabdhiḥ kintūpalabdhireva
kvacid ghaṭādiśūnye deśe prakāśe pradīpādilakṣaṇe satyapi ghaṭādyanupalabdheḥ
tataśca janya eva śabdo na vyaṅgyaḥ
nanu pūrvaṃ jananamātreṇa kārakaṃ jñānajananayogyatvenotpādakantu vyañjakamevetyuktaṃ
tathā hyavikalasahakārikāraṇasya puṃsaḥ pradīpādijanako niyamena pradīpāderupalambhakaḥ kārako na vyañjaka ityadoṣaḥ
yathā te na nityā nāpi vyāpina iti
prakāśo hyeṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ vyañjako loke siddho na kulālādayaḥ
tatra vyañjakatve niṣiddhe pāriśeṣyāt kārakatvaṃ kulālādīnāṃ
naivaṃ śabdasya karaṇamuktvānyad vyañjakāntaraṃ siddhaṃ yena karaṇameva śabdasya kārakaṃ kalpyeta
ghaṭāderye kārakāḥ kulālādayaḥ samagrāsteṣāṃ yo dharmo niyamena svakāryārambhakatvantasya karaṇeṣu dṛṣṭeḥ
tānyapi hi vyāpṛtāni śabdaṃ niyamena janayanti
yadi ca śabdasya vyañjakāntarābhāvāt karaṇāni vyañjakānīṣyante
tadā tasyaiva vyañjakasya pradīpāderviṣayāntarasya ca kasyaciditi rasādervyañjakāntarampradīpādirnāsti
tatkāraṇāni pradīpādikāraṇāni caiṣāṃ pradīpādīnāṃ vyañjakāni syuḥ
yata evantasmānna vyaktiḥ śabdasya karaṇebhyaḥ kintūtpattireva
bhavantī vā karaṇebhyaḥ sakāśād vyaktistridhā bhavet
tasyā atiśayotpatteḥ pūrvarūpasya yā hāniraparasya pāścātyasya rūpasya yad upajananaṃ tallakṣaṇatvāt
sa yadi śabdasya vyaktiste tava mī māṃ sa ka sya matā

yathā tulye vastutve keṣāṃcideva janmināmutpattimatāṃ pratigho nāma svadeśe parasyotpattivivandhalakṣaṇa iṣṭo na sarveṣāṃ
yasmānna hi svabhāva ityeva kṛtvā sarvaḥ sarvasya svabhāvo bhavati
yathā pratighātmatā vastusvabhāvatvepi na sarvasya bhavati tadvadityarthaḥ
sarvaḥ sarvasya svabhāvo na bhavatīti sattyametat
tathāpyayaṃ sapratighasya janako'yaṃ neti svabhāvaniyamāddhetoḥ svabhāvaniyamaḥ phale'yaṃ pratigho'yaṃ neti
nānitye tu nānityatvaviṣaye kṛtakānāṃ rūpabhedosti yena kasyacinna śvaraḥ svabhāvaḥ syānnānyasya
nanu nāśasvabhāvo bhāvānānnānutpattimatāṃ yadīti codyaṃ prakṛtaṃ
na ca tatrānitye rūpabhedosti bhedakānāmabhāvata ityayamparihāro yuktaḥ
yathā sattvaṃ vyabhicāryuktantathā kṛtakopi kaścinnaśvaraḥ kaścinnetyāśaṃkate
śaktiniyamastādṛśaṃ hetuśaktyanurūpaṃ phalambhavatīti kṛtvā hetusvabhāvaniyamāt phalasvabhāvaniyama iṣṭaḥ
kaścideva naśnaraṃ janayenna sarvamityevaṃ naśvarajanane pratiniyataḥ svabhāvo yasya bhāvasyeti vigrahaḥ
tajjanmā vinaśvarajananāddhetorjanma yasya sa tathā syānnaśvaraḥ syānnānyo yastadvilakṣaṇahetujanmeti
kasyāścit sāmagryā naśvarajanikāyā darśanādadṛṣṭā api tajjātīyatayā tathābhūtā niścīyanta iti ced
tatra vicitraśaktiṣu sāmagrīṣu madhye kācit sāmagrī syādapi yā bhāvamanaśvarātmānaṃ janayet
ayaṃ ca parihāro nāśasvabhāvo bhāvānāṃ nānutpattimatāṃ
ye kadācit kāle kvacid deśe kenacit puruṣeṇārthā jñātāḥ santaḥ punarna jñāyante teṣāṃ santānānubandhī nāśa iti brūmaḥ
ye cājñātāḥ santo jñāyante jñātā vā punarna jñāyante
anena ca kṛtakatvasya kṣaṇikatvena vyāptiḥ sattvādityanena niścīyata ityuktambhavati
nanu ca yadyapi te jñātāssanto na jñāyante tathāpi kathanteṣāmanityatvamiti
yasmānna hyasti sambhavo yat te jñānajananasvabhāvāḥ pūrvampunaranaṣṭāstasminneva svabhāve sthitā na janayeyuḥ
na ca teṣu naiva teṣu jñānajananasvabhāveṣu vyavasthiteṣu sahakāryanapekṣeṣu kasyacit puṃsaḥ
tataśca jñānamajanayanto janakasvabhāvāt pracyutā iti gamyate
tasya cārthakriyāsamarthasya vastunaḥ krameṇārthakriyāṃ kurvato vināśāvyabhicārādahetutvācca vināśasya sattānubandhī vināśaḥ siddhaḥ
ata eva yathoktād vināśasya vastumātrānu bandhāt
yathā śabdasya nityatā pratikṣiptā tadvat sambandhasyāpi nityatā pratyākhyeyā
evantāvat sambandhaṃ vyatiriktamabhyupagamya doṣa ukto'dhunā'vyatirikta eva sambandho na yujyata iti
yā ca śabdaśaktiryogyatākhyā yogyatāsaṃjñitārthapratipattyāśrayo jai mi nī yai rva rṇṇyate
tathā hi bhāvānāṃsvabhāvātiśaya eva vivakṣitārthakriyāsamartho yogyatetyāveditaṃ prāk
samarthaṃ hi rūpaṃ śabdasya yogyate tyādinā
tenaiva prāguktena doṣeṇa śabdaśaktirapi sambandharūpeṇa kalpitā dūṣiteti kṛtvā na punaḥ pṛthagucyate doṣaḥ
bhavatu nāmāpauruṣeyastathāpi na tasya satyārthatā niścetuṃ śakyā
bhavantu nāmāpauruṣeyā vaidikāḥ śabdāstathāpi sambhāvyamevaiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmayathārthajñānahetutvaṃ
artheṣu jñāpyeṣu jñāpakānāṃ śabdānāṃ jñānavibhramo jñānaviparyāsaḥ
tathā hi rātrau pradīpo nīlotpale raktapratibhāsajñānahetuḥ
taditi tasmādime vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ puruṣasaṃskāranirapekṣāḥ syuriti sambandhaḥ prakṛtyā ca svabhāvena cārtheṣu pratītihetavo jñānahetavaḥ syuḥ
vitathā vyaktayorthapratipattayo yebhyaḥ śabdebhya iti vigrahaḥ
vitathavyaktaya eva sadā vaidikāḥ śabdā ityasya niyamasya kāraṇaṃ nāsti
tato niyamakāraṇābhāvād vitathavyaktaya eva vaidikāḥ śabdā ityetat kalpanamayuktamiti cet
tavāpi mī māṃ sa ka syāvitathajñānahetavo vaidikāḥ śabdā ityasminnavitathavyaktiniyame kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
tasmāt tvanmatena yathārthavyaktiniyamatvāt prakṛtyā svabhāvenāyathārthavyaktiniyamaḥ kinna kalpyate
athavā yathā vahnyādayo ghaṭādiṣu nīlotpalādiṣu cārtheṣu yathāyogaṃ satyāsatyajñānahetavastathā vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmartheṣu mithyetarajñānahetutvenobhayajñānahetutvaṃ syāt
ekatra ghaṭādau divā yathārthajñānahetavopi santaḥ sarvatra nīlotpalādāvapi rātrau
vahnyādīnāṃ kṛtakatvāt kāraṇād yathāpratyayaṃ yasya yadbhrāntikāraṇaṃ
anyathātvaṃ vitathajñānahetutvaṃ na punarnityeṣu śabdeṣvetat sahakāripratyayabalena mithyājñānahetutvamasti
nanvityādi si ddhā nta vā dī
kintu nityatvāt svabhāvata eva svaviṣayajñānajananasvabhāvā vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ
tadā kāryasya svaviṣayajñānasya yo jananasvabhāvastatra sthitau caiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ samayādeḥ
tato vaidikācchabdātpratītirjñānamartheṣu sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt
tasmānna vaidikāḥ śabdā arthapratītipratiṣṭhitasvabhāvāḥ kintu samayādikamapekṣyanta eveti
tepi mithyājñānasya hetava iti tadavastho doṣaḥ
tasmin śabde'kṛtake mate iṣṭe sati na jñānahetutaiva syāt
yasmānna hi nityebhyo vastusāmarthyāt svarūpopadhānasāmarthyena janmāsti kasyacit
tayoḥ kālo pratīterjanmetarakālayostulyarūpasya nityatvādekarūpasya pratī tirjanmani sāmarthyasambhāvanā'yogāt
pratīterajanmakāle yattasya janakaṃ rūpantasminneva svabhāve sthitasya janakatvavirodhāt
evamanena rūpeṇāyaṃ nityābhimato janako naivamanena rūpeṇājanaka ityevaṃ vivecanīyasya pṛthag vyavasthāpyasya rūpabhedasya svabhāvabhedasyābhāvāt
asya nityasyājanako yādṛśaḥ svabhāvastādṛśa eva janakona yuktaḥ
yata evantasmānnityānāṃ śabdānāṃ kvacidartheṣu puruṣe jñānajananasāmarthyaṃ
atha mābhūdeṣa doṣa iti nityaṃ svakāryaṃ kurvantyevetīṣyate
na te śabdāḥ kathaṃcit kenacit prakāreṇa karttāra ityetaccoktaṃ prāk
yā apyetā nityābhimateṣvākāśādiṣu pratipattayo buddhayo bhaviṣyantītīṣyate
anādiḥ samānajātīyo yo vikalpastenāhitā yā vāsanā śaktistata udbhūtā utpannā
yathāgamaṃ samāropito ya ākāśādyākārastadgocarāstatpratibhāsinya eva kevalaṃ gatāḥ
svalakṣaṇaviṣayā hi buddhirniyamena tasya svalakṣaṇasya yogyatā sāmarthyantasyopasthānaṃ sannidhānantadanuvidhāyinī tadbhāva eva bhāvinīti kṛtvā
asyā buddheryat kāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ yogyaṃ samarthantasmin kāraṇe yogye sati sā buddhirbhavatyeva
tadevaṃ nyāye sthite yadi nityānāṃ padārthānāṃ svalakṣaṇe kasyacit puṃso jñānaṃ syāt
tadā nityaṃ kāraṇasya saṃnnidhāt sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt

nāpi sahakāryapekṣayā nityānāṃ kasyacit kadācijjñānajananantathā hi kāryo janyaḥ sahakāribhirviśeṣo yāsāṃ vyaktīnāntā hi vyaktayaḥ kathaṃciddeśakālāvasthāniyamena kvacit kārye upayujyamānā hetutvaṃ pratipadyamānāstasya kāryasyopajanane yogyo yotiśaya ātmabhūtastasya pralambhe hetumvastuviśeṣaṃ sahakāriṇamiti yāvat
nityo bhāvo kāryaviśeṣonādheyātiśayaḥ kenacit puṃsā gṛhyamāṇastatkāraṇāpekṣaḥ grahaṇasahakārikāraṇāpekṣo yadi grahaṇamasya puṃso janayet
yuktaṃ yattenaiva puṃsā gṛhyeta nānyena sahakāripratiniyamāt
tacca sahakāryapekṣayā jananaṃ nityasya na sambhavati
tataśca nityaṃ jananasvabhāve sthitatvāt sarveṇa puṃsā samamekakālaṃ gṛhyetātha sarveṇājanakatvānna gṛhyeta
tadā sa evāsya svabhāva iti na vā kenacit puruṣeṇa kadācid gṛhyeta
iti hetossan vidyamāno nityo bhāvo yadi kenacit yogināpi dṛṣṭastadā na kaścinnityo'tīndriyaḥ syātsarveṣāmavaśyaṃ kenacid darśanāt
tathā cāsau nityaṃ sarvapuruṣāṇāmindriyagrāhya eva syāt sarvapuruṣamprati jñānajananasāmarthyāviśeṣāt
yā āhitā vāsanā tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ kāryotpādanaṃ pratyābhimukhyaṃ
yata evārthasāmarthyānapekṣā ata eva bāhyārthaśūnyā bhrāntaya evākāśādiṣu sarvasya puṃso bhavanti
kintu jñānaṃ jñānaṃ pratyarthā bhinnavṛttaya eva
atha nityamekarūpā eva tadā tattve vā
eka rūpatve vā'bhyupagamyamāne'vitathārthapratītaya eva vaidikāḥ śabdā iti kuta etat
na hyagnirhimasya bheṣajaṃ pratipakṣa ityevamādiṣu vedavākyeṣvagneḥ śītapratighātasāmarthyamvedavākyāt
prāgapi yathāsaṃketaṃ lokaprasiddhaṃ khyāpyata iti kṛtvā sarvamadṛṣṭārthamapi vedavākyantathā bhavati
lokaprasiddhe hyarthe lokasya saṃketānusāreṇa vyavahāro dṛṣṭaḥ
tatolokasya svecchākṛto yaḥ saṃketastenānu paścād vyavahārakāle vyavahārāt
agnirhimasya bheṣajamityādivākyādevampratyetyagneḥ śītāpanodasāmarthyamiti niścinotyāhosvicchabdasvabhāvasthiteḥ śabdasya svabhāvena prakṛtyā sāmarthyaniyamādevaṃ pratyetīti
yadā ca dṛṣṭa evārthe vaidikasya śabdasya svatorthapratipādanaśaktissandigdhā tadātyantaparokṣepyarthe nitarāṃ sambhāvyata iti bhāvaḥ
nanvanādilokaprasiddhyanuvidhānenaiva vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmarthavattā na ca tatra sandehaḥ pratibhāsata iti
lokecchayā parāvarttyamānā yathāsamayamartheṣu niveśyamānāḥ puna- ranyatra deśādiparāvṛttāvanyathetyarthāntaraniveśena parāvartyamānāḥ śabdā dṛśyante
tasmāt kasyacid vaidikasya vākyasyā gnirhimasyabheṣajamityādikasyāvaiparītyadarśanepi sarveṣāṃ vedavākyānāntathābhāvassatyārthatvanna sidhyati
akṛtakasvabhāvatvehyeṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ mithyārthaniyatopi kaścicchabdaḥ syāt
itihetoḥ svabhāvaparijñānādayaṃ satyārthoyaṃ mithyārtha ityevaṃ vivekena śabdasvabhāvāniścayāt sarvatra śabde saṃśayaḥ syāt
mithyātvaṃ kṛtakeṣveva dṛṣṭamiti hetorakṛtakamvacaḥ satyārthaṃ yadīti sambandhaḥ
akṛtakasya hetoryo vyatirekaḥ kṛtakatvantena satyārthatvaṃ yatsādhyantasya virodhimithyātvantasya vyāpanāt
vaidike śabde'kṛtakatvāt kṛtakatvanivṛttau mithyārthatvanivṛtteḥ satyārthatvaṃ sidhyatyeva
sādhyaṃ satyārthatvaṃ tasya vyatireko mithyātvantasya vyāpteranyatrākṛtake mithyārthatvasyāsambhavāt kāraṇādakṛtakaṃ satyārthamiti syād vināpyanvayena
yasmād yo hyartho mithyātvalakṣaṇo yena kṛtakatvenāvyāptastatra mithyātve tadvyatirekastasyāvyāpakasya kṛtakatvasya vyatireko kṛtakatvalakṣaṇo dharma āśaṃkyetāyamapi mithyātve bhavediti
na ca viruddhena vyāpte viruddhasya sambhavo yato na ca viruddhayoḥ kṛtakatvākṛtakatvayorekatra mithyātve sambhavosti
satyārthamithyārthatvābhyāṃ nānyā gatirastīta gatyantarābhāvādakṛtakatvena satyārtha eva bhavitavyamityakṛtakatvādiṣṭā rthasya satyārthatvalakṣaṇasya siddheḥ kimanvayena
vipakṣāddhetorvyatireke siddhe sati sādhyaṃ sidhyediti sattyametat
yadyakṛtakatvākhyasya hetossādhyavipakṣe mithyārthatve'bhāvaḥ sidhyettadā sādhyasya satyārthatvasya vyatirekaṃ mithyātvaṃ
na ca tasyākṛtakatvasya tatra mithyārthatāyāmasambhave bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ
evaṃ hi yasya kasyacid vidhānena yasya kasyacidabhāvaḥ pratīyeta
kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasyākṛtake kathaṃ vṛttiriti ced
na caikatra kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasya punaranyatrākṛtake'sambhava eva
anityatvaṃ prayatnānantarīyakatvena saha dṛṣṭamaprayatnānarīyakatvena saha dṛśyate
ayampuruṣamātraka ityarvāgdarśī sarvamvastu draṣṭuṃ samartho yenāsya puṃso darśananivṛttyā na tathā syāt
yasya hi puṃso jñānaṃ jñeyasattāṃ na vyabhicarati
sadityeva kṛtvā yasya sarvasmin jñaye jñānaṃ pravarttate tasya jñānaṃ jñeyavyāpakaṃ nivarttamānaṃ jñeyamapi nivarttayati
svabhāvaśca deśaśca kālaśca tairviprakarṣo vyavadhānamiti vigrahaḥ
sannapi kaściddeśakālābhyāṃ svabhāvena ca viprakṛṣṭaḥ piśācādivat
kevalamatītānāgatānāmidānīmanupalambhepi kadācit sattvaṃ bhūtaṃ kadācid bhaviṣyatītyanupalambhābhāva iti
ekasya vedavākyasya samvādadarśanāt sarvatra vede samvādanamiti
tathā vedavākyānāmmithyātvaṃ yadi nāma dṛṣṭantathāpi na śakyampratikṣeptuṃ
etāni ca trīṇi rūpāṇi jñānaiḥ pramāṇairyadi sidhyanti kīdṛśaistanniścayaphalaistasya rūpatrayasya niścayaḥ phalaṃ yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ
tadā tāni trīṇi rūpāṇi vivakṣitasya sādhyasya sādhanambhavanti
vādiprativādibhyāṃ niścitasya hetulakṣaṇayuktasyārthasya vācakaḥ sa sādhanandūṣaṇamvā
asiddhatvādilakṣaṇayuktasyārthasya vācakaḥ śabdaḥ prativādinā dūṣaṇābhiprāyeṇa prayuktaḥ
nānyataraprasiddhaḥ sandigdhavādo vādiprativādibhyā- manyataraprasiddhasya sandigdhasya cobhayoranyatarasya ca yo vācakaḥ śabdaḥ sa na sādhanaṃ nāpi dūṣaṇaṃ
na cākṛtakatvena saha mithyārthatvasya virodho niścito yenākṛtake mithyātvasya vyatirekaḥ siddhaḥ syāt
akṛtakatvādeva vede mithyātvaṃ na bhavatīti ced
yasmāt ko hi sacetā akṛtakatvena sahādṛṣṭavirodhasya mithyātvasya sambhavamvedavākyeṣu pratyācakṣīta
taditi tasmādayamakṛtakatvasya hetoryathokto vyatireko na sādhanaṃ
sa evāsya kṛtakasya hetoḥ sapakṣaḥ syād
nanu sādhyadharmasāmānyena samānorthaḥ sapakṣaḥ sādharmyadṛṣṭānta ucyate
evaṃ hetorakṛtakatvasya vipakṣeṇa kṛtakatvena sādhyavipakṣasya mithyātvasya yā vyāptiḥ sā tadabhāve kṛtakatvābhāve mithyātvasyābhāvasiddhau satyāṃ syāt
kṛtakatvābhāve bhavato mithyārthatvasya tena kṛtakatvena vyāptyayogāt
vipakṣo mithyātvantasya kṛtakatvanivarttano kṛtake yo vyavacchedo vyāvṛttistallakṣaṇatvāt
tasya ca mithyārthatvasyākṛtake yadā pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtastadā pratiṣedhadvayañjātaṃ
asmācca satyārthatāvyavacchedarūpāt pratiṣedhadvayāt satyārthatāvidhisiddheriti hetoḥ kānanvayānvayarahitā
sādhanavyatirekeṇa kṛtakatvena sādhyavyatirekasya mithyātvasya vyāptisiddhirnaivānanvayā vyāptisiddhiḥ
yadā kvacicchaśaviṣāṇādau vyavacchedaḥ kriyate tadāpi tathā syāt
abhāvasya ca yo vyavacchedo nivṛttistasya bhāvarūpatvāt
bhāvasvabhāvasya vyavacchede sati na bhāvānuṣaṅgo na bhāvasyākṣepaḥ
bhāvo na bhava tīti tatpratiṣedhasyaiva sambhavāt
abhāvavyavacchedasvabhāvasya virahamātrasya tu yo vyavacchedassa niyamena bhāvasyopasthāpano bhāvasyākṣepakaḥ
sa satyārthatā'bhāvarūpā sa vyatiricyamānaḥ kṛtakatvanivṛtyā nivarttamāno bhāvaṃ satyārthatālakṣaṇamupasthāpayatyakṛtake
tadā vedavā kyeṣu kṛtakanivṛttau mithyātvameva na syānna tu satyārthatvantataścānarthakyaṃ syāditi vakṣyati
bhogaḥ sukhaduḥkhānubhavastayoradhiṣṭhānaṃ svīkārastatrāsvatantraḥ paravaśo hyātmā svabhāvo nirātmā
tasmin kriyābhogādhiṣṭhāne yatsvātantryaṃ tallakṣa ṇa tvāt
yata evantaditi tasmād rūpaṃ svabhāvo nairātmyaṃ nātmanivṛttimātraṃ
anyathā yadi nivṛttimātraṃ nairātmyaṃ syāttadā niḥsvabhāvatvānnirupākhyameva tad bhavet
kintvātmavyavacchedena nirātmano bhāvasya vastuno nirātmaśabdena parāmarśādabhidhānāt kṛtakatvādessakāśānnairātmyagatirna prāpnotītyayamadoṣa iti cet
tasmād bauddhānāṃ śaśaviṣāṇādau nairātmyavyavacchedepi nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ
tena yadukta manityanirātmatāvyavacchedepi tathā syādi ti tatparihṛtaṃ
yasyāpi nai yā yi kā de rnābhāvarūpa ātmaā vyatirekaḥ
svabhāvābhāva eva tasya naiyāyikāderbhāvarūpasya nairātmyasya vyavacchede nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt
yathā ca śaśaviṣāṇādau nairātmyavyavacchedepyātmano nānvayānugamastathā jīvaccharīre'nairātmyepi nairātmyābhāvepi nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt
mī māṃ sa ko ktavyatirekinirākaraṇaprastāvena naiyāyikoktamapi vyatirekiṇaṃ nirākarttumāha
tasyaivamvādino naiyāyikasya bhāvarūpasya nairātmyasya vyavacchede nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt
yathā ca nānvayānuṣaṅgastathā sādhyadharmiṇyanairātmyepi nairātmyanivṛttāvapi nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt
atra prayoge jīvaccharīrasya sātmakatvaṃ sādhyanna cobhayasiddhaḥ

kevalaṃ sādhyasyātmano hetośca prāṇādimattvasya yathākramaṃ yau vipakṣau nairātmyamaprāṇādimatvaṃ ca tayorvyāpyavyāpakabhāvacintāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāmapramāṇādimatva eva nairātmyaṃ dṛṣṭantadabhāve vyāpakasyāprāṇādi- mattvasyābhāve ca vyāpyaṃ nairātmyaṃ
svayaṃ na bhavadapi nairātmyaṃ prāṇādīnāṃ hetutvenābhimatānāmātmani sapakṣabhūte na siddhimupasthāpayati

tatsamutthāpyānāmvarṇṇānāmutpattikramaḥ kramotpannaiśca varṇṇaiḥ svaviṣayāṇi kramabhāvīnyeva śrotravijñānāni sākṣājjanyante
tato varṇṇānāṃ samutthāpakajñānakramād yā krame kāryatā
svaviṣayajñāneṣu ca yā krameṇa kāraṇatā saivānupūrvīti vyavasthāpyata iti
yathā sara ityatra pade sakārāt paro'kāraḥ
sakārasya samutthāpakaṃ yajjñānantasmādakārasamutthāpakaṃ jñānaṃ yadutpannantenākāro janyata ityarthaḥ
evantāvad vaktṛsantānasthasya samutthānajñānasya kramād varṇṇānāṃ krameṇotpatteḥ kāryatvamuktaṃ
te ca krameṇotpannāḥ śrotṛsantānasthānāṃ svaviṣayajñānānāṃ krameṇa hetavo bhavanto jñāyanta iti darśayannāha
pūrvo varṇṇa upādhiviśeṣaṇaṃ yasyottarasya varṇṇasya sa tathoktaḥ
sa ityuttaro varṇṇaḥ śrutyā śrotrajñānena samavasīyate gṛhyate
nanu ca pūrvo varṇṇa uttaravarṇṇakāle naivāsti
tatkathantadupādhi pūrva varṇopādhi ruttaro varṇṇo gṛhyata iti
tena pūrvavarṇṇāviṣayeṇa jñānena janitaṃ svaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ
sakārālambanaṃ yadā śrotravijñānaṃ tasminnevakāle akārasamutthāpanacittenākāro janitastenākārassakārālambanaśca pratyayaḥ samānakālaḥ
tatra sākārālambanena śrotravijñānena sahakāriṇā'kāraḥ svaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ janayan pūrvavarṇṇopādhiḥ pratīyata ityucyata ityarthaḥ
apaṭuśrutirityatvaritaṃ śanaiḥ śanairuccārito yadā varṇṇo bhavati
tadā'paṭvī mandacāriṇī pravibhaktavarṇṇagrāhiṇī śrutiḥ śrotravijñānaṃ yasya śabdasyetyapaṭuśrutiḥ
ati tvaritantūccāryamāṇe vibhaktavarṇṇāparicchedāt kutaḥ krameṇa smṛtijananamityasya sandarśanārthaṃ
etena ca svaviṣayāṇi jñānāni prati varṇṇānāṃ krameṇa kāraṇatoktā
varṇṇahetavaḥ krameṇa yadi cetāṃsi teṣāṃ sambandhena varṇṇānāṃ krameṇa kāryatā
cittaṃ samutthānaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasyā vāgvijñaptessā tathoktā
varṇṇe tyādi varṇṇāḥ padaṃ vākyaṃ cetyabhidhānaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ
tatretyādi sara ityatra pade yañca varṇṇāḥ sakārastasmāt paro akārastato rephastasmādakārastasmātparo visarjanīya iti
tathetyuktena krameṇa rephākā- ravisarjanīyā utthāpyante yaiścittaistāni pūrvapūrvapratyayāni
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ cittaṃ pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ
tadeva ca cittaṃ sakārasamutthāpakamucyate tadanantaraṃ sakārasyotpatteḥ
atra ca sakārasamutthāpakacetasā samanantarapratyayenetyā dinā granthenaikakarttṛka eva varṇṇakramorthapratītiheturna bhinnakarttṛka ityuktambhavati
tena yaducyate ma ṇḍa ne na
atha samutthāpakacittakrameṇa varṇṇakramādarthapratītistathāpi sa ca kramo jñāpakatvājjñānamapekṣate
na ca tatra samutthāpakacittakāryakāraṇatāṃ kaścana niścetumarhati
na ca tirohita vyavahitayorvakturekatve pramāṇamastī ti
devadatto māṃ śabdayati na yajñadatta iti loke pratītipūrvikaiva pravṛttirdṛśyate
api ca spho ṭa vā dinopi tirohitāvasthādau kathaṃ sphoṭābhivyaktirvyañjakānāṃ varṇṇānāmekakarttṛkatvānavadhāraṇāt
svakāraṇāni samutthāpakānyeva jñānāni teṣāmānupūrvī kramastasyā janma yeṣānte tathoktāḥ
śrutikālepi śravaṇakālepi yadā mandacāriṇa iti yadā nātidrutamuccāryanta ityarthaḥ
pūrvavarṇṇālambanaṃ jñānantadeva sahakāripratyayastamapekṣante ye varṇṇāste tathoktāḥ
